title: Network Infrastructure Engineer I, Amazon Dedicated Cloud (NIDD)
descriptionHtml:
Application deadline: Nov 9, 2026

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for a Network Infrastructure Engineer to build Amazon Dedicated Cloud regions as part of our Infrastructure Operations team. As dedicated cloud regions continue to expand and grow, Infrastructure Operations is looking for builders to take on the challenge of scaling network systems allowing us to stay ahead of customer demand.

As a Network Infrastructure Engineer, you will work in a dynamic environment to drive the stability and sustainability of our next-generation networks and assist in the development of innovative ways to automate and scale our network. The position's responsibilities include scaling support of several data center locations and day to day assistance with capacity management. Engineers will work closely with internal customers and external vendors to facilitate smooth project execution as directed by Technical Program Managers.

The ideal candidate should be highly autonomous, very detail oriented, possess strong written and verbal communication skills and have significant experience in supporting large scale, enterprise class networks. Excellent network implementation and troubleshooting skills combined with a proven documentation methodology is also required. The desire and ability to work in a fast paced, collaborative environment is essential.

In addition to providing top-tier management and support of Amazon’s vast network infrastructure, Network Infrastructure Engineers are expected to build or enhance tools, develop best practices, refine operational procedures and think proactively.

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen and must currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph.


Key job responsibilities
- Clearly communicate project status and blockers to leadership and project management.
- Perform device build and cabling validation activities.
- Manage cabling vendor activities and performing quality assurance activities.
- Support Network Engineering deployment activities during scheduled change management windows and participate in the migration (possibly off business hrs), basic configuration and rollout of new or upgraded hardware
- Complete customer requests via Remedy trouble ticketing system
- Troubleshoot networking, routing and inter connectivity issues, including troubleshooting of network device configuration and low-level application interaction. Deliver simple, sustainable and repeatable solutions and processes.
- Manage work and priorities through ticketing system and workflow and Collaborate with various stakeholders to remove project obstacles
- Travel within geographical work area is required, up to 40% travel outside traditional work area may be required possibly including international travel and experience with small project scopes and ambiguous details within a relevant work environment

A day in the life
A day in the life of a Network Design Engineer on our team includes attending meetings, creating and executing change management activities in the data centre, deploying hardware, connecting cabling, troubleshooting links, updating tickets, working with peers from all across AWS to innovate and develop, and finding new ways to do it all better for our customers.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

title: Ingénieur(e) en Chef DCEO, Data Center Engineering Operations
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services recherche un(e) Ingénieur(e) en Chef rigoureux(se) et expérimenté(e) pour rejoindre notre équipe Data Center Engineering Operations (DCEO). Ce groupe s'engage à maintenir l'infrastructure physique critique qui supporte Amazon Web Services, en garantissant un fonctionnement des systèmes mécaniques, électriques et de protection incendie/sécurité à 100 % de disponibilité, tout en assurant un service client de premier ordre aux équipes opérant au sein des centres de données.

AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS)
AWS Infrastructure Services est responsable de la conception, de la planification, de la livraison et de l'exploitation de l'ensemble de l'infrastructure mondiale d'AWS. En d'autres termes, nous sommes les personnes qui font fonctionner le cloud. Nous soutenons l'ensemble des centres de données AWS ainsi que tous les serveurs, équipements de stockage, réseaux, systèmes d'alimentation électrique et de refroidissement qui garantissent à nos clients un accès continu aux innovations sur lesquelles ils comptent. Nous travaillons sur les problèmes les plus complexes, avec des milliers de variables impactant nos opérations, et nous recherchons des talents qui souhaitent nous aider à relever ces défis.

Vous rejoindrez une équipe diversifiée composée d'ingénieurs logiciels, matériels et réseau, de spécialistes des systèmes critiques, d'experts en sécurité, de responsables des opérations et d'autres rôles essentiels. Vous collaborerez avec des collègues à travers AWS pour maintenir les plus hauts standards de sécurité tout en fournissant une capacité apparemment infinie au coût le plus bas possible pour nos clients. Vous évoluerez dans une culture inclusive qui accueille les idées audacieuses et vous donne les moyens de les mener à terme.

En tant qu'Ingénieur(e) en Chef DCEO, vous serez responsable de veiller à ce que tous les équipements électriques, mécaniques et de sécurité incendie/sécurité des personnes au sein du centre de données fonctionnent à leur efficacité optimale. Cela implique à la fois la maintenance préventive planifiée des équipements, les travaux correctifs quotidiens et la réponse aux incidents urgents. Vous jouerez le rôle de référent(e) technique unique pour toutes les opérations des installations, en reportant au Facility Manager du site et en interagissant avec les Techniciens en Exploitation des Opérations d'Ingénierie (EOT) ainsi qu'avec les prestataires tiers. Les équipements des centres de données supportant des serveurs critiques doivent maintenir un taux de disponibilité supérieur à 99,999 %.

En tant qu'Ingénieur(e) en Chef DCEO, vous gérerez des projets à impact faible à moyen, de la conception jusqu'à la livraison. Ces projets impliquent une part importante de travail en autonomie ainsi qu'une collaboration avec des équipes supports transverses incluant l'ingénierie, l'automatisation, les opérations et la finance, dans des environnements locaux et internationaux. Vous créerez et assurerez le suivi des jalons clés, obtiendrez et suivrez les devis pour tous les coûts nécessaires, et documenterez les résultats des projets pour une mise en œuvre future dans d'autres installations. L'objectif est de piloter l'innovation et la résilience tout en réduisant les coûts opérationnels.

L'un des aspects les plus enrichissants de ce rôle est de diriger, former et encadrer les Techniciens en Exploitation des Opérations d'Ingénierie dans leur mission de dépannage et d'exploitation des équipements électriques et mécaniques. Cela inclut notamment les groupes électrogènes diesel de secours, les tableaux de distribution, les onduleurs (UPS), les PDU, les unités de traitement d'air (UTA), les refroidisseurs centrifuges, les tours de refroidissement, les systèmes de traitement chimique, les pompes, les moteurs, les variateurs de fréquence (VFD) et les systèmes de gestion technique du bâtiment (GTB).


Key job responsibilities
• Superviser les opérations quotidiennes et la maintenance des équipements mécaniques et électriques du centre de données.
• Travailler en autonomie avec un niveau de supervision directe limité.
• Agir en tant que point d'escalade pour tous les problèmes liés aux installations du centre de données, en escaladant au Facility Manager selon les besoins.
• Effectuer des analyses des causes racines (Root Cause Analysis) des défaillances d'équipements.
• Dépanner et signaler les événements au niveau des installations et des serveurs dans les délais SLA internes.
• Créer et déployer de nouvelles pratiques standard pour les Techniciens EOT, les Ingénieurs en Chef et les équipes prestataires.
• Assurer la formation et l'encadrement des Techniciens en Exploitation des Opérations d'Ingénierie.
• Veiller au strict respect de toutes les procédures de sécurité par les prestataires et le personnel Amazon.
• Utiliser le CMMS interne pour gérer et suivre les flux de travail des installations.
• Communiquer des informations techniques complexes à un public non technique.
• Gérer des projets d'amélioration des infrastructures de la conception à la livraison, en assurant le suivi des jalons, des coûts et des livrables.


About the team
Pourquoi AWS ?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) est la plateforme cloud la plus complète et la plus largement adoptée au monde. Nous avons été pionniers du cloud computing et n'avons jamais cessé d'innover — c'est pourquoi les clients, des startups les plus prospères aux entreprises du Global 500, font confiance à notre gamme robuste de produits et services pour alimenter leurs activités.

Expériences diversifiées
Amazon valorise les expériences diversifiées. Même si vous ne répondez pas à toutes les qualifications et compétences préférées énumérées dans la description du poste, nous vous encourageons à postuler. Si votre carrière débute, n'a pas suivi un parcours traditionnel ou inclut des expériences alternatives, ne laissez pas cela vous empêcher de postuler.

Culture d'équipe inclusive
Chez AWS, la curiosité et la connexion humaine sont au cœur de notre identité. Nos groupes d'affinité portés par les employés et soutenus par l'entreprise favorisent l'inclusion et permettent à chacun d'être fier de ce qui le rend unique. Nos événements d'inclusion renforcent des équipes plus soudées et plus collaboratives. Notre innovation continue est alimentée par les idées audacieuses, les perspectives nouvelles et les voix passionnées que nos équipes apportent à tout ce que nous faisons.

Mentorat et évolution de carrière
Nous élevons continuellement notre barre de performance dans notre quête pour devenir le Meilleur Employeur au Monde. C'est pourquoi vous trouverez ici un partage de connaissances infini, du mentorat et d'autres ressources d'avancement professionnel pour vous aider à devenir un professionnel plus accompli.

Équilibre vie professionnelle / vie personnelle
Nous valorisons l'harmonie entre vie professionnelle et vie personnelle. Réussir au travail ne devrait jamais se faire au détriment de sacrifices à la maison, c'est pourquoi nous nous efforçons d'offrir de la flexibilité dans notre culture de travail. Lorsque nous nous sentons soutenus sur le lieu de travail et à la maison, il n'y a rien que nous ne puissions accomplir dans le cloud.

Basic qualifications

- Niveau intermédiaire en anglais et/ou en français (oral et écrit)
- Diplôme de niveau Bac+3 minimum en Génie Électrique, Génie Mécanique, CVC, Technologie Industrielle ou Génie Électrotechnique
- Minimum 5 ans d'expérience professionnelle pertinente dans un centre de données ou tout autre environnement critique
- Expérience significative dans l'exploitation et la maintenance d'infrastructures critiques (onduleurs, groupes électrogènes, tableaux de distribution, CVC, systèmes eau glacée/refroidissement)

Preferred qualifications

- Maîtrise de l’anglais (oral, écrit et lecture)
- Connaissance des systèmes CMMS, GTB (Gestion Technique du Bâtiment) et de supervision électrique (EPMS)
- Expérience en gestion de projets techniques (conception, suivi des coûts, livraison)
- Expérience en centre de données, industrie manufacturière ou secteur Oil & Gas
- Expérience avérée dans l'encadrement et la formation d'équipes techniques
- Familiarité avec les environnements opérationnels critiques 24h/24, 7j/7, 365 jours par an
- Aptitude à communiquer des informations techniques complexes à des interlocuteurs non techniques

Amazon est un employeur engagé pour l'égalité des chances. Nous sommes convaincus qu'une main d'oeuvre diversifée est essentielle à notre réussite. Nous prenons nos décisions de recrutement en fonction de votre expérience et de vos compétences. Nous apprécions votre envie de découvrir, d'inventer, de simplifier et de construire. title: Principal Delivery Consultant, Emerging Tech
descriptionHtml:
The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Delivery Consultant to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you'll work closely with semiconductor and high-tech manufacturing customers to design, implement, and manage AWS solutions that meet their technical requirements and business objectives. You'll be a key player in driving customer success through their cloud journey, providing technical expertise and best practices throughout the project lifecycle.

Possessing a deep understanding of AWS products and services, as a Principal Delivery Consultant you will be proficient in architecting complex, scalable, and secure solutions tailored to meet the specific needs of each customer. You'll work closely with stakeholders to gather requirements, assess current EDA and manufacturing infrastructure, and propose effective migration strategies to AWS. As trusted advisors to our customers, providing guidance on industry trends, emerging technologies, and innovative solutions, you will be responsible for the implementation process, ensuring adherence to best practices, optimizing performance, and managing risks throughout the project.

Your focus will span EDA workload migration, smart manufacturing, digital twins, and generative AI applications for chip design and verification. You'll partner with technology leaders to assess their current state, architect cloud-native solutions, and deliver transformative engagements across the entire chip value chain.

The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.

Key job responsibilities
As an experienced technology professional, you will be responsible for:
- Designing and implementing complex, scalable, and secure AWS solutions for semiconductor customers — including high-performance computing environments for chip design, simulation, and verification
- Providing technical guidance and troubleshooting support throughout project delivery, incorporating smart manufacturing solutions such as industrial data fabric, digital twins, and computer vision for defect detection
- Collaborating with stakeholders to gather requirements and propose effective migration strategies for EDA workloads and manufacturing systems
- Acting as a trusted advisor to customers on semiconductor industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices for cloud adoption
- Sharing knowledge within the organization through mentoring, training, and creating reusable artifacts — including reference architectures and AI/ML workflows for accelerating the design-to-fab process

A day in the life
Your morning might start with a working session alongside a semiconductor customer's engineering team, helping them optimize their EDA compute environment for faster tape-out cycles. After lunch, you're whiteboarding a computer vision architecture for automated wafer inspection with a solutions architect and account manager. Later, you're refining a proof-of-concept that uses generative AI to accelerate chip verification workflows. Between customer calls, you're contributing to a reference architecture that will help the next customer get to value faster.

title: Software Development Manager, S3
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Simple Storage Service (S3) is storage for the Internet. Through the use of pioneering techniques in distributed computing, developers are able to durably store their data on Amazon’s proven computing infrastructure to achieve virtually limitless storage capacity at minimal cost. Amazon S3 provides a simple web services interface that can be used to store and retrieve any amount of data, at any time, from anywhere on the web. It gives any developer access to the same highly scalable, reliable, secure, fast, inexpensive infrastructure that Amazon uses to run its own global network of web sites. The service aims to maximize benefits of scale and to pass those benefits on to developers.

We are seeking a talented Software Development Manager to join our S3 organization to build and support a new storage paradigm for AWS. You will contribute towards our rapidly increasing scale as we develop new services and integrate with other S3 and AWS teams. To meet and exceed our customers' expectations, we are constantly working on software innovation, process automation, and improving cloud storage infrastructure. We seek smart, passionate people to help us deliver this industry leading technology.

Our team is clearly passionate about the incredible opportunity that Amazon S3 presents and about distributed systems in general. You will have the opportunity to deliver high quality technology products/services in a hyper-growth environment delivering AWS and S-Team level goals. You will be able to utilize your experience in building, managing, and mentoring engineering teams, while building, operating or using web-based services.

We are an organization focused on designing, building and supporting critical S3 storage software services and infrastructure that allows S3 to meet internal and external customer growth. Our team works to focus on current and future operational health while iterating quickly in an exciting and hugely impactful space, giving the opportunity to work with experienced Amazonians across AWS. Our leaders are focused on providing a supportive, inclusive environment with excellent opportunities for growth.

Key job responsibilities
Leading and owning a flexible web service requires exceptional technical expertise, a sound understanding of the fundamentals of Computer Science, and practical experience leading large-scale distributed systems. You should be somebody who enjoys working on complex system software, is customer-centric, and feels strongly not only about building good software but about making that software achieve its goals in operational reality. Come join us and help solve a challenging set of problems in a space packed full of opportunities.

A Software Development Manager in this role is responsible for leading the architectural vision, upholding best practices and quality standards, hiring and developing talent, and establishing a strong customer-focused vision for the team. You will work daily with Senior and Principal Engineers, Senior leadership across S3 and our partners in other AWS organizations to prioritize the right solutions for the long-term success of S3 and AWS storage health. title: Applied Scientist, Personalization, Personalization
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking an Applied Scientist to help build Amazon’s next-generation customer memory and personalization systems.

Are you interested in building systems that move beyond reacting to customer behavior, to actually understanding and remembering it over time? Our team is building Amazon’s customer memory layer – a system that extracts, curates, and reasons over customer knowledge to power next-generation personalization. This includes transforming noisy, unstructured signals into durable, high-quality representations of customer preferences, intents, and life events, and using them in real time to improve customer experiences.

We are part of Amazon’s Personalization organization, a high-performing group that leverages large-scale machine learning, generative AI, and distributed systems to deliver highly relevant customer experiences.
We tackle challenging problems at the intersection of information extraction, knowledge representation, LLM reasoning, and recommendation systems. Our systems operate under real-world constraints of scale, latency, and quality, requiring careful tradeoffs between precision, recall, and responsiveness. This team plays a central role in defining how Amazon understands its customers, and how that understanding is applied across the shopping experience.

As an Applied Scientist, you will design and build ML and LLM-powered solutions for Amazon's customer memory and
personalization systems. You will work on how customer knowledge is extracted, validated, and applied in production
systems.

You will own the end-to-end delivery of ML solutions, from problem formulation and modeling to offline and online experimentation, and production deployment at scale. You will deliver high-quality, scalable systems that power customer-facing experiences.
You will drive work across areas such as fact extraction, memory quality and lifecycle, temporal reasoning, and grounded personalization, while navigating tradeoffs between quality, latency, and coverage.
You will collaborate closely with engineering and product teams to translate research into measurable customer impact.

Please visit https://www.amazon.science for more information.

- Knowledge of programming languages such as C/C++, Python, Java or Perl
- Experience in patents or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals
- PhD, or a Master's degree and experience in CS, CE, ML or related field research
- Strong communication and collaboration skills

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in building and launching deep learning and machine learning models for business applications
- Solid knowledge of big data and cloud technologies (e.g., Spark, AWS, etc.)
- Experience with information retrieval, recommender systems, natural language processing, and/or personalization algorithms
- Publications at top Web, Machine Learning, Natural Language Processing conferences such as KDD, ICML, NeurIPS, ACL, EMNLP, etc.

title: Software Development Engineer, AWS Infrastructure Supply Chain Automation
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Join AWS Supply Chain as a Software Development Engineer II and build the systems that power the world's leading cloud infrastructure. You'll develop cutting-edge inventory and warehouse management systems that enable AWS to provide computing services to millions of customers worldwide. Working with a collaborative team of engineers, supply chain specialists, and operations managers, you'll solve complex problems with thousands of variables impacting the global supply chain. This role offers unique opportunities to work directly with business stakeholders in defining, designing, and operating products that ensure physical and financial control of inventory across AWS's global footprint.

We're looking for someone passionate about product design who innovates for customers in a flat team structure. You'll take true ownership of your work, from design through deployment, while contributing to the systems that keep the cloud running for hundreds of thousands of developers and businesses using AWS daily.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, develop, test, and deploy scalable software solutions for inventory and warehouse management systems that support AWS's global infrastructure operations
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams including supply chain specialists, security experts, and operations managers to deliver integrated solutions that meet business requirements
- Participate actively in code review processes, providing meaningful feedback to teammates and ensuring high-quality, maintainable code across the team
- Take operational responsibility for software systems, identifying root causes of issues and implementing permanent fixes to improve system reliability and performance
- Work with customers and stakeholders to understand business value and requirements, ensuring software solutions align with long-term architectural strategy and customer needs

A day in the life
You'll start your day reviewing system metrics and addressing any overnight operational issues with your global team. Throughout the day, you'll design and implement features for supply chain management systems, participate in collaborative code reviews, and work directly with business stakeholders to refine requirements. You'll spend time analyzing complex supply chain data patterns, building automated solutions for inventory orchestration, and mentoring new team members on system architecture and best practices.

About the team
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure - we're the people who keep the cloud running. title: Area Manager II
descriptionHtml:
Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Area Manager. In this role, you will lead a team of hourly workforce and will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. You will also play a key role in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.

Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. Please note that all workflows have slight building variations, but one thing is constant: our vision and dedication to the customer.

Key job responsibilities
* Support, mentor, and motivate your hourly workforce
* Manage safety, quality, productivity, and customer delivery promises
* Collaborate with all support teams including Safety, Engineering, Loss Prevention, Quality Assurance, Human Resources to develop plans to meet business objectives
* Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
* Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
* Work in an environment where the noise level varies and can be loud
* Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
* Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)

Our fulfillment network launches new Operations sites every year, providing various opportunities for your professional growth. We hire Area Managers based on location preference and the business’ current openings.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of employee and performance management experience
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays

Preferred qualifications

- 1+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience
- Experience managing a team of 20+ employees
- Experience with process improvements (Lean process, Kaizen, and/or Six Sigma)
- Excellent customer service, communication, and interpersonal skills
- A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain/Logistics, or a related field.
- Industry experience in: retail, F&B, military, manufacturing, automotive, biotech, electronics, energy, instrumentation, machinery, defense/aerospace, medical, cosmetics, production or distribution environments.

descriptionHtml:
The successful candidate will perform hands-on operation and maintenance of the electrical and mechanical infrastructure for AWS-owned Data Centers (DC) in Amazon Web Services (AWS) Cloud regions. Our engineers are directly operating and maintaining AWS DCs' world-class mechanical and electrical infrastructure. In addition to technical operations and maintenance, the successful candidate will perform facility operations and ensure the implementation of safety procedures.
This is a highly hands-on, field-based role requiring a motivated, self-managed individual who demonstrates initiative and proactively seeks solutions to problems while striving for operational excellence. The work follows a process-oriented approach: the individual needs a strong willingness to learn new processes and adapt to rapidly changing operational scenarios with conflicting priorities.
The successful candidate will be part of the Engineering and Facilities team and will be responsible for maintaining availability for customers, ensuring maintenance and operation of technical infrastructure, and the upkeep and operation of the DC facility.

AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS)

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Key job responsibilities
SAFETY
Follow and maintain the highest safety standards and diligently encourage a world-class safety culture. As a facility owner team member, ensure remediation of safety risks/issues in conjunction with other teams. Own safety initiatives and projects to foster strong safety culture.
Lead by example in implementing and maintaining AWS safety protocols
Respond to emergency situations and coordinate with emergency services as needed

ENGINEERING & FACILITY OPERATIONS AND MAINTENANCE
• Operational hands on experience, and deep knowledge with electrical, mechanical, fire protection and control systems, including Uninterruptable Power Supplies (UPS’s), Switchgear, Circuit Breakers, Automatic Transfer Switches (ATS's), Diesel Generators, Chillers, Heating Ventilation Air Conditioning (HVAC), Water treatment systems, Static Transfer Switch (STS), Exhaust Fans, Variable Frequency Drives (VFD's), Fire Systems and Transformers.
• Operate, monitor, and maintain fire detection and suppression systems including pre-action systems, VESDA (Very Early Smoke Detection Apparatus), and other fire protection equipment
• Draft, review and publish Standard Operating Procedures (SOP), Emergency Operating Procedures (EOP) and Method of Procedures (MOP) for in -house activities.
• Review vendor documentation for preventative maintenance (e.g. RAMS – Risk Assessment Method of Statement)
• Perform routine inspections and testing of fire alarm panels, smoke detectors, and suppression systems in accordance with AWS standards and local regulations
• Troubleshoot and resolve straightforward electro-mechanical problems; and collaborates with the engineering team, within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA’s)
• Take daily operational readings of all mechanical and electrical equipment through routine rounds/log-taking (temperatures, voltages, currents, etc.)
• Perform hands-on preventive and corrective maintenance activities on critical infrastructure
• Execute equipment repairs, replacements, and facility modifications in accordance with AWS standards guidelines.
• Maintain accurate documentation of all maintenance activities, equipment performance, and system configurations
• Collaborate with internal AWS teams on capacity planning and infrastructure improvements
• Supervise contractors who perform servicing or preventive maintenance
• Respond to alarms and perform emergency troubleshooting and repairs
• You may train new team members (Drill, Buddy, Mentor)
• You may participate in business reviews (e.g., WBR/MBR).
• Execute and plan work assignments, using maintenance and change management documents, and by reviewing outstanding action items with your Facility Manager and/or Chief Engineer.
• Take action to make improvements based on operating experience, assist in the creation of process improvement plans, and provide process improvement feedback to site leadership
• Managing ticketing systems for Preventive and Corrective Maintenance (CMMS, Incident management tool)
• Manual handling and lifting of equipment may be required (weight limits in accordance with health & safety regulations)

title: Sr Enterprise Sales Specialist Cloud Infrastructure
descriptionHtml:
Senior Enterprise Sales Specialist, Cloud Infrastructure

Do you obsess over customer outcomes?

We're looking for a Senior Enterprise Sales Specialist, Cloud Infrastructure who starts with the customer's business challenge, works backwards from their goals, and builds migration and modernisation solutions that deliver real, measurable value across the full AWS platform.

Join a team of driven sales specialists focused on helping UK and Ireland customers achieve transformational business outcomes through cloud migration and modernisation. You will earn trust by deeply understanding each customer's priorities, then build pipeline and close revenue by positioning migration not as a technology project but as the fastest path to the business results they care about.

The ideal candidate is a quota-carrying sales specialist who leads with customer empathy and backs it with technical credibility. You engage at CXO level to understand business pain, and propose solutions that genuinely solve problems. You see migration as the commercial catalyst for larger transformation programmes that culminate in AI adoption and intelligent automation, and you build pipeline by earning trust and demonstrating long-term value. You thrive in ambiguity, own outcomes end-to-end, and make decisions independently. You are a self-starter, ready to develop and execute account and territory plans that exceed targets. You bring strong knowledge of SaaS and on-premises infrastructure (Nutanix, VMware, Hyper-V), colocation and hosting environments, and cloud platforms (GCP, Azure), along with a working understanding of Microsoft licensing and enterprise agreements.

How you will spend your time

80% working directly with customers: understanding their business objectives, uncovering what success looks like for them, and designing the most effective path from migration through to full platform value on AWS.
20% creating campaigns and building thought leadership: developing strategic campaigns that generate net-new pipeline and establishing yourself as a trusted voice in your domain.
You will engage across the full transformation lifecycle:

Migrate: infrastructure landing and workload mobility
Modernise: application refactoring, containerisation, serverless adoption
Activate Data: analytics, lake formation, AI/ML readiness
Deploy Applications: GenAI, agentic workloads, intelligent automation
Your role is to find, build, and close opportunities across this lifecycle, always starting from the customer's desired outcomes and working backwards to the right solution.

Key job responsibilities
- Deeply understand customer business objectives, industry dynamics, and competitive pressures to identify where migration and modernisation can deliver the highest-impact outcomes.
- Generate and manage pipeline for AWS Migrations and Modernisations within defined verticals in the UK and Ireland, rooted in genuine customer need.
- Identify, qualify and close M&M deals from the largest, priority customers and targets in your verticals, positioning migration as the entry point to broader platform value that solves real business problems.
- Think Big: own the strategy to grow the migration and modernisation business in your territory. Design and execute campaigns, create new routes to market, and identify untapped customer segments or use cases that expand the addressable opportunity beyond today's pipeline.
- Drive thought leadership that tells the end-to-end transformation story: from migration through modernisation, data activation, and AI deployment. Create content, deliver keynotes, host executive roundtables, and build market awareness that positions AWS as the platform for customers building the company of the future.
- Develop and deliver executive-level narratives that start with the customer's challenges: cost pressure, speed to market, data-driven decision making, operational resilience, and map these to migration and modernisation outcomes.
- Build compelling commercial propositions that connect migration events with data modernisation, AI adoption, and agentic business transformation, always anchored to customer-defined success metrics.
- Position AI and GenAI as the outcome layer of migration: help customers see how moving to AWS unlocks access to services like Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, and partner AI technologies (e.g. Anthropic Claude) to drive competitive advantage post-migration.
- Own revenue targets across the full transformation lifecycle. Drive upsell and expansion by delivering on earlier promises and demonstrating measurable customer value at each stage.
- Work cross-functionally with Solutions Architects, Customer Success, Partner teams, Professional Services, and Product to inventory customers' existing software estates, build business cases for transformation, develop implementation plans, and close agreements.
- Build and execute co-sell motions with Global Systems Integrators (e.g. Accenture, Deloitte, TCS, Wipro) and strategic technology partners (e.g. Anthropic, Databricks) to bring joint migration-to-AI propositions to market and accelerate deal cycles.
- Leverage the AWS partner ecosystem to ensure customers get the right delivery support across large-scale migration and modernisation programmes.
- Respond to RFI/RFPs with differentiated, platform-level proposals that address what customers actually asked for, not generic capability decks.
- Maintain an accurate pipeline and forecast; deliver predictable revenue against quota.
- Act as the voice of the customer internally: feed customer insights back to product, engineering, and partner teams to improve the AWS migration and modernisation experience.
- Travel to customer sites across the UK and Ireland as needed

descriptionHtml:
The Amazon Dedicated Cloud (ADC) Serverless team is hiring a cleared Systems Development Engineer to join the team. This is an exciting opportunity to use the latest cloud computing technologies to help U.S. Government agencies implement innovative serverless and container solutions and solve technical problems at scale.

In this role, you will join a team of highly talented engineers that build and support AWS Lambda and container services (ECS, EKS, ECR, Fargate) in air-gapped cloud environments, as well as services and tooling to improve how we operate and deliver these platforms. This role enables you to deliver impact at scale: the work you do unlocks the latest in serverless and container capabilities for all of our US ADC customers.

A successful Systems Development Engineer on our team is focused on building services and tooling that enhance our operational posture and eliminate toil. They think about the scalability, availability, and operational readiness of what they create. They operate at the intersection of commercial service architecture and ADC partition constraints, balancing long-term design decisions against the urgency of customer delivery. They build automation that replaces manual processes, and they drive reliability improvements through software rather than procedure.

This position requires that the candidate selected must currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance. The position further requires that, after start, the selected candidate obtain and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph or commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work.

- Designing and building automation, tooling, and CI/CD pipelines that enable safe, continuous delivery of AWS Lambda and container services into isolated cloud environments

title: Data Center Chief Engineer Night Role
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic Data Center Engineering Operations Team and become a critical architect of the infrastructure that powers global cloud computing. You'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of Amazon Web Services' physical infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that support millions of customers worldwide.
The Data Center Chief Engineer (CE) is responsible for ensuring that all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center is operating at peak efficiency. This involves planned preventative maintenance of equipment, daily corrective work, and emergency response. The CE serves as an expert technical resource interacting with onsite Engineering Operations Technicians (EOT) and any third-party vendors. They are expected to be a singular focal point for all facility operations within a given data center and to support AWS.
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. カスタマーサービスのネットワークコントロールセンター（NCC）に参画いただくリアルタイムアナリストを募集しています。NCCは、Amazonカスタマーサービスの集中型インシデント管理機能です。お客様、アソシエイト、ドライバー、ブランドに影響を与える重大インシデントをリアルタイムで検知、管理、解決し、数十のクロスファンクショナルチームと連携して、お客様への影響を最小限に抑え、サービスを復旧させます。システムが大規模に障害を起こした時、コンタクト量が予測を超えて急増した時、またはサービス障害が数百万のお客様とのやり取りを脅かす時、NCCが指揮を執ります。

AI Toolは私たちの意思決定のスピードを加速させ、私たちを本当に重要な「判断」と「議論」に集中させることを可能にしています。Amazon では学習を継続する文化が根付いているため、ご自身のペースでAIに関する知識を深めることができるリソースが用意されています。

title: Sr. TPM - Satellite Integration & Test, Amazon Leo Technical Program Management
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable broadband connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From households to small businesses, schools, hospitals, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve communities and organizations operating in places without dependable internet access.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

We are seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager (TPM) to lead satellite assembly, integration, and test programs. In this role, you will drive satellite-level tests from planning through execution, including: qualification schedules and dependencies, hardware and software deliverables, test case development, test readiness reviews, mechanical GSE support, test rack support, and venue logistics coordination. You will influence test design while managing work streams across internal and external teams, proactively addressing risks to the critical path, removing roadblocks through stakeholder coordination and escalation, and tracking actions to closure.

This is an individual contributor role with broad organizational influence. Your technical domain knowledge, program management fundamentals, and trusted partnerships will enable you to drive organizational alignment and help teams deliver faster with higher quality.

This position requires direct technical experience developing and testing relevant systems. You will create and drive high-level strategic initiatives, but will also roll up your sleeves and contribute directly in test strategy and execution.

Key job responsibilities
* Drive complex cross-functional satellite tests from concept through vehicle-level qualification, managing initiatives that span multiple engineering disciplines (electrical, software, reliability, dynamics, thermal, test, mechanical, manufacturing) and directly impact Leo's satellite constellation deployment.
* Drive the critical path for vehicle qualification, working to define solutions that balance technical risk with business needs of the program office, production operations, and launch operations.
* Work with engineers to understand technical issues impeding the critical path in real time, pull in the correct stakeholders for resolution, escalate blockers, and synthesize information into data for leadership consumption (overall status, help needed, and critical path impacts).
* Develop integrated schedules, dependencies, risks, and tradeoffs in a high-speed, high-complexity, agile environment to deliver qualified hardware in time to meet business commitments.
* Apply understanding of concept of operations, system budgets, and lifecycle considerations for satellite tests and dependencies.
* Translate engineering concepts into executable plans (hardware and software), including new product introductions with DFM, manufacturing processes, test strategies, and automated test system development.
* Drive cross-team alignment on ownership, sequencing, and delivery while adapting quickly as conditions change, ensuring deliverables meet customer, mission and program requirements.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
- 5+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
- Experience in technical program management working directly with software engineering teams

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
- Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership
- Experience influencing senior leaders/stakeholders
- Experience leading engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
- Experience owning and driving large-scale cross-functional programs
- Experience with space hardware in a design or manufacturing environment
- Experience in test engineering or systems engineering
- High sense of ownership, urgency, and drive
- Proven ability to deal effectively with ambiguity while leading in a high-speed, agile environment.

title: ファシリティエンジニア - DCEO（データセンターエンジニアリング・オペレーションズ）, Data Center Engineering Operations (DCEO)
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services はすべての AWS グローバルインフラストラクチャの設計、計画、提供、運用を担当しています。私たちは、クラウドを稼働させ続ける人々です。すべての AWS データセンターとお客様がイノベーションに継続的にアクセスできるようにするすべてのサーバー、ストレージ、ネットワーク、電源、冷却設備をサポートしています。私たちはサプライチェーンに影響を与える数千もの要因を考慮しながら、最も困難な課題に取り組んでいます。そして私たちと共に支援したいと考える優秀な人材を探しています。

ソフトウェア、ハードウェア、ネットワークエンジニア、サプライチェーンスペシャリスト、セキュリティエキスパート、オペレーションマネージャー、その他の重要な役割を担う多様なチームに参加していただきます。AWS 全体の人々と協力して、お客様に最低コストで無限の容量を提供しながら、安全性とセキュリティの最高基準を提供できるよう支援していただきます。そして、大胆なアイデアを歓迎し、それを完成まで自分のものとして進める力を与える包括的な文化を体験していただけます。

Data Center Operationsチームは AWS のバックボーンであり、急速に成長する AWS ビジネスとお客様を 24 時間 365 日サポートしています。私たちは AWS の物理インフラストラクチャを維持し、安全性、セキュリティ、可用性、生産性、容量、効率性、コストの分野における運用パフォーマンスの基準を確保することに取り組んでいます。

Key job responsibilities
Facility Engineer - Data Center Engineering Operations (DCEO) の役割は、大規模で高密度のデータセンターにおいて、施設（電気/機械システム、制御/消火システムなど）の展開、運用、保守、および関連プロジェクトの管理を担当します。
日常業務では、以下の業務に携わります:
- 建物システムの点検と監視、および施設の問題のトラブルシューティング
- 運用効率の改善とエネルギー削減
- ベンダーやパートナーとの定期メンテナンスと修理の計画と実施。これには、ブレーカー操作、機械/電気設備操作などの重要な施設運用が含まれます
- 新規キャパシティ設置前の電気冷却容量の確認
- 新規データセンター建設および既存データセンター拡張の設計レビュー
- プロジェクトチームメンバーと協力して建設とテストをサポート

A day in the life
柔軟な勤務体制:

通常営業日は 9:00〜18:00 の間で実働 8 時間

勤務時間は、その日および週の業務に応じて相談・調整可能

通常勤務時間外のオンコール業務があり、全チームメンバーで週単位でローテーション

*注: ビジネス状況によっては、この役割でシフト勤務が必要になる場合があります。シフト勤務の詳細については、面接時に説明します。

About the team
チームについて

多様な経験

AWS は多様な経験を重視しています。職務内容に記載されているすべての資格やスキルを満たしていなくても、応募することをお勧めします。キャリアが始まったばかりの場合、従来の道を歩んでいない場合、または関連しない経験がある場合でも、応募をためらわないでください。

なぜ AWS なのか?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) は、世界で最も包括的で広く採用されているクラウドプラットフォームです。私たちはクラウドコンピューティングのパイオニアであり、イノベーションを止めることはありません。だからこそ、最も成功しているスタートアップから Global 500 企業まで、幅広いお客様が当社の堅牢な製品・サービスを信頼し、ビジネスを推進しています。

包括的なチーム文化

AWS では、学び、好奇心を持つことが私たちの本質です。従業員主導のアフィニティグループは、私たちが自分たちの違いを誇りに思える包括的な文化を育んでいます。Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) や AmazeCon (ジェンダーダイバーシティ) カンファレンスを含む継続的なイベントや学習体験は、私たちが独自性を受け入れることを決して止めないよう刺激を与えてくれます。

メンターシップとキャリア成長

私たちは、地球上で最高の雇用主になるために、継続的にパフォーマンスバーを引き上げています。だからこそ、ここには、より多角的な専門家に成長するのに役立つ、無限の知識共有、メンターシップ、その他のキャリア向上リソースがあります。

ワークライフバランス

私たちはワークライフハーモニーを重視しています。仕事での成功は、家庭での犠牲を伴うべきではありません。だからこそ、柔軟な勤務時間と勤務体制が私たちの文化の一部となっています。職場と家庭でサポートされていると感じるとき、クラウドで達成できないことは何もありません。

Basic qualifications

- ミッションクリティカルな設備の運用と保守に関する 2 年以上の関連実務経験（例: 24 時間稼働の工場、変電所、病院など）
- メンテナンス、変更管理、インシデント管理、ベンダー管理の経験または基本的な理解、およびポリシー、プロセス、手順を遵守して作業する方法
- 日本語（JLPT N2 相当）および英語（TOEIC 550 相当、または英語で日常業務を処理できるレベル）の両方における口頭および読み書き能力

Preferred qualifications

- データセンターに関連する資格（CDCP、CDCS、CDCE、ASHRAE など）、またはデータセンター管理のための資格（第二種または第三種電気主任技術者、エネルギー管理士、第 4 類危険物取扱者、冷凍機械責任者、第二種電気工事士）

- 電気システムに関する高度な理解力（変電所の電源供給システム、変圧器、スイッチギア、VFI クラス UPS、DRUPS、PDU、ATS、STS、SLA または VRLA バッテリーおよび関連システム、ディーゼル/ガスタービン発電機に関連する燃料システム、サージ制御回路、アクティブ高調波フィルター、バッテリー監視システム、分岐回路監視システム、SCADA システム）
- 機械システムに関する高度な理解力（CRAC/CRAH、AHU、チラー、冷却塔、貯蔵タンク、熱交換器、配管システム、ポンプ、バルブ、ダクトシステム、ファン、ダンパー、火災検知・消火システム、排水システム、ビル監視システム、自動制御システム）

title: Business Development, Mission Innovation, Public Sector (UK, Germany and International Organisations)
descriptionHtml:
Governments, defence organisations, healthcare and education providers are all facing seemingly impossible challenges - and the cloud and AI are how they'll solve them. AWS is looking for a Mission Innovation lead for the UK, Germany and International Organisations (UKGI) public sector team. Someone who can connect what is technically possible to the mission outcomes that matter most. Based in the UK, you'll create strategic customer relationships, win the trust of the most senior decision makers, and show them how the cloud and AI can bring clarity where strategy is still taking shape. Revenue growth and mission impact are treated as one goal, earned through disciplined customer engagement not through transactional selling.

This is a new role for UKGI, and success starts with customer obsession. You need to work backwards to understand constitutes mission success for our customers, and then build the path from that vision to execution so they can solve their hardest problems. Trust is earned daily through consistent, high-value engagement, and it is measured honestly: every critical relationship is assessed regularly for whether it advanced, held steady, went quiet, or cooled, with a deliberate plan to move each one forward.

The role also demands invention on behalf of the customer. You will build evidence-based adoption narratives for our customers, grounded in efficiencies, cost savings, and mission successes that were achieved with other customers, public sector or not. You will show customers that if they bring their silos together in the cloud, they can unlock new capability that seemed impossible before. Prototypes are built quickly, shown early, and refined through customer feedback, producing a growing set of proof points. Adoption narratives span all levels of sensitivity, adding service accreditation, hardening, and additional assurance requirements when needed.

Customers should experience AWS as a quiet enabler that has placed capacity, compute, silicon, infrastructure, and power in the right place for the mission. You help them unlock that and shape opportunities where none formally existed.

Key job responsibilities
- Partner with our public sector customers to define mission success and apply our working backwards methodology to reach it.
- Build and iterate rapid prototypes that demonstrate value, capturing outcomes into a reusable set of proof points.
- Develop evidence-based adoption narratives, taking them from the commercial world and translating them for public sector at every level of sensitivity, adding security hardening as required.
- Map the decision makers who hold influence within key accounts, alongside understanding the formal and informal power structures that surround them.
- Identify and cultivate key influencers, enabling wider account teams to work through them to reach the decision makers for the whole public sector.
- Facilitate government-to-government and private-sector-to-government conversations, including cross-border engagement, that surface tradecraft and technical expertise in a way that is organic for the customer.
- Build and own a portfolio of strategic relationships, honestly grading the health and momentum of each account.
- Increase cloud utilisation of existing workloads by uncovering opportunities to improve data workflows, achieve cost efficiencies, and deploy new applications of generative and agentic AI.
- Contribute repeatable mechanisms that help account teams drive new workload migrations from on-premises environments and competitor platforms.
- Share thought leadership across the broader UKGI community, through white papers and on-stage presentations, on new and innovative ways to deliver mission outcomes.
- Support hackathons that accelerate external adoption of agentic AI and emerging technologies while extracting repeatable insights that sharpen account team strategy.

A day in the life
A typical week blends customer time with internal research and collaboration, though customer time always comes first. Mornings might open with a pipeline review that identifies the key touchpoints needed to keep priority accounts progressing. Midday could bring an executive briefing where you use a working prototype to turn an abstract mission requirement into something a decision maker can see and react to. Afternoons could shift to enablement, translating a hard-won migration pattern into a repeatable approach that other account teams can reuse. Travel is frequent, because presence with the customer is where trust is built and how momentum is sustained.

About the team
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating - that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Our public sector team is driven by a simple belief: the organisations that serve citizens deserve world-class technology and guidance to deliver on their missions. We dive deep to understand each customer's goals, bring clarity to complexity, and celebrate the diverse perspectives that make our solutions stronger. We're curious, customer obsessed, and proud of the difference our work can make.

Basic qualifications

- Experience developing strategies that influence leadership decisions at the organizational level
- Experience working with Advanced Compute technologies including, but not limited to: Accelerated Compute, High Performance Compute, Visual/Spatial Compute, and/or IoT.
- Experience working with Data & AI related technologies, including, but not limited to, AI/ML, GenAI, Analytics, Database, and/or Storage
- A UK national and able to obtain and maintain a UK Government Security Clearance
- Thought leadership through speaking, writing, or hosting technical events such as hackathons.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working with Enterprise Application Modernization and Migration technologies, including, but not limited to, Mainframe, Serverless, Containers, or Cloud Operations
- Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud
- Experience in industry work in a related environment
- Experience contributing to repeatable go-to-market mechanisms that scale across account teams.

title: Electrical Field Engineer, IAD North Field Engineering
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

As an Amazon Critical Infrastructure Engineer, you will provide full life-cycle support to AWS Data Centers from design inception through site improvement and maintenance. You will be the ‘go to’ engineering resource for your region when technical advice is needed, and will use your subject matter expertise and engage with diverse teams to:
• Troubleshoot, conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and create Corrective Action (CA) documentation for site/equipment failures.
• Directly support operational issues with ad-hoc training, complex operating procedure reviews, including critical equipment, and event support.
• Own the conceptual design for existing data center upgrades and design-solutions, which add capacity, improve availability, increase efficiency and sustainability.
• Interface with internal data center operations team, data center design engineering team, server hardware team, environmental health and safety team to promote standards that maintain consistency and reliability in services delivered.
• Develop innovative solutions for AWS’s data centers.
• Work on concurrent projects, sometimes in multiple geographical regions.
• Initiate and lead engineering audits including on-site visits within Amazon’s data centers. Produce reports outlining risks with recommended mitigations and remediations.
• Act as resident engineer during new construction projects. Support construction, commissioning, and turnover.

Key job responsibilities
Amazon's vision is to be the world's most customer-centric company, and this role is key to that vision. As an Amazon Critical Infrastructure Engineer, you will be leading projects to fit out our data centers to meet ever-evolving customer needs as we continue expanding our fleet to hyper-scale. As an ideal candidate you:
• Possess Strong Engineering Judgement and are able to provide recommendations despite uncertainty/ambiguity.
• Are detail and data oriented.
• Have experience solving problems with engineered solutions.
• Have experience managing engineering projects and consultants.
• Build trust and relationships with different stakeholders (e.g., Operations, Controls, Construction, Design, Commissioning, Product Managers, Technical Program Managers,).
• Are adaptable and inclined to get into the field to see things up close.
• Excited about a mix of office and field work.


A day in the life
Each day you will interact with different teams responsible for all aspects of the data centers. You will prioritize your activities to support data center capacity availability and safety focusing on the actions that are most impactful. You will have the opportunity to work on projects locally and globally.

If you meet these qualifications, exude passion, and enjoy the challenge of innovative projects at hyper-scale, this job is for you!

title: Program Specialist, Network Control Center, Network Control Center
descriptionHtml:
Customer experience is at the heart of all we do at Amazon, as we strive to be Earth's most customer-centric company. Amazon Customer Service (CS) is at the forefront of customer experience, working relentlessly to provide customers a convenient, high quality, and delightful experience — across all of our CS channels — in every interaction.

Within CS, Network Solutions is responsible for designing, planning, and operating the world's largest customer service network — building intelligent, adaptive systems that anticipate demand, match customers to optimal experiences, and continuously improve service quality. We are transforming CS from a manually operated, reactive model into an AI-native ecosystem that makes CS a growth driver and competitive advantage for Amazon.


We are seeking a Program Specialist to join the Network Control Center (NCC), Amazon's central incident management function for Customer Service. When systems fail at scale, contact volumes spike unexpectedly, or a service disruption threatens millions of customer interactions, the NCC takes command. You will be at the center of that response — running incidents end-to-end, driving cross-functional coordination under pressure, and ensuring leadership has the information they need to make decisions fast.

At Amazon, you'll work alongside the latest AI and GenAI tools that are increasingly woven into how teams operate: from AI-powered capabilities that accelerate decision-making, to Generative AI that helps you focus on work that truly matters. You'll have opportunities and resources to develop AI fluency at your own pace, with continuous learning built into the culture.

title: Risk Manager II, TSI SCI & Res-Q
descriptionHtml:
Millions of Selling Partners trust Amazon's marketplace to grow their businesses, and hundreds of millions of customers depend on us every day. Behind that trust is a network of systems, tools, and workflows designed to detect and resolve fraud and abuse at scale — and our team builds them.
We are looking for a Risk Manager II who will drive end-to-end program execution for risk reduction initiatives across TSI SCI and Res-Q. In this role, you will own cross-functional program delivery — building roadmaps, aligning stakeholders, managing dependencies, and driving process automation to eliminate defects and improve operational efficiency at scale.
You will partner with engineering, science, operations, legal, and policy teams to define program scope, manage trade-offs, and deliver measurable outcomes. You'll own root cause and preventive action (RC/PA) for systemic defects, drive process automation initiatives that reduce manual investigation effort, and ensure programs are delivered on time, at quality, and with measurable impact.
This role offers the opportunity to shape how Amazon protects seller and customer trust by combining structured program management with process automation expertise that fundamentally improves how our organization operates.

Key job responsibilities
• Own end-to-end program management for risk reduction initiatives — defining scope, building roadmaps, tracking milestones, managing dependencies, and driving delivery across engineering, science, operations, legal, and policy teams.
• Drive cross-functional alignment across Risk Managers, Operations, Science, Legal, and Policy stakeholders to define program scope, prioritize features, and manage trade-offs — with defect elimination and operational efficiency as the primary lens.
• Identify, design, and implement process automation opportunities that reduce manual investigation effort, eliminate repetitive workflows, and improve investigator productivity — partnering with engineering teams to translate operational pain points into automation solutions.
• Own root cause / preventive action (RC/PA) for systemic defects — when defect pattern analysis reveals recurring failure modes, document root cause findings, define preventive actions with measurable closure criteria, and track implementation through to validated defect elimination.
• Build and manage program roadmaps for automation and process improvement launches, tracking dependencies, identifying risks, and driving escalation management across multi-team initiatives.
• Conduct defect pattern analysis to identify systemic abuse trends, process gaps, and opportunities for automation coverage expansion — translating findings into prioritized program requirements.
• Lead escalation triage for program-impacted workflows — rapidly diagnosing whether issues stem from process gaps, system failures, or policy misalignment, and routing to the appropriate team with clear severity assessment and remediation path.
• Define and instrument success metrics to measure program impact, automation coverage, defect escape rates, process cycle time reduction, and seller experience improvement.
• Drive process improvement initiatives using structured methodologies (DMAIC, Kaizen, or equivalent) mapping current-state workflows, identifying waste and bottlenecks, and implementing scalable solutions.
• Manage stakeholder communication and program governance - preparing and presenting program updates, launch readiness reviews, and impact assessments to senior leadership, quantifying the value of risk reduction investments.
• Own change management for new process launches and automation deployments — ensuring smooth adoption across operations teams through documentation, training, and feedback loops.
• Conduct deep dives into escalation data, process metrics, and system gaps to identify launch blockers and ensure seamless program implementation.

A day in the life
You'll start your day reviewing program dashboards and defect metrics — checking milestone progress, flagging blockers, and identifying where process automation can reduce manual effort. You'll meet with investigators and Risk Managers to understand which workflows are creating friction and translate those insights into program requirements.
You'll drive sprint planning and stakeholder alignment meetings — prioritizing initiatives by defect elimination impact and operational efficiency gains. You'll analyze escalation data to spot systemic issues that process automation should solve, and work with operations leaders to validate that deployed solutions are actually reducing investigation workload.
Your week includes cross-functional program reviews with Science, Legal, Operations and Policy, launch readiness assessments, RC/PA deep dives on systemic defects, process mapping workshops for automation opportunities, and presenting program progress at WBRs and MBRs.

About the team
The Res-Q team operates as the central command for abuse-related escalations, conducting investigations and driving systemic improvements across Amazon's global stores. Through our various intake channels, we handle the most complex and sensitive cases that require expert judgment and cross-functional coordination.

- 5+ years of program or project management experience
- 2+ years of experience in risk management, trust & safety, fraud prevention, or marketplace integrity domains
- Experience driving process automation or process improvement initiatives that delivered measurable operational efficiency gains
- Experience managing programs across technical and non-technical teams with competing priorities
- Strong analytical skills and data-driven decision making
- Experience with defect analysis, root cause investigation, and structured problem-solving methodologies
- Experience writing program requirements, process documentation, and stakeholder communications
- Demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent programs with interdependencies

Preferred qualifications

- Experience launching automation solutions that directly reduced operational defect rates or manual investigation workload
- Strong written and verbal communication skills to influence technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership

title: Risk Specialist II, Whole Foods Market, Product Safety Assurance, Worldwide Grocery Stores (WWGS)
descriptionHtml:
Collaborate with Food Safety Quality Assurance Specialists, Product Developers, Nutrition Compliance Analysts, Private Brands (PB) Merchandising Team, EB Sourcing, adjacent technical teams, and Suppliers. Lead the development and maintenance of product safety specifications and associated requirements for assigned food products sold by WWGSS under Private Brands across higher-complexity product categories such as: Baby Food, Body Care, Produce, Meat, Seafood, Household Cleaning, Pet Food, Prepared Foods, Over the Counter drugs (OTCs), and/or Dietary Supplements. This includes reviewing specifications and testing results to ensure consistent product safety for our customers.

Contribute to commercialization activities by providing technical expertise to help ensure products will meet WWGS PB, safety, regulatory and Quality Standards.


Key job responsibilities
· Develop appropriate chemical, microbiological, physical, and shelf-life test requirements for products based on supplier data, existing testing profiles, all applicable regulatory requirements, food safety, or product safety risk, and all WWGS specific requirements.
· Review applicable product claims and statements and determine criteria for claim validation.
· Partner with Product Developers to incorporate characterizing product attributes into the testing profile.
· Review Supplier Quality Reports and Facility Risk Assessments to determine appropriate risk of product and facility and adjust specification or verification plans accordingly.
· Review Supplier documents and test results to ensure adherence to WWGS PB and regulatory standards, and adherence to agreed WWGS testing profiles.
· Partner with WWGS legal team and cross-functional stakeholders to determine product testing needs to meet state, federal, and international regulatory requirements. Present findings, recommendations, and project decisions to leaders up to 3 tiers above level, as needed.
· Review and approve shelf-life study validation parameters with Suppliers for new and existing products.
Work with external labs and other quality teams to perform regular product quality reviews and end-of-shelf-life reviews to ensure compliance with WWGS standards and regulatory requirements.
· Partner with appropriate stakeholders as needed to determine product performance acceptability and CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action) plans for out of specification test results.
· Monitor existing product test results for compliance with ongoing periodic testing per the agreed testing profiles.
· Collaborate with relevant stakeholders on interpretation of data trends, product improvement activities, and test results, as needed.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives across product safety programs, including optimizing testing workflows, supplier communication protocols, and specification development processes. Ensure products meet WWGS PB Safety and Quality Standards, and regulatory requirements, throughout the product lifecycle.
· Act as a mentor and technical resource to other Product Safety Assurance analysts and other EB stakeholders as needed.
· Monitor relevant industry and regulatory trends and changes.
· Assist PSA Leadership with short- and long-term strategies, initiatives, and goals.
· Identify and define key performance indicators (KPIs) for assigned product safety programs. Determine if success metrics are in place for testing profiles, supplier compliance, and risk mitigation activities, and if not, work to define them.
· Negotiate and define product safety program controls applicable to cross-functional partner teams.
· Help partner teams make trade-offs by educating them on the current risk and regulatory environment, recommending a variety of risk-mitigation solutions as appropriate.
· Help recruit and interview for the Product Safety Assurance team, including participating in the hiring process and helping train new members of the team.

Basic qualifications

- Experience managing multiple projects, prioritizing, planning, and managing time
- B.S. degree in Food Science, Microbiology, Chemistry, or related field OR equivalent combination of education and relevant experience. Graduate degree in science or related field preferred.
- 4 to 6 years’ relevant experience in consumer packaged goods (CPG), including manufacturing-site experience, OR equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
- Experience with at least 3 of the following higher-complexity product categories: Baby Food, Body Care, Household Cleaning, Pet Food, OTCs, Produce, Meat, Seafood, Prepared Foods, and/or Dietary Supplements.
- Experience explaining and negotiating specifications and testing requirements with suppliers while upholding quality and safety standards.
- Experience working in a food and/or non-food quality control or assurance department, including familiarity with product safety risk assessment, regulatory compliance (state, federal, and international), and specification development.
- Ability to work effectively on a cross-functional team in a highly dynamic environment as well as independently with little to no supervision.
- Ability to make decisions or judgments independently and know when to seek subject matter expert opinion.
- Ability to travel domestically up to 20% of time; minimal international travel expectations.
- Ability to have fun and enable others to have fun while achieving results.
- Preventive Controls Qualified Individual (PCQI) Certification and Hazard Analysis Critical Control Point (HACCP) Certification.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with natural and organic foods
- Global Food Safety Initiative (GFSI) or other quality and product safety auditing systems experience
- Sensory evaluation experience and skills
- Experience using specification databases and/or product lifecycle management systems
- Experience with production facility auditing
