title: Program Manager, LMT Reverse Logistics
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Logistics (AMZL) Japan is seeking a Program Manager to own quality assurance and operational expansion of our Merchant Fulfilled Network (MFN) pickup program. This is a highly operational role — you will be closely embedded in day-to-day MFN pickup operations across Delivery Stations and seller sites, developing a thorough, hands-on understanding of how the seller-to-FC package flow functions end-to-end.

In this role, you will track program quality from seller injection through DS handling and middle-mile transit, identify failure modes, and build the operational improvements needed to meet expansion readiness standards. You will work closely with the Program Lead to ensure quality gates are cleared at each expansion phase, and collaborate with local ACES teams and DS operations to deploy standard work on the ground.

As part of the Last Mile Tech (LMT) organization, this role serves as the connection between Japan's day-to-day MFN operations and global technology and product organizations, ensuring solutions are properly scoped, implemented, and optimized for the Japan market.

At Amazon, you'll work alongside the latest AI and GenAI tools that are increasingly woven into how teams operate: from AI-powered capabilities that accelerate decision-making, to Generative AI that helps you focus on work that truly matters. You'll have opportunities and resources to develop AI fluency at your own pace, with continuous learning built into the culture.




Key job responsibilities
- Conduct operational analysis across the full MFN pickup flow — from seller package handoff through DS injection, middle-mile transit, and deliver to customer to identify quality gaps, failure patterns, and process inefficiencies across the AMZL Japan network.
- Develop improvement plans based on field observations and data insights, and work with the Program Lead to validate that quality standards are met before each phase of DS network expansion.
- Partner with ACES teams and DS operations to deploy standard work, training materials, and operational procedures on the ground, ensuring consistent execution as the program scales to new sites.
- Own seller-facing quality tracking — monitoring injection compliance rates, SLAM label accuracy, and pickup window adherence — and develop corrective action plans for sellers or sites falling below quality thresholds.
- Analyze operational datasets to monitor key performance indicators including pickup success rate, injection cutoff compliance, and transit time by DS node, conducting root cause analysis on failures and escalating risks and opportunities to the Program Lead.
- Support end-to-end program execution for MFN pickup expansion milestones, including site readiness checklists, quality gates, and contingency plans to ensure each new DS node launches reliably.
- Coordinate with Delivery Stations, Sort Centers, Fulfillment Centers, and global product teams to align on operational requirements and represent Japan-specific needs in worldwide forums.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams experience
- 3+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
- Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
- Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Speak, write, and read fluently in Japanese

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
- 3+ years of driving process improvements experience
- Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
- Experience building processes, project management, and schedules

You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. Amazon Music is an immersive audio entertainment service that deepens connections between fans, artists, and creators. From personalized music playlists to exclusive podcasts, concert livestreams to artist merch, Amazon Music is innovating at some of the most exciting intersections of music and culture. We offer experiences that serve all listeners with our different tiers of service: Prime members get access to all the music in shuffle mode, and top ad-free podcasts, included with their membership; customers can upgrade to Amazon Music Unlimited for unlimited, on-demand access to 100 million songs, including millions in HD, Ultra HD, and spatial audio; and anyone can listen for free by downloading the Amazon Music app or via Alexa-enabled devices. Join us for the opportunity to influence how Amazon Music engages fans, artists, and creators on a global scale. Learn more at https://www.amazon.com/music.

The Music Catalog Quality team at Amazon Music serves a key role in developing solutions to ensure and improve the quality of catalog metadata and content across the music streaming experience. We create solutions that detect, measure, and remediate quality issues in music metadata - including artist information, track attributes, versions, content tags, and provide actionable insights that enable continuous improvement of the catalog. We leverage a host of scientific and engineering technologies to accomplish this mission, including Generative AI, classical ML, Natural Language Processing, Computer Vision, and automated data validation pipelines.

Key job responsibilities
As an Applied Scientist, you will own the design and development of end-to-end systems. You’ll have the opportunity to create technical roadmaps, and drive production level projects that will support Amazon Science. You will work closely with Amazon scientists, and other science interns to develop solutions and deploy them into production. The ideal scientist must have the ability to work with diverse groups of people and cross-functional teams to solve complex business problems. Other responsibilities include:

- Collaborate with scientists, engineers, and product managers to define and frame business problems as ML or optimization tasks.
- Use machine learning, deep learning, LLMs and Agentic AI techniques to create scalable solutions for business problems
- Analyze and extract relevant information from large amounts of Amazon's data to help automate and optimize key processes
- Design, development and evaluation of AI models for predictive learning
- Research and implement novel machine learning and statistical approaches
- Implement scalable data pipelines and model-serving systems.
- Analyze experimental results, draw insights, and refine models to improve accuracy and robustness.
- Communicate findings and recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of building models for business application experience
- PhD, or Master's degree and 4+ years of CS, CE, ML or related field experience
- Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
- Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing

Preferred qualifications

- Experience using Unix/Linux
- PhD in computer science, machine learning, engineering, or related fields

title: Kierownik Obszaru /  Kierownik Logistyki / Kierownik Magazynu - Area Manager
descriptionHtml:
Lokalizacja: Dobromierz (woj. dolnośląskie)

Dział operacyjny to serce firmy Amazon. Ten kluczowy segment naszej działalności zapewnia, że realizujemy i wysyłamy zamówienia w sposób efektywny, dzięki czemu nasi klienci otrzymują swoje zakupy na czas. Osoba na stanowisku Area Manager dokłada wszelkich starań, aby centrum logistyczne, w którym pracuje działało sprawnie, co pozwala nam wychodzić naprzeciw oczekiwaniom klientów. Kieruje zespołem, który troszczy się o zachowanie bezpieczeństwa, wydajności i wysokiej jakości naszych działań, a także podejmuje się realizacji wielu projektów w całej naszej sieci, mających na celu zwiększenie wydajności.

Key job responsibilities
- Tworzenie, nadzorowanie i promowanie kultury bezpieczeństwa i zadowolenia z pracy
- Analizowanie i wdrażanie modyfikacji w celu zapewnienia jakości i wydajności na stałym, wysokim poziomie
- Nadzorowanie projektów mających na celu usprawnienie procesów, optymalizację wydajności i podniesienie jakości usług dla klientów w obrębie swojego obszaru odpowiedzialności
- Analizowanie wydajności zmiany w stosunku do stosownych celów biznesowych i wprowadzanie działań mających na celu osiągnięcie doskonałości operacyjnej
- Współpraca z innymi managerami w celu standaryzacji procesów na zmianach

A day in the life


Osoba na tym stanowisku pracuje w systemie zmianowym w jednym z naszych centrów logistycznych, zapewniając jego najwyższą możliwą wydajność. Głównym zadaniem Area Managera jest kierowanie i napędzanie kultury bezpieczeństwa oraz utrzymywanie jakości i standardów wydajności na zmianach. Area Manager nadzoruje również usprawnienia procesów w swoim obszarze i napędza ich wdrażanie. Typowy dzień jest tutaj niezwykle zróżnicowany i obejmuje rozmaite czynności, od rutynowego zarządzania zespołem i codziennych obowiązków operacyjnych, po doskonalenie procesów i szeroko zakrojone zadania operacyjne w sytuacjach awaryjnych. Osoba ta jest również mentorem dla nowych managerów.

About the team
Nowe centrum logistyczne Amazon w Dobromierzu (woj. dolnośląskie, okolice Wrocławia) to jedna z najnowszych i najbardziej zaawansowanych inwestycji w naszej europejskiej sieci operacyjnej. Obiekt o powierzchni ok. 200 000 m² został zaprojektowany z myślą o maksymalnej efektywności operacyjnej oraz komforcie i bezpieczeństwie pracy.

W codziennych operacjach pracowników wspiera ponad 5000 robotów oraz nowoczesne systemy automatyzacji, które usprawniają procesy kompletowania i wysyłki zamówień. Centrum będzie odgrywać kluczową rolę w obsłudze klientów w regionie, zapewniając szybkie i niezawodne dostawy.

To także miejsce budowania kompetencji przyszłości – zarówno w obszarze operacji, jak i technologii – w dynamicznym, międzynarodowym środowisku.

Centrum logistyczne to miejsce, w którym firma Amazon stawiała swoje pierwsze kroki. Ze skromnego zespołu sprzedawców książek przekształciło się ono w wysokorozwiniętą korporację o zasięgu ogólnoświatowym, która każdego dnia obsługuje ponad 1,5 miliona zamówień. Osoby pracujące w centrach logistycznych stanowią fundament naszej działalności, a ich wysiłki pomagają nam w ekspansji naszej firmy na nowe rejony oraz w rozszerzeniu wachlarza świadczonych przez nas usług. Korzystając z najnowszych technologii, stale poszukujemy sposobów na zwiększenie i udoskonalenie gamy oferowanych przez nas produktów – dostarczanych szybko i tanio.

Nasze zespoły w centrach logistycznych są pierwszym ogniwem w łańcuchu dostaw przyczyniającym się do realizacji zamówień klientów w tempie, z którego tak słyniemy. Pracujemy w centrach logistycznych, które stanowią serce prężnej sieci operacyjnej firmy Amazon i określane są niekiedy jako „pierwszy kilometr”, ponieważ to właśnie tutaj większość przesyłek rozpoczyna swoją podróż. Pomagamy również zarządzać dynamicznie zmieniającymi się składami magazynowymi i umożliwiamy realizację szybkich dostaw 24 godziny na dobę.
W naszych centrach logistycznych pracuje wiele różnych osób, bo oferujemy perspektywy dla osób o każdym poziomie umiejętności i wykształcenia. Niektórzy z nas zajmują się bezpośrednio towarami, inni analizują dane, pomagając wszystkim w firmie w podejmowaniu trafnych decyzji.

Minimalne wynagrodzenie zasadnicze dla tego stanowiska jest wskazane poniżej. Amazon zastrzega sobie możliwość zaproponowania wyższej wartości wynagrodzenia zasadniczego, w zależności od posiadanych umiejętności, kompetencji i doświadczenia kandydata. Amazon kieruje się zasadą całkowitego wynagrodzenia, w związku z czym oprócz wynagrodzenia zasadniczego mogą być przewidziane dodatkowe składniki wynagrodzenia, takie jak premia rekrutacyjna oraz możliwość uczestnictwa w programie akcji zastrzeżonych (RSU) prowadzonym niezależnie przez Amazon.com Inc. w USA. Zespół rekrutacyjny poinformuje Cię o ostatecznej kwocie wynagrodzenia zasadniczego oraz o wszystkich przysługujących dodatkowych składnikach wynagrodzenia, w zależności od umiejętności i wymagań.Dodatkowe świadczenia przysługują na warunkach obowiązujących w Spółce i obejmują m.in. plany emerytalne, dodatkowe ubezpieczenie zdrowotne, dodatkowe ubezpieczenie na życie, ubezpieczenie podróży służbowych, kartę MultiSport, dofinasowanie do posiłków w stołówce firmowej, kod rabatowy dla pracowników i program zniżek pracowniczych (EDC/Extras) oraz Program Wsparcia Pracownika (EAP – prywatne i poufne doradztwo i wsparcie).Minimalne wynagrodzenie zasadnicze dla tego stanowiska wynosi 9,683 PLN miesięcznie.

Basic qualifications

- Wykształcenie wyższe
- Wcześniejsze doświadczenie w kierowaniu zespołem
- Wcześniejsze doświadczenie w komunikacji z szerokim gronem partnerów biznesowych, w tym ze współpracownikami i z przełożonymi
- Umiejętność wykorzystywania danych analitycznych i empirycznych do podejmowania decyzji i rozwiązywania problemów
- Biegła znajomość języka angielskiego i polskiego w mowie i piśmie

title: Engineering Program Manager, NA Field Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Application deadline: Nov 7, 2026

Amazon is seeking an Engineering Program Manager to support the Amazon Logistics North America (AMZL NA) Engineering team, part of Amazon's Last Mile organization. The Last Mile team helps get customer packages from delivery stations to a customer's doorstep.

This is a unique opportunity to own high-impact engineering programs and mechanisms that advance the intelligence and reliability of our last mile business. We are looking for an individual who has experience creating scalable, data-driven solutions to complex reliability and engineering problems. In this role, you will be responsible for driving engineering program governance, compliance reporting, data analytics, and documentation systems that enable leadership visibility, cross-functional alignment, and operational excellence across a portfolio of automation and electrical infrastructure projects.

You will build and maintain the mechanisms that keep our engineering organization running at the highest standard—from automated dashboards and compliance reporting to documentation platforms and stakeholder coordination. You will partner with field engineers, electrical contractors, supply chain teams, and operations leaders to deliver scalable processes that reduce rework, improve quality, and accelerate project delivery.

Key competencies of this position include insisting on the highest standards in root cause quality and corrective action effectiveness; analyzing and deep diving systems performance; inventing and simplifying solutions that improve installation and operational processes; and providing technical expertise to internal customers and stakeholders.

Key job responsibilities
• Design and maintain automated reporting pipelines and performance dashboards (e.g., equipment health trends, failure rates, system uptime) that provide leadership with real-time visibility into program health and enable data-driven decisions

• Translate complex data sets into clear narratives and actionable recommendations for stakeholders at all levels, supporting weekly business reviews and program prioritization

• Build and maintain AI-powered compliance tools that aggregate multi-source data (invoices, training records, action items) into consolidated weekly leadership reports

• Manage multiple concurrent engineering projects (electrical, automation, MHE) across the NA delivery station network, coordinating timelines and deliverables with external contractors

• Track project milestones and completion metrics; identify process gaps through root cause analysis and implement corrective actions that reduce rework and accelerate project delivery

• Own weekly organizational compliance reporting on a strict cadence; monitor metrics including training completion, invoice accuracy, and Correction of Error action item closure

• Administer engineering documentation platforms and develop SOPs that standardize processes across the network; drive document governance including version control, review cycles, and user enablement

• Collaborate cross-functionally with Supply Chain, Startup Execution, Operations, RME, and external contractors; facilitate status meetings and manage escalations from field engineers through senior leadership

A day in the life
No two days look alike in this role. You will move fluidly between analyzing performance data and building dashboards, facilitating cross-functional alignment meetings, and designing scalable process improvements that eliminate rework across the network. You balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution—architecting a new reporting mechanism one hour and removing barriers for field teams the next. You thrive in ambiguity, take ownership of problems before they are assigned, and find energy in the variety of challenges that come with supporting and driving measurable impact across a fast-moving engineering organization operating at Amazon scale.

About the team
Our diverse team of engineers and program managers owns the full lifecycle, from firm engineering through project execution to final customer hand-off. We are customer-obsessed, data-driven, and never satisfied with the status quo. We capture lessons learned, incorporate them into our mechanisms, and raise the quality bar with each iteration. Our approach to growth is holistic—we continually learn, develop, and expand expertise across the organization, leveraging subject matter knowledge on a global scale. Collaboration is at our core; we are a true team that supports, challenges, and leverages each other's strengths to deliver on the Customer Promise every day.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in engineering, management, or technology
- Experience leading cross-functional teams across engineering, operations, and field execution through launch readiness and go-live phases
- 3+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
- Experience with Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
- Experience developing and managing recruiting reports, dashboards, and metrics
- Experience managing multiple projects and priorities across teams in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
- Experience in written and verbal communication with the ability to present complex technical information in a clear and concise manner to executives and non-technical leaders

Preferred qualifications

- Experience building launch readiness frameworks, standard work, playbooks, and scalable deployment mechanisms across multiple concurrent sites
- Experience with automation and any version control tools, or experience managing full application stacks from the OS up through custom applications and experience in Database like NoSQL
- Master's degree or above in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, or 3+ years of in material handling equipment (MHE) or automation environments experience
- Experience reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings, or experience developing MOPs and SWMS for planned works
- Project Management Professional (PMP) or equivalent certification

descriptionHtml:
You are applying to our Talent Pool for Operations Internships starting from January 2027 onwards. By applying early, you benefit from:

- Greater scheduling flexibility during the interview process
- Advance placement ahead of peak hiring season

Amazon Operations is the backbone of the Amazon customer experience. With over 50 fulfilment centres, hundreds of delivery stations, and tens of thousands of employees, the team works together to efficiently deliver items to customers. In the fulfilment centres, millions of items are picked and packed annually, while delivery teams work to get orders to customers on time. Safety is the top priority, and the operations culture is defined by teamwork, diversity, and a shared work ethic that keeps the business running smoothly. The team takes pride in delivering the quality service Amazon is known for globally.


Note: You must have the right to work in the country of employment by the start date.

Key job responsibilities
As an Amazon operations intern, you'll have the opportunity to apply your analytical skills to impactful projects that enhance the functionality and service of Fulfillment Centers, Sortation Centers, and Delivery Stations. Key aspects of the role include:

- Completing high-priority projects to the highest standard, demonstrating your ability to deliver results
- Analyzing data to identify operational challenges and opportunities for improvement
- Proposing and testing solutions, collaborating with the team to implement the most effective ones
- Developing communication and teamwork skills by working with managers, stakeholders, and frontline associates.
- Be on the move within the building to engage with various teams. This includes actively gathering knowledge by participating in activities such as pre-briefs, flow meetings, and discussions with the leadership team and associates.
- Ability to navigate the workspace and move between different areas is essential for this position.

This internship will place you at the heart of our operations, enabling you to trace the journey of a customer order. You'll gain a realistic job preview of the full-time opportunities awaiting you within our organization.

You'll learn how our managers cultivate a safe, productive environment, harnessing the full potential of their teams through effective engagement and performance management strategies. This is your chance to develop skills that will propel you towards a rewarding career with Amazon.

title: Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:
Job summary
Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Operations Manager. In this role, you will lead and develop a team of salaried and hourly talent. You will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. To achieve this, managers are expected to provide their team with the tools needed for success while driving improvements in productivity and efficiency through data-driven decisions and analytical problem-solving. You will also play a key role in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.

Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. Please note that all workflows have slight building variations, but one thing is constant: our vision and dedication to the customer.

- Collaborate with all support teams including Safety, Engineering, Loss Prevention, Quality Assurance, Human Resources to develop plans to meet business objectives
- Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
- Work in an environment where the noise level varies and can be loud
- Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)

Our fulfillment network launches new Operations sites every year, providing various opportunities for your professional growth. We hire Operations Managers based on location preference and the business’ current openings.

- Experience managing a team of 2+ salaried employees and 70+ indirect employees

title: Cloud HW engineer, SI/PI, Network Product Development - Optics
descriptionHtml:
Do you like to use electrical and computer engineering to deliver simple, sustainable, and repeatable solutions? Would you like to play a key role in driving the stability and sustainability of next-generation networks?

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. descriptionHtml:

In this role, you'll design highly resilient, secure AWS architectures that power core banking modernization, real-time payments infrastructure, and mission-critical financial workloads at global scale.

You'll work at the intersection of engineering and financial services, translating complex regulatory and business challenges into elegant cloud solutions that span high-availability transaction processing, data-intensive risk and fraud detection systems, and generative AI experiences that transform how customers manage their financial lives. We're looking for strategic thinkers who excel in ambiguity, communicate with clarity across technical and business stakeholders, and are energized by mentoring others.

Why join? Shape how millions of people interact with their financial institution, collaborate on some of the most sophisticated and compliance-driven cloud architectures at scale, and innovate in a culture that values curiosity, ownership, and diverse perspectives. title: Logistics Scheduler/物流コーディネーター, Central Operations
descriptionHtml:
アマゾンジャパンAmazon Logistics(以下、AMZL)部門のセントラルオペレーションチームでは急速に拡大している物流の最後の区間、ラストマイルネットワークを円滑に運営するために注文数の予測や配送ドライバー台数の計画、運用方法を改革していくことを目指したオペレーションを構築します。そのため、イノベーションと問題解決に情熱を持ち、世界最高レベルの顧客体験を創造する能力を持つLogistics Scheduler/物流コーディネーターを募集しています。日本にある全てのAMZLデリバリーステーション(以下、DS)をサポートする重要な役割を担っていただきます。

勤務形態は40時間/週、日勤・夜勤8時間勤務のシフト制(土日祝日含む)となります。シフトにより年末年始の勤務あり。

関連情報
・所属部門:ラストマイル(AMZL)
・職種:オペレーション

https://www.amazon.jobs/disability/jp


Key job responsibilities
全国のDSの配送オペレーションを横断的にサポートしていただく役割を担って頂きます。支える役割を担っていただきます。具体的には荷物量の予測からドライバーの配車計画、配送ルート作成、当日のリアルタイム対応まで、マネージャーやチームと連携しながら以下の業務を遂行します：
1. 配送計画の策定・調整: 全国のDSに対し、日次の荷物量予測に基づきドライバー台数・配送ルートを計画し、リアルタイムで最適化する
2. オペレーション異常への即時対応: 遅延・災害等の発生時に、配送ルート再編成やステークホルダーへの情報共有を迅速に実施し、配送サービス・納期を維持する
3. パフォーマンスの可視化・報告: 日次・週次のオペレーションレポートを作成し、改善機会をマネージャーに提案する
4. オペレーション拡大時の準備・実行: セールイベントや新規サービス・システム導入時に、手順変更の検討・標準作業手順書（SOP）の作成・トレーニング教材の構築を行い、円滑な導入を推進する
5. 業務標準化・改善の推進: チームメンバーとステークスホルダーと協力し、データに基づいた業務プロセスの改善と標準化を推進する

A day in the life
あなたの1日は、全国のDS状況をリアルタイムで把握することから始まります。シフト開始時に朝礼を行い、当日の業務内容を確認します。配送計画、リアルタイム対応、改善推進など、専門チームごとに担当領域が分かれており、あなたの強みや適性に応じたチームに配属されます。
シフト中は、複数のモニターで状況を監視しながら、配送計画の策定・調整業務を行います。突発的な遅延や天候変化に対応する場面もあります。あなたが支えるのは、デリバリーステーションに荷物が届く前からお客様の手元に届くまでの全プロセスです。1人で判断するのではなく、チームメンバーと連携しながらリアルタイムで最適な解決策を見つけていきます。
また、日々のオペレーション対応だけでなく、「もっとこうすれば効率的になるのでは？」というアイデアをチームに提案し、改善プロジェクトを主動していただきます。前職での経験や視点を活かして、新しい仕組みづくりに貢献できる環境です。


About the team
■セントラルオペレーション■
セントラルオペレーションは複数のチームからなる300人を超える大規模な組織です。大多数は日本語を母語とするメンバーですが、多様なバックグラウンドを持つメンバーが世界中から集まっています。多様性(DEI)が尊重され、安心して働ける環境です。

■会社のカルチャー■
Amazonでは全員がリーダーです。個人の裁量に任される部分が多く、職位や役割に関わらず誰もがチャレンジできる環境です。年次有給休暇の取得を積極的に推進しており、仕事とプライベートの両方を充実させることができます。

まずは試してみることを大切にしています。好奇心を持って学び、時にはリスクを取りながら、よりよい成果に繋げていく文化があります。

■キャリアパス■
Logistics Scheduler/物流コーディネーターからキャリアをスタートし、チームのマネージャーとなった実績も多数あります。また、社内公募制度を通じて、国内外の他部署や異なる職種への異動にチャレンジし、多様なキャリアを築くチャンスもあります。

Basic qualifications

- 高校卒業以上
- PCスキル（WordやExcelなどで文書作成や表作成ができる能力）、但し業務を通じて向上させる意欲があること）
- ビジネスレベルの日本語力（文書の作成・読解能力）
- 翻訳を活用しながらでもコミュニケーションをとることができる英語力

Preferred qualifications

- 4年制大学での学士号
- チーム内でリーダーシップを発揮し、プロジェクトを完遂した経験
- マネジメント経験（人数・期間は問わず）
- 定量的なデータ分析をもとに、業務改善・標準化を実施した経験
- SQLを使用したデータ取得や、VBAをた業務自動化の実務経験
- ビジネスレベルの英語力

title: Wireless Network Development Engineer , ONE-NAT
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon's Network Access Technology team and build automation that keeps the world's largest enterprise wireless network running smoothly and healing itself. You'll design and deploy next-generation access infrastructure across thousands of global sites, solving complex problems at massive scale while your work directly enables every package Amazon delivers.

Your primary focus is building automation that makes our global wireless network self-sufficient and resilient. You'll analyze patterns across thousands of sites, develop workflows that resolve issues without human intervention, and validate new hardware before it reaches production environments.

You partner with firmware, field operations, and infrastructure engineers—pressure-testing designs and influencing decisions through data-driven insights. You'll mentor newer engineers, conduct technical reviews, and occasionally visit sites for hands-on validation and troubleshooting.

No two weeks look the same, but the constant is this: you're solving complex problems at unprecedented scale, and your work directly impacts the reliability of our fulfillment network worldwide.


Key job responsibilities
- Design and Deploy Network Solutions: Lead the design, development, and deployment of network access solutions spanning wireless (Wi-Fi 5/6/6E/7), wired (802.1X, NAC), and emerging network access technologies across Amazon's global fulfillment network.
- Own End-to-End Project Delivery: Take ownership of complex, multi-milestone network engineering projects from requirements gathering through deployment and validation, ensuring alignment with internal processes and stakeholder expectations.
- Build Automation and Tooling: Develop and enhance automation frameworks for network configuration, compliance validation, and zero-touch deployment pipelines that reduce manual effort and improve consistency.
- Enable Self-Healing Operations: Contribute to our automation platform by developing automated remediation workflows, anomaly detection models, and predictive maintenance capabilities for wireless infrastructure.
- Drive Cross-Team Collaboration: Partner with engineering, field operations, network operations, and program management teams to develop solutions that balance performance, cost, and operational simplicity while validating new device types and configurations.

Amazon offers a full range of benefits that support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners. About the team
We own the design, planning, deployment, and support of the largest wireless and wired access network in the world. We operate at an unprecedented scale—assisting fulfillment, sortation, and delivery sites globally. Our team manages access interconnection that ensures every Amazon associate, robot, and IoT device stays reliably linked to power Amazon's fulfillment promise.

We're focused on transforming network engineering and operations through AI-driven automation, self-healing infrastructure, and next-generation access technologies. We don't just maintain reachability—we architect the network that enables Amazon to deliver for customers worldwide. You'll be part of a team that values operational excellence, continuous improvement, and collective problem-solving.

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of automation scripting using Python, Bash, Shell and/or Perl experience
- 4+ years experience developing engineering, deployment, or operations mechanisms to support IP network and/or networking systems
- 4+ years experience in a network focused hands-on technical role working with IP routing protocols/technologies and platforms in large scale enterprise wireless network environments
- 4+ years of experience in network engineering, with deep expertise in wireless (802.11ac/ax/be) and wired (802.1X, RADIUS, DHCP, DNS) access technologies

Preferred qualifications

- Thorough understanding of TCP/IP networking, IP routing, Server Load Balancing, and Network Security architecture and core technologies such as IP, TCP, OSPF/IS-IS, BGP, MPLS, Server Load Balancers, Firewalls, ACLs, DNS, DHCP, IPAM, LDAP, NFS, etc.

title: Sr. Product Manager, Amazon Intermodal
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Intermodal (AZIM) Network Optimization team is looking for a Senior Product Manager to drive the technology and product strategy that powers cost optimization and operational efficiency across the intermodal network, with a primary focus on drayage. This is a high-impact role responsible for translating complex supply chain problems — drayage cost reduction, carrier allocation, load planning, and ramp-level execution — into scalable product and automation solutions.

This role will own the product roadmap for drayage optimization tooling, partnering closely with engineering, operations, finance, and sourcing teams to define requirements, prioritize investments, and deliver capabilities that measurably reduce cost and manual effort. The ideal candidate combines strong technical product management skills with supply chain fluency, is comfortable navigating ambiguity to define what should be built and why, and thrives in a fast-paced environment where shipping product improvements directly impacts network economics.

Key job responsibilities
Drayage Product Strategy & Roadmap Own the product vision and roadmap for drayage optimization — including carrier allocation, load planning, cost modeling, and ramp-level execution tooling. Define what to build, sequence investments, and align stakeholders on priorities.

Requirements & Solution Design Translate operational pain points and cost reduction opportunities into clear product requirements and technical specifications. Partner with engineering to scope solutions that balance speed-to-value with long-term scalability.

Automation & Tooling Development Identify and eliminate manual processes across the drayage lifecycle by designing automated workflows, alerting mechanisms, and self-service analytics capabilities that reduce toil and improve decision speed.

Data & Metrics Ownership Define and instrument success metrics for drayage product initiatives. Monitor adoption, measure realized cost savings, and use data to iterate on product direction and prioritize the backlog.

Cross-Functional Partnership Collaborate with Network Optimization, Strategic Sourcing, Finance, and Operations to ensure product investments are grounded in business priorities and deliver measurable impact to the intermodal network.

Stakeholder Communication Present product strategy, progress, and outcomes to senior leadership. Articulate trade-offs clearly, build alignment on investment decisions, and advocate for the resources needed to execute the roadmap.

A day in the life
You'll start each morning reviewing drayage performance metrics and product dashboards to assess adoption, flag issues, and identify optimization gaps. From there, you'll work with Engineering to refine requirements, unblock development, or review sprint deliverables. You'll partner with Network Optimization and Operations teams to ground product decisions in real execution challenges — carrier availability, ramp constraints, cost variability. You'll sync with Finance and Sourcing to validate that product investments align with cost savings targets. When new opportunities surface, you'll scope the problem, size the impact, and build the case for senior leadership. Your customers are the AZIM teams that plan, execute, and optimize drayage operations every day.

About the team
Amazon Intermodal (AZIM) is Amazon's internal intermodal transportation program, managing the movement of freight across the nation's Class 1 railroad network. The team oversees rail strategy, carrier relationships, operational execution, and financial performance for one of Amazon's most cost-efficient long-haul transportation modes. title: Senior Account Manager
descriptionHtml:
As Senior Account Manager at AWS, you will drive growth and adoption of AWS services among cross industry customers in Indonesia.

You'll build strong relationships with C-level executives and technical leaders, understand their business objectives, and provide tailored cloud solutions to address their unique challenges. Your expertise will help customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and achieve cost optimization. You'll work collaboratively with AWS teams, partners, and customers to develop and execute go-to-market strategies, identify new opportunities, and expand existing relationships.

With a deep understanding of enterprise landscape, you'll provide thought leadership, drive deal closure, and ensure exceptional customer satisfaction. If you're a motivated relationship-builder with a passion for cloud innovation, this role is a great fit for you.

Key job responsibilities
- Build and maintain strong relationships with C-level executives and technical leaders for cross industry customers
- Understand customer business objectives, challenges, and cloud adoption goals
- Develop tailored AWS solutions to address customer needs and drive business outcomes
- Drive growth and adoption of AWS services among assigned customers
- Collaborate with AWS teams (sales, solutions architecture, professional services) to execute customer deals and projects
- Identify new business opportunities and expand existing relationships
- Provide thought leadership and expertise on AWS services and cloud innovation
- Manage deal pipeline, forecast, and reporting
- Ensure exceptional customer satisfaction and success with AWS services
- Stay up-to-date on industry trends, market developments, and competitor activity in banking and enterprise sectors

About the team
Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon diversity conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- 4+ years of stakeholder or account management experience, or experience with AWS services or other cloud offerings
- 7+ years of direct sales or business development in software, cloud or SaaS markets selling to C-level executives experience

Preferred qualifications

- BA or BS degree in a related field
- 7+ years of B2B sales
- Experience implementing cloud services including migrations and modernization projects or equivalent
- Experience navigating prospective accounts from and into a senior executive level to identify new customer opportunities
- Experience using Salesforce or other CRM tools

title: AWS Solutions Architect, AWS Solutions Architect
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, we are continuously striving to me the most customer-centric company in the world. AWS have been helping over one million customers in over 190 countries to deliver flexibility, scalability and reliability across their organizations. Behind this success is exceptionally talented, bright and driven individuals who work hard, have fun and make history.

As a Solution Architect within Amazon Web Services (AWS), you will have the opportunity to help shape and deliver on a strategy to build mind share and broad use of Amazon's services (like Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Q, Amazon SageMaker, Amazon DynamoDB, Amazon S3, Amazon EC2, and Amazon SQS, etc) within strategic accounts across Italy.

Your broad responsibilities will include: owning the technical engagement and ultimate success around specific implementation projects, and developing a deep expertise in the AWS technologies as well as broad know-how around how applications and services are constructed using the AWS platform.

The ideal candidate will possess customer-facing skills that will allow them to represent Amazon well within a customer's environment and drive discussions with senior personnel within the company, as well as a technical background that enables them to easily interact and give guidance with software developers and architects. He/she should also have a demonstrated ability to think structured about business, product, and technical challenges.

The AWS SA team provides a ramp-up program that includes self-paced learning, instructor-led training, hands-on projects, job shadowing opportunities, and a peer-reviewed opportunity to demonstrate your knowledge.

title: Software Development Engineer II, Amazon Fulfillment Technologies (AFT) - Workforce Optimization
descriptionHtml:
Have you ever ordered a product from Amazon and been amazed by how fast it gets to you? Every day, Amazon engineers are working relentlessly to make sure that the time from Click to Deliver is as short as possible for your products. In our mission to get packages to you even faster, Amazon Fulfillment Technologies (AFT) is building large scale, fault-tolerant distributed systems for optimizing labor planning in fulfillment operations.

Our team is looking for Software Development Engineers who love listening to our customers, working as a team, and building large scalable systems. This is an opportunity to build and improve systems that will help Fulfillment Centers (FCs i.e. Amazon Warehouses) and other building types around the world to operate efficiently by providing information and insights to FC operators and software services which rely on real time information for planning and staffing. These systems provide aggregate data and help build an end-to-end picture of FC state to help users make key decisions to improve efficiency and staff optimally. These decisions impact delivery of packages to Amazon customers. Your work will directly influence Amazon business and customer promise. As a member of this team, you will get the opportunity to work on highly visible, innovative projects that directly impact the customer experience. You will be involved in all the aspects of the software development cycle including scoping, design, implementation, testing & delivery of your product. The position has great opportunity for growth.

Key job responsibilities
In this position you will partner with product managers, software engineers, user experience designers and other teams. A successful candidate will have an established background with strong technical ability, bar raising engineering skills, great communication skills and motivation to achieve results for your customers. In this role you will both code and mentor junior engineers committing code to the program.

About the team
Amazon Fulfillment Technologies (AFT) powers Amazon’s global fulfillment network. We invent and deliver software, hardware, and data science solutions that orchestrate processes, robots, machines, and people. We harmonize the physical and virtual world so Amazon customers can get what they want, when they want it.

Workforce Optimization
AFT’s Workforce Optimization team delivers innovative platforms and products to automate labor management and staffing decisions across processes and functions at Amazon’s global fulfillment network locations.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Software Development Engineer, AI Studios Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Join us as a Software Development Engineer on the AI Studios Engineering org within Prime Video and Amazon MGM Studios, where you'll build intelligent systems at the intersection of AI and cinematic storytelling. This role offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to Nara, our AI-native content creation platform that empowers creators to produce professional animation and live action content featuring world-class intellectual properties at unprecedented speed and scale.   In this role, you'll develop production-quality code for AI-powered creative tools while learning from experienced engineers and scientists. You'll work alongside creative professionals (animators, filmmakers, and storytellers) implementing features that directly transform how animation and live action/VFX content is made for Prime Video's most ambitious productions. This is an ideal opportunity for engineers who are passionate about AI/ML applications in entertainment and want to grow their skills while contributing to industry-defining products featuring iconic IPs.

Key job responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain software components for our AI-native content creation platform, supporting professional animation and live action/VFX workflows   Implement features across the stack—from backend services, media processing pipelines, and APIs to ML model integrations and creator-facing tooling—with guidance from senior engineers   Write clean, well-tested, and maintainable code while participating in code reviews to both give and receive constructive feedback   Collaborate with cross-functional teams including ML scientists, applied scientists, product managers, and creative professionals to understand requirements and deliver solutions   Contribute to integrations with industry-standard Digital Content Creation (DCC) tools such as Adobe Animate, After Effects, Maya, and Storyboard Pro   Troubleshoot and debug issues in production systems, contributing to operational excellence and system reliability   Participate in on-call rotations and contribute to improving system monitoring, alerting, and documentation   Continuously learn new technologies, tools, and methodologies relevant to AI/ML systems, media processing, and distributed computing

A day in the life
As an SDE on the AI Studios team, you'll spend most of your time writing and reviewing code, with regular opportunities to collaborate with teammates on design discussions. A typical day might include building API endpoints for our creator tooling platform, implementing new features for our live action VFX pipeline, or debugging an integration with our proprietary AI models. What makes this role unique is the opportunity to work on-site alongside VFX artists and creative professionals, sitting with them as they use your tools, watching where workflows break down, and iterating rapidly to meet the demands of production timelines. You'll participate in team standups, sprint planning, and retrospectives while building your understanding of our systems. You'll have opportunities to learn from experienced engineers and gradually take on more complex challenges as you grow, all while working on technology that powers content featuring world-class IPs.

About the team
We're part of the Engineering org within newly established Prime Video's AI Studios Division, pioneering AI-native cinematic content creation. Our mission is to establish Amazon MGM Studios as the definitive leader in AI-enabled content creation—giving creators unprecedented control over AI outputs while materially reducing production costs and timelines for animation and live action productions featuring world-class intellectual properties.   Our engineering team spans distributed systems engineers building scalable infrastructure, ML engineers optimizing model training and inference, and full-stack engineers crafting intuitive interfaces for creative collaboration. We're building Nara, our AI-native platform, along with proprietary AI models (Genies) for animation, Live Action/VFX copilots, and integrations with industry-standard creative tools. We work in a fast-paced, innovative environment where you'll contribute to technology transforming how iconic entertainment content is made.

Prime Video is a first-stop entertainment destination offering customers a vast collection of premium programming in one app available across thousands of devices. Prime members can customize their viewing experience and find their favorite movies, series, documentaries, and live sports – including Amazon MGM Studios-produced series and movies; licensed fan favorites; and programming from Prime Video add-on subscriptions such as Apple TV+, Max, Crunchyroll and MGM+. All customers, regardless of whether they have a Prime membership or not, can rent or buy titles via the Prime Video Store, and can enjoy even more content for free with ads.

Are you interested in shaping the future of entertainment? Prime Video's technology teams are creating best-in-class digital video experience.

As a Prime Video technologist, you’ll have end-to-end ownership of the product, user experience, design, and technology required to deliver state-of-the-art experiences for our customers. You’ll get to work on projects that are fast-paced, challenging, and varied. You’ll also be able to experiment with new possibilities, take risks, and collaborate with remarkable people.

We’ll look for you to bring your diverse perspectives, ideas, and skill-sets to make Prime Video even better for our customers. With global opportunities for talented technologists, you can decide where a career Prime Video Tech takes you!

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
- 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
- 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Sales Ops Lead, GTM Strategy, GTMO Sales Ops, AB
descriptionHtml:
Come be a part of a rapidly expanding $35 billion dollar global business. At Amazon Business, a fast-growing startup passionate about building solutions, we set out every day to innovate and disrupt the status quo. We stand at the intersection of tech & retail in the B2B space developing innovative purchasing and procurement solutions to help businesses and organizations thrive. At Amazon Business, we strive to be the most recognized and preferred strategic partner for smart business buying. Bring your insight, imagination and a healthy disregard for the impossible. Join us in building and celebrating the value of Amazon Business to buyers and sellers of all sizes and industries. Unlock your career potential.

We are seeking a Senior Sales Operations Lead to own our strategic and go-to-market execution for a new, purpose-built B2B fulfillment network launching across the United States. This role sits at the intersection of network economics, enterprise sales, and operational scaling, building the engine that translates infrastructure investment into customer acquisition and GMS growth. You will architect the GTM motions, scenario models, and pipeline frameworks that connect a multi-billion-dollar network buildout to measurable enterprise customer outcomes.

This isn't a maintenance role. You'll be standing up the operating model from scratch; defining customer segmentation, building incrementality frameworks that pressure-test top-down targets against bottom-up account-level data, and designing the sales motions that activate managed spend across thousands of enterprise accounts. You'll own the bridge between network capacity coming online and the revenue those buildings need to justify their investment.

Key job responsibilities
• Build and own the commercial strategy framework Build and own the commercial strategy framework for a dedicated B2B fulfillment network scaling from pilot to 20+ US sites, translating network topology and capacity plans into customer-facing GTM motions with quantified GMS targets by region, cohort, and sales motion.
• Design and validate incrementality models Design and validate incrementality models that bridge top-down financial targets to bottom-up account-level opportunity, using scenario analysis (Conservative / Base / Optimistic) to quantify the contribution of sales-led engagement, managed spend activation, and marketing-led motions across enterprise customer segments.
• Own customer segmentation and prioritization Own customer segmentation and prioritization for a 10,000+ account universe — developing composite scoring frameworks, cohort-level growth rate analysis, and managed spend conversion premium quantification to focus sales resources on highest-yield accounts.
• Architect multi-tier GTM motions: Architect multi-tier GTM motions: concentrated high-touch engagement for top-quartile enterprise accounts ($50M+ addressable base), scaled managed spend activation for mid-tier cohorts, and marketing-led automated outreach for long-tail accounts, each with distinct KPIs, conversion assumptions, and ROI models.
• Partner with Operations, Finance, and Network Design Partner with Operations, Finance, and Network Design to align demand planning with building launch timelines, translating site-level capacity constraints into sales planning inputs (coverage radius, direct dispatch eligibility, ASIN selection ramp, and delivery speed commitments).
• Drive Sales Operations infrastructure Drive Sales Operations infrastructure — Territory Planning aligned to network geography, quota development calibrated to building launch cadence, SFDC workflow implementation for pipeline tracking, and performance management frameworks that surface leading indicators of network adoption.
• Build the measurement and reporting stack Build the measurement and reporting stack for network-specific GMS contribution, including cohort analysis by managed spend engagement tier, pipeline-to-attainment waterfall, weekly unit forecasting against building capacity, and growth rate benchmarking across MS-engaged vs. non-engaged accounts.
• Model and simulate business outcomes Model and simulate business outcomes to inform VP-level investment decisions — including 5-year build plan economics, per-site payback analysis, reseller exclusion sensitivity testing, and ASIN category expansion accelerators.
• Develop executive-ready narratives Develop executive-ready narratives that translate complex scenario models into clear strategic recommendations for senior leadership, calibrating language and granularity for VP audiences while preserving analytical rigor in appendices.
• Collaborate cross-functionally Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales Leadership, Enablement, Marketing, Supply Chain, and Tech teams to ensure GTM activation is synchronized with operational milestones (inbound launch, outbound launch, tech releases, selection ramp).

Basic qualifications

- 6+ years of Microsoft Excel experience
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience developing and implementing systems/tools utilized for CRM, variable compensation, revenue reporting, forecasting, Salesforce automation, etc.
- Experience defining, refining and implementing sales processes, procedures and policies or equivalent

Preferred qualifications

- Experience using Salesforce (or other CRM tool) or BI tools
- Experience presenting to senior leadership

title: Senior Water Infrastructure Manager, AWS EMEA Water Team
descriptionHtml:
The EMEA Water team is looking for a Senior Water Infrastructure Manager to support scaling and growth across our Data Centre network. If you like to drive the development, implementation and construction of new water infrastructure and have experience in infrastructure delivery end to end - this role may be for you. Your work will help deliver large-scale water projects, and water infrastructure projects outside the fenceline that our infrastructure needs to renewably and strategically operate.

AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS)

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Key job responsibilities
- You will own the End-to -End delivery of external water infrastructure solutions, from scoping to physical delivery. This requires you to project manage as the business and technical owner of all aspects of the delivery.
- You will manage 3rd party design consultants, develop and document requirements, budgets, business cases, permitting and project schedules.
- You will prepare project contracts, milestone payments and schedules; taking the contract through legal reviews and procurement pathways.
- The role requires strong project management, technical competency in design and a programmatic leadership through legal and procurement to drive results.
- You will multitask and re-prioritize and effectively lead deliveries based on ever changing business needs
- You will build and maintaining overall delivery program and project budget, submitting Capital Allocation Requests to Senior leadership to secure finance for project delivery.
- You will prepare investment need/business case papers to secure internal funding for water reinforcement projects to secure water supply and discharges.


A day in the life
- Liaison with a wide range of regulators and external stakeholders (Water utilities, environmental agencies, health department, construction contractors etc)
- Liaison with a wide range of internal stakeholders (Environmental, Legal, Procurement, Construction, Real Estate etc)
- You will leverage project management tools and techniques for all phases of the project lifecycle.
- Regularly report to senior leadership on status of key project metrics vs. commitment of your projects.
- Negotiate infrastructure agreements that address business need and community benefit across a range of diverse stakeholders.
- Own the delivery of the water infrastructure solution end to end from negotiation of technical infrastructure solutions to managing design development to tendering, GC award and on time delivery to build scalable and future proof water infrastructure.

title: Advanced Materials Engineer, Global Materials Science
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon's Global Sustainable Packaging (GSP) organization as we pioneer the future of sustainable e-commerce packaging. As an Advanced Packaging Materials Engineer based in the EU, you'll serve as the critical link between our European and North American materials science operations—driving paper-based materials development tailored to the EU supplier base while harmonizing global materials strategies across regions. Embedded alongside our automation hardware development teams, you'll ensure that packaging materials and automation systems are co-developed for seamless integration.

This is a hands-on, technically broad role spanning pulp and paper manufacturing, packaging converting operations, paper-based materials for manual and automatic packaging, and packaging automation equipment. You'll conduct laboratory research, characterize materials properties, establish specifications, and work directly with EU-based suppliers to bring novel materials from concept to production—while serving as the conduit to align materials globally, simplify where possible, and solve for region-specific requirements driven by regulation, material supply availability, and operational differences.



Key job responsibilities
Materials Development & Innovation:
- Lead laboratory research and development of paper-based packaging materials for manual and automatic packaging, with deep understanding of pulp and paper manufacturing processes and converting operations.
- Design and execute experiments to optimize material formulations and processing parameters, applying the materials science triangle framework (processing-structure-properties) across the full range of paper-based packaging materials and converting processes.
- Develop next-generation materials solutions that unlock step-change improvements in performance, cost, sustainability, and automation compatibility—with specific focus on EU supplier capabilities and regional material availability.
- Advance materials innovations from concept, pilot, and deployment phases, ensuring solutions are compatible with EU packaging automation hardware and converting equipment.
- Evaluate and develop paper-based material systems that meet the unique performance demands of automated packaging lines, considering substrate interactions, machine speed requirements, and environmental conditions.

EU Materials Strategy & Global Alignment
- Serve as the primary conduit between EU and NA materials science teams, driving global alignment on materials specifications while identifying opportunities to harmonize and simplify across regions.
- Develop and maintain a comprehensive understanding of the EU supplier base—including paper mills, converters, and coating suppliers—and how it differs from the North American supply landscape.
- Identify region-specific materials requirements dictated by EU regulations (e.g., REACH, EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation, CEFLEX), regional material supply constraints, and operational differences in EU fulfillment networks.
- Balance global standardization with regional customization—driving simplification where materials can be harmonized and developing tailored solutions where regional requirements demand differentiation.
- Build and maintain a materials roadmap for EU that aligns with global GSP strategy and EU automation hardware development timelines.

Automation Hardware Integration
- Work closely with EU-based automation hardware development teams to ensure paper-based packaging materials are co-developed with automation equipment, optimizing for machine runnability, reliability, and throughput.
- Provide materials expertise during automation system design, commissioning, and optimization—translating materials properties into actionable equipment parameters.
- Develop deep understanding of packaging converting equipment (folders, gluers, sealers, labelers) and how paper-based materials properties influence machine performance at production speeds.
- Support troubleshooting of materials-related automation failures, conducting root cause analysis that spans materials properties, converting conditions, and equipment settings.

Materials Characterization & Testing
- Perform and direct lab engineers to conduct comprehensive materials characterization of physical, structural, strength, resistance, surface, optical, barrier, and recyclability properties while utilizing standards and non-standard methodologies.
- Establish correlations between fundamental materials properties and operational performance in fulfillment environments, with emphasis on how EU-specific substrates and converting conditions affect outcomes.
- Design and execute test plans that validate materials performance against specifications and requirements for both manual and automated packaging operations.
- Analyze test data using statistical methods to drive data-driven materials selection decisions across the EU supplier base.

Specifications & Quality
- Define materials specifications based on critical performance thresholds required for packaging to protect products and survive the fulfillment network, accounting for EU-specific substrate variability and supplier capabilities.
- Translate operational requirements and automation equipment constraints into measurable materials properties and acceptable ranges.
- Develop quality control protocols and testing methodologies to ensure EU supplier compliance with specifications, accounting for differences in regional testing standards.
- Drive specification harmonization between NA and EU where feasible, clearly documenting where and why regional deviations are necessary.

Supplier & Manufacturing Collaboration
- Work directly with EU-based paper mills, converters, and other suppliers to develop and scale new paper-based packaging materials.
Conduct technical evaluations of EU supplier capabilities, pulp and paper manufacturing processes, converting operations, and quality control systems.
- Guide suppliers on process optimization—from pulp preparation and paper machine settings through converting and finishing operations—to achieve target material properties and consistency.
- Build strong technical relationships across the EU supplier base to enable rapid development cycles and ensure supply resilience.

Cross-Functional Partnership
- Collaborate with Packaging Design and automation hardware teams on materials-design-equipment integration, ensuring all three dimensions are optimized together.
- Partner with EU and Global Procurement (GPO) on strategic sourcing, supplier selection, and commercial negotiations within the EU supply base.
- Support sustainability initiatives including carbon footprint modeling, recyclability assessment, and compliance with EU-specific sustainability regulations and reporting requirements (REACH, EU PPWR, CEFLEX).
- Provide technical expertise to program managers, product teams, and deployment teams across both EU and NA organizations.
- Communicate complex materials science and manufacturing concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences across multiple geographies and cultures.

Documentation & Knowledge Sharing
- Author technical reports, test protocols, specifications documents, and research summaries that serve both EU and global audiences.
- Document experimental procedures, results, and learnings to build institutional knowledge, with particular emphasis on EU-NA materials differences and lessons learned.
- Present findings at design reviews, technical workshops, and leadership reviews across regions.
- Contribute to intellectual property generation through public disclosures and patent applications.
- Mentor junior engineers and technicians on materials science principles, pulp and paper manufacturing fundamentals, converting operations, and testing methodologies.


A day in the life
You're bridging continents and disciplines, ensuring Amazon's paper-based packaging materials work seamlessly from lab bench to automated packaging line.
Your morning starts with a technical review alongside the EU automation hardware team, discussing runnability data from a new paper substrate on their latest packaging machine prototype. The converting parameters need adjustment, your deep knowledge of fiber orientation, surface chemistry, and machine dynamics helps the team identify the right combination of material properties and equipment settings for optimal performance.
By midday, you're on a call with a European paper mill, discussing modifications to their pulp furnish and machine settings to improve tensile energy absorption, a critical property for automated forming operations. You're also comparing their capabilities against what your NA colleagues are achieving with North American suppliers, identifying where specifications can be unified.
Your afternoon shifts to lab work, where you are directing a lab engineer to characterize a new paper-based material system for high-speed automated packaging on recycled substrates and a global alignment session with your NA counterparts. You're presenting a proposal to harmonize material specifications across regions, having identified that three separate specs can be consolidated into one without compromising performance in either geography.
Where regulatory or supply differences demand regional solutions, you've clearly documented the rationale and developed parallel qualification paths.

This role sits at the intersection of materials science, manufacturing processes, automation engineering, and global supply chain strategy. Your holistic understanding of how pulp becomes paper, how paper becomes packaging, and how packaging runs through automated systems makes you uniquely positioned to solve problems that span traditional disciplinary boundaries, all while keeping EU and NA aligned on a simplified, high-performing materials portfolio.


About the team
The Global Materials Science (GMS) organization is Amazon's Center of Excellence for packaging materials development and supply chain transformation. Our team represents a fundamental shift in how Amazon approaches packaging innovation—moving from supplier-dependent solutions to owning the invention, development, and optimization of materials that power our fulfillment network.

Our Mission: We build deep expertise in packaging materials through rigorous research and testing, develop innovative packaging solutions that unlock automation potential and sustainability improvements, and establish robust supply chains that deliver superior solutions at lower cost.

Our Vision: To be the global leader in e-commerce packaging materials science and innovation, enabling the best customer packaging experience at the lowest cost to serve.

What Makes Us Unique: We're not just specifying materials—we're fundamentally understanding them through the materials science triangle framework (processing, structure, properties). Our integrated capabilities span from molecular-level materials characterization, to full packaging system testing, to automation compatibility testing. This end-to-end ownership enables us to innovate faster, unlock step-change improvements impossible for suppliers alone, and maintain freedom to operate across multiple supply chains.

Our Impact: We're driving Amazon's transition from plastic to paper packaging, developing breakthrough materials and establishing supply chains that reduce costs while advancing our 2040 net-zero commitment. Our work directly influences automation success, customer experience, and sustainability metrics.

Our Culture: We operate with high technical rigor while moving at startup speed. We embrace calculated risk-taking in R&D, fail fast, and iterate based on data. We believe in radical collaboration—our success requires seamless partnership across engineering, procurement, operations, and sustainability teams. We're building something that's never been done before in e-commerce, and we're looking for engineers who thrive in ambiguity, think globally while executing locally, and are energized by complex, high-impact challenges.

Our Team: We bring together materials scientists, chemists, engineers, and program managers who are passionate about solving hard problems. We partner with world-class academic institutions, leading materials suppliers, and internal Amazon teams to push the boundaries of what's possible in packaging materials. Our EU presence ensures we're co-located with automation development and deeply embedded in the European supplier ecosystem

Basic qualifications

- Experience with the project management of technical projects
- Experience working with interdisciplinary teams to execute product design from concept to production
- Experience in developing functional specifications, design verification plans and functional test procedures
- Experience with materials selection, testing, and scaling to manufacturing
- Bachelor's degree in materials science engineering, chemistry, chemical engineering, mechanical engineering, pulp/paper engineering or a related technical discipline

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree or higher in materials science engineering, chemistry, chemical engineering, mechanical engineering, pulp/paper engineering or a related technical discipline
- Engineering experience in pulp, paper, packaging or related field
- Experience in characterization of physical, structural, strength, resistance, surface, optical, barrier, and recyclability properties with standard (ASTM, TAPPI, ISO, EN, ISTA, CEPI) and non-standard methodologies
- Laboratory management experience

descriptionHtml:

The OPM partners with Site Technical Managers and Sunnyvale Product Managers to plan new product introductions, and drives cross-functional execution with Engineering, Quality, Automation, and the CM across every phase of the program lifecycle.

Key job responsibilities

• Identify and escalate risks in manufacturing process development, equipment delivery, quality control plans, and validation schedules.

On any given day, the OPM may be working with STMs and Sunnyvale Product Managers to plan capacity, material, and technology requirements for a new product introduction, defining manufacturing strategies and site readiness requirements for a project launch, or leading the daily standup during a production ramp to drive issue resolution and report progress against yield targets. During sustained operations, the OPM focuses on operational improvements and CM performance management. title: Supply Chain Manager II, AMXL Last Mile
descriptionHtml:
We're looking for a Supply Chain Manager to own AMXL's forward-looking speed strategy, GVS goal management, and the tradeoffs required to achieve the right customer outcome. This is not a reactive reporting role — you will shape how speed decisions are made before they're locked, connecting analytical rigor to planning decisions that affect millions of customer promises.

You'll sit within the AMXL NA Strategic Planning Team (SPT) and serve as the single-threaded owner for speed strategy across planning horizons. You'll partner closely with Finance, Operations, Capacity Planning, and Science teams to quantify tradeoffs, diagnose drivers, and recommend where different planning choices would materially improve the customer experience.

Key job responsibilities
- GVS goal and speed outlook — Own the forward-looking speed outlook, including the primary drivers of expected performance and any gaps to goal.
- Speed diagnostics — Identify where speed is expected to improve or degrade and why, distinguishing structural opportunities from temporary noise.
- Tradeoff analysis — Evaluate speed, backlog, capacity, and cost tradeoffs across HVE and ongoing planning decisions. Quantify the customer impact of alternative scenarios.
- Pre-HVE inputs and logic — Own or co-own the inputs-and-logic review before HVE speed modeling to ensure scenarios are built from understood, decision-ready assumptions.
- Finance partnership — Partner closely with Finance E2E on cost/tradeoff decisions; serve as the team's finance SME for speed-related planning tradeoffs.
- Investment recommendations — Recommend where incremental investment or different planning choices would materially improve customer speed.
- Cross-mechanism connectivity — Connect speed implications into backlog, MTP, HVE, capacity, and aligned-planning decisions.
- Analytical capability development — Develop the scenario logic, tools, and analytical frameworks needed to support speed strategy decisions.

A day in the life
Amazon offers a full range of benefits that support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners and their children. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment.

The benefits that generally apply to regular, full-time employees include:
- Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
- Maternity and Parental Leave Options
- Paid Time Off (PTO)
- 401(k) Plan  

If you are not sure that every qualification on the list above describes you exactly, we'd still love to hear from you!

At Amazon, we value people with unique backgrounds, experiences, and skillsets. If you’re passionate about this role and want to make an impact on a global scale, please apply!

About the team
