title: Praktikum im Bereich Logistik - Bad Oldesloe - Start 2027
descriptionHtml:
Bitte beachte: Wir haben verschiedene Möglichkeiten in ganz Deutschland und benötigen Flexibilität bezüglich der Standorte. Wenn du dich für die Stelle bewirbst, gib bitte alle deine bevorzugten Standorte in Deutschland an.
Alle unsere Praktika finden vollständig vor Ort statt.
Amazon Operations ist das Rückgrat der Amazon-Kundenerfahrung. Mit über 50 Logistikzentren, hunderten von Zustellstationen und zehntausenden von Versandmitarbeiter:innen arbeitet das Team zusammen, um Artikel effizient an Kund:innen zu liefern. In den Logistikzentren werden jährlich Millionen von Artikeln kommissioniert und verpackt, während die Zustellteams daran arbeiten, Bestellungen pünktlich an die Kund:innen zu bringen. Sicherheit hat oberste Priorität, und die Betriebskultur ist geprägt von Teamwork, Vielfalt und einer gemeinsamen Arbeitsethik, die das Geschäft reibungslos am Laufen hält. Das Team ist stolz darauf, den Qualitätsservice zu liefern, für den Amazon weltweit bekannt ist.

Hinweis: Du musst zum Starttermin die Arbeitsberechtigung für das Beschäftigungsland haben.


Key job responsibilities
Als Amazon Operations-Praktikant:in hast du die Möglichkeit, deine analytischen Fähigkeiten in wirkungsvollen Projekten anzuwenden, die die Funktionalität und den Service von Logistikzentren, Sortierzentren und Zustellstationen verbessern. Wichtige Aspekte der Rolle umfassen:
• Abschluss von Projekten mit hoher Priorität nach höchstem Standard und Nachweis deiner Fähigkeit, Ergebnisse zu liefern
• Datenanalyse zur Identifizierung operativer Herausforderungen und Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten
• Vorschlagen und Testen von Lösungen in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Team zur Umsetzung der effektivsten Ansätze
• Entwicklung von Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeiten durch die Zusammenarbeit mit Führungskräften, Stakeholdern und Versandmitarbeiter:innen.
• Bewegung im Gebäude, um mit verschiedenen Teams zu interagieren. Das umfasst aktives Wissenssammeln durch Teilnahme an Aktivitäten wie Vorbesprechungen, Ablaufmeetings und Diskussionen mit dem Führungsteam und Versandmitarbeiter:innen.
• Die Fähigkeit, sich im Arbeitsbereich zu orientieren und zwischen verschiedenen Bereichen zu wechseln, ist für diese Position unerlässlich.
• Flexibilität bei verschiedenen Arbeitszeiten und Schichtmustern nach Bedarf zeigen.
• Möglicher Umzug an den vorgesehenen Arbeitsort.


A day in the life
Unsere Praktika sind Bildungsmöglichkeiten, die es dir als unserer zukünftigen Führungskraft ermöglichen, zu entdecken, wie wir unsere Teams von Versandmitarbeiter:innen führen und entwickeln. Du tauchst in die schnelllebige, komplexe Welt unserer Logistikzentren, Sortierzentren und Zustellstationen ein und erlebst, wie unsere Führungskräfte ihre Teams einsetzen, um Kundenerwartungen zu erfüllen.
Dieses Praktikum versetzt dich ins Herz unserer Abläufe und ermöglicht es dir, den Weg einer Kundenbestellung zu verfolgen. Du erhältst einen realistischen Einblick in die Vollzeitchancen, die dich in unserem Unternehmen erwarten.
Du lernst, wie unsere Führungskräfte eine sichere, produktive Umgebung schaffen und das volle Potenzial ihrer Teams durch effektive Einbindung und Leistungsmanagement-Strategien nutzen. Das ist deine Chance, Fähigkeiten zu entwickeln, die dich zu einer lohnenden Karriere bei Amazon führen werden.


About the team
Praktikant:innen-Community:
• Als Amazon-Praktikant:in bist du Teil einer lebendigen, unterstützenden Community, die dein Wachstum und deine Entwicklung fördert. Du arbeitest mit Praktikant:innen aus der ganzen Welt zusammen, knüpfst Kontakte und nimmst an sozialen Veranstaltungen teil, um deinen Horizont zu erweitern. Du kannst auch spezialisierten Gruppen beitreten, die sich auf Bereiche wie Nachhaltigkeit konzentrieren, um deine vielfältigen Interessen zu erkunden.
Unterstützung:
• Das Praktikumsprogramm bietet ein robustes Unterstützungssystem, einschließlich wöchentlicher Praktikant:innen-Sprechstunden, spezieller IT- und HR-Unterstützung sowie einem Programmteam, das sich deinem Erfolg verschrieben hat. Das stellt sicher, dass du die Anleitung und Hilfe hast, die du zum Gedeihen brauchst.
Lernsessions:
• Exklusive Lernsessions werden deine Fähigkeiten weiter verbessern und dir Zugang zu Amazons modernsten Lernplattformen und der Expertise von Branchenführern gewähren. Diese strukturierten Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten bereiten dich auf den nächsten Schritt in deiner Karriere vor.
Möglichkeiten:
• Nach erfolgreichem Abschluss des Praktikums kannst du für eine Absolvent:innen-Stelle oder ein zweites Praktikum in Betracht gezogen werden, was es dir ermöglicht, deine Reise mit Amazon fortzusetzen. Zusätzlich erhältst du ein wettbewerbsfähiges Monatsgehalt, Umzugsunterstützung und Zugang zu einer Reihe von Mitarbeitervorteilen.
Praktikums-Starttermine über das Jahr:
• Wir stellen Praktikant:innen ein, die jederzeit von Januar bis Juli 2027 anfangen können. Jeden Monat führen wir 1-2 Onboarding-Tage für neue Mitarbeiter:innen durch.
Internal job description

Basic qualifications

- Derzeit im vorletzten oder letzten Jahr und auf dem Weg zu einem Universitätsabschluss in Supply Chain, Business/Management, Ingenieurwesen oder einem anderen verwandten Bereich.
- Berechtigt, ein Vollzeit-Praktikum von 3-6 Monaten zu absolvieren.
- Sehr gute Kenntnisse in gesprochenem und geschriebenem Englisch und der Landessprache des Landes, für das du dich bewirbst (Gemeinsamer Europäischer Referenzrahmen C1).

Preferred qualifications

- Starke Problemlösungs- und Analysefähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, Prozessverbesserungen und innovative Lösungen zu identifizieren.
- Ausgezeichnete Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeiten, fähig zur effektiven Zusammenarbeit mit anderen.
- Bewiesene Neugier, Proaktivität und Bereitschaft, Herausforderungen in einem unklaren, schnelllebigen Umfeld anzunehmen.

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.

Amazon Operations ist das Rückgrat der Amazon-Kundenerfahrung. title: Programme de stage « Pathways » 2027 pour les étudiants en MBA ou en Master d'Ingénierie
descriptionHtml:
Chez Amazon, nous nous efforçons de devenir l'entreprise la plus centrée sur le client au monde. Pour y parvenir, nous recherchons la prochaine génération de cadres supérieurs d'Amazon qui rejoindront le programme de leadership Pathways dans le cadre des opérations Amazon.

Le stage de leadership Pathways est un stage à temps plein de 10 à 12 semaines dans notre réseau d'opérations pour les personnes inscrites à un MBA, une maîtrise, une maîtrise ou un doctorat ayant plus de 3 ans d'expérience dans un rôle complexe. Vous serez confrontée à un défi commercial critique pour trouver une solution et acquérir de l'expérience pratique en tant que leader de grandes équipes. Votre stage se terminera par la présentation d'une solution innovante à la haute direction sur la base de vos observations, de votre implication pratique et de vos recherches analytiques au sein des opérations. À la fin du programme de stage, vos performances seront évaluées. L'évaluation de vos performances, ainsi que la disponibilité des postes, détermineront votre opportunité de rejoindre le programme Pathways à plein temps en 2027.

Notre programme de stages Pathways nécessite un minimum de 10 semaines de travail entre début juin et début septembre. S'il n'est pas possible pour vous d'obtenir votre visa/permis de travail au maximum une semaine avant votre premier jour chez nous, nous n'aurons peut-être pas d'autre choix que d'annuler votre stage dans le cadre de ce programme pour le cycle convenu, mais nous ferons tout notre possible pour vous donner la possibilité de passer un nouvel entretien pour un autre stage ou même pour un poste permanent sur Amazon en 2028, sous réserve de disponibilité.

À propos du programme Pathways

Pathways est un programme de trois ans conçu pour former rapidement des diplômés expérimentés de niveau MBA et Master aux compétences nécessaires pour devenir les prochains directeurs des opérations supérieurs d'Amazon et au-delà. C'est l'occasion de tracer votre propre voie. Les membres de Pathway sont très visibles auprès de la haute direction grâce à un réseau de mentorat exclusif. Ils sont flexibles lorsqu'ils changent de rôle, de site et de zone géographique. Grâce à une série d'opportunités intenses et progressivement stimulantes au sein de notre réseau d'opérations de premier ordre, nous allons exploiter au maximum votre capacité de leadership. Les leçons commerciales que vous en tirez et la crédibilité que vous développez vous permettront d'accélérer votre carrière et de saisir de futures opportunités de leadership au sein d'Amazon Operations et au-delà.

Key job responsibilities
Les responsabilités incluent, sans s'y limiter :

- Diriger des projets d'amélioration continue susceptibles d'avoir un impact sur la sécurité, la productivité, la qualité et, surtout, l'expérience client
- Élaborer des procédures opérationnelles standard
- Responsabilité directe en matière de définition et d'atteinte des objectifs opérationnels
- Concepts standardisés en matière de portée et de conception
- Suivez les leaders des opérations pour découvrir ce qu'il faut pour devenir manager chez Amazon
- Avec le soutien de la direction, dirigez de grandes équipes pendant les différentes équipes
- Découvrez comment les dirigeants publient des évaluations économiques hebdomadaires de leurs sites et les aident à les préparer
- Collaborez avec la haute direction et les équipes d'assistance, notamment en matière de sécurité, d'ingénierie, de prévention des pertes, d'assurance qualité et de ressources humaines, afin d'élaborer des plans visant à atteindre les objectifs commerciaux


A day in the life
Ce poste est basé dans l'un de nos entrepôts en France. Les lieux sont sujets à changement.

Pour avoir un aperçu du fonctionnement de nos réseaux, rejoignez-nous pour une visite vidéo de l'un de nos centres de distribution :

https://www.amazontours.com/de/

Avantages

Les avantages peuvent varier selon le lieu de résidence, y compris, mais sans s'y limiter :
- Un programme de relocalisation
- Un code de réduction pour les employés
- Prestations pour soins familiaux
- Assurance-vie
- Programme d'assistance aux employés fournissant un soutien confidentiel gratuit en matière de santé mentale, d'événements de la vie, de vie quotidienne et de questions financières
- Prestations médicales à l'étranger pour les voyages d'affaires internationaux
- Des groupes d'affinité pour créer des communautés et rassembler les employés du monde entier (en savoir plus sur https://www.aboutamazon.com/affinity-groups)

Basic qualifications

- Actuellement inscrite à un MBA/PhD et disponible pendant 10 à 12 semaines entre juin et septembre pour travailler à plein temps
- Plus de 3 ans d'expérience professionnelle complexe (hors stages et études en alternance) en tant que responsable de la gestion et de la réalisation de projets
- Très bonne maîtrise du français (CECR B2) et de l'anglais au moment de la candidature
- Expérience dans la direction de projets ou d'équipes
- Expérience professionnelle dans les domaines de l'ingénierie, de la gestion, de la logistique, de la fabrication, des sciences ou dans tout autre domaine des STEM
- Flexible pour travailler selon des horaires non traditionnels, y compris la nuit et le week-end
- Ouvert à la relocalisation dans le pays dans lequel vous avez postulé pour travailler
- Capacités d'analyse et bon jugement commercial
- A réalisé des projets complexes, dans le cadre desquels vous avez dû impliquer des équipes et des dirigeants pour réaliser des initiatives ou des objectifs commerciaux

Preferred qualifications

- Aptitudes démontrables à prendre des décisions, vous permettant d'utiliser un raisonnement solide selon les besoins
- Expérience de gestion directe des employés et de leurs performances
- Expérience antérieure dans la définition, le suivi et l'amélioration de KPI ou de mesures similaires
- Expérience réussie en matière d'assistance à des clients internes ou externes
- Compétences interpersonnelles et de communication exceptionnelles (écrites et verbales)
- Connaissance des techniques et méthodologies Lean, Six Sigma ou Kaizen

Amazon est un employeur engagé pour l'égalité des chances. Nous sommes convaincus qu'une main d'oeuvre diversifée est essentielle à notre réussite. Nous prenons nos décisions de recrutement en fonction de votre expérience et de vos compétences. Nous apprécions votre envie de découvrir, d'inventer, de simplifier et de construire. La protection de votre vie privée et la sécurité de vos données constituent depuis longtemps une priorité absolue pour Amazon. Veuillez consulter notre Politique de Confidentialité pour en savoir plus sur la façon dont nous collectons, utilisons et traitons les données personnelles de nos candidats.

title: Data Center Technician, Data Center Operations
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking Data Center Technicians to support our customers in multiple locations. This position requires the successful candidate report to a site location.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is a fast-paced technology company and a leader in the world of data centers. The position will help ensure overall availability and reliability to meet or exceed defined service levels of data center operations. This position may involve participation in an primary responder rotation, which includes monitoring the data center infrastructure, coordinating response to operational incidents, and partnering with other teams to rapidly resolve issues that impact service availability. Primary responder responsibilities may require evening, weekend, holiday, and/or night work to ensure our global data centers are operating at the highest levels of reliability for our customers. All candidates should be willing to work both independently and with a team. Work prioritization, organizational skills, effective communication, and the ability to react quickly are critical to success. In addition to hardware and network repair candidates will install equipment, create documentation, innovate solutions, and fix problems within the data center space. This team works in an environment that operates 24/7. Traveling within and outside of regional work area is required. You will be responsible for having a reliable personal vehicle and valid driver's license to travel within the regional work area, as company transportation will not be provided.


All physical requirements are expected with reasonable accommodations:
• Regularly lift and/or move up to 40 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 41+ pounds
• Ability to work in an environment that operates 24/7 with an ability to participate in primary responder rotation and provide after-hours support as needed
• Working in cramped and/or elevated and/or noisy environments
• Bending, lifting, stretching, reaching, standing and walking for up to 8+ hours a day
• Ascending and descending ladders, stairs, and gangways safely and without limitation

NOTE: Amazon is not able to provide sponsorship now or in the future for these positions. Eligible candidates must have work authorization without employer intervention to be considered.

NOTE: If applying for positions in Oregon (OR) and Ohio (OH), these sites are within AWS GovCloud region. Effective May 15, 2017, logical access to the AWS GovCloud region will be restricted to Amazon employees who are U.S. Citizens (GovCloud may NOT be accessed from outside of the United States).


Key job responsibilities
• Performing server rack installations, hardware break-fix on various components, troubleshooting network issues, and responding to operational incidents that impact service availability, escalating to senior technicians and management as needed/required
• Serving as a primary contact point for both internal and external stakeholders, including engineers, software developers, vendors, and contractors
• Performing on-call duties and participating in scheduled maintenance and change management activities
• Contributing to documentation and process improvement initiatives based on your analysis of operational issues
• Helping to train and onboard new team members

SECTION: A day in the life
As a Data Center Technician professional, you have industry-leading technical abilities and demonstrate a breadth of knowledge while you:
• Take ownership of technical issues brought by their customer base, engaging other teams when needed to drive resolution
• Solve problems at their root and step back to understand the broader context
• Maintain service level agreements through the implementation of proactive issue detection and reporting

You will be required to work shift work that will include days/nights/weekends/holidays. Traveling within and outside of regional work area is required. You will be responsible for having a reliable personal vehicle and valid driver's license to travel within the regional work area, as company transportation will not be provided.

About the team
Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

- 2+ years of computer hardware troubleshooting and repair experience
- 1+ years of computer networking experience

title: Data Center Engineering. Operations Facility Manager, ADC InfraOps DCEO
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a Data Center Facility Manager to serve as a technical resource and leader within Amazon data centers. The position will help ensure overall availability and reliability to meet or exceed defined service levels of data center operations. The Data Center Facility Manager is responsible for the overall operation and maintenance of all electrical, mechanical, and HVAC equipment within the data center. The Data Center Facility Manager will assist in maintaining a high reliability and performance while keeping operating costs in facilities at a minimum. This equipment supports mission-critical servers and must maintain better than 99.999% uptime.

This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including electrical support equipment such as stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems that include but not limited to switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAC units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire suppression systems, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US citizen and currently possess and maintain an active Top Secret security clearance with SCI eligibility.

Key job responsibilities
- Oversee all aspects of the data center's critical physical infrastructure. Ensure that all work performed within the space is done to high quality and without impact to internal/external customers
- Manage teams of 24x7 engineering technicians in all facets of their career
- Engage in improvement projects, often requiring reaching out to a variety of support teams, and drive them from conception to completion
- Coordinates daily with a multitude of third party vendors ensuring adherence to contracted SLAs
- Effectively and efficiently manage the operations budget and expenditures
- Routinely operate as the afterhours on-call Data Center Facility Manager for the data centers in the region. This will include responding to any issues within the data centers and managing the investigation, mitigation, and recovery of the issue(s).

Physical Requirements:
- Walk jobsites in uneven terrain.
- Work at heights and from ladders.
- Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or craw.
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 49 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 50 pounds or more.
- Carry objects weighing up to 49 pounds for short distances
- Work shifts longer than eight hours in duration.
- Respond to off hour emergency calls.
- Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder
- Coordinate body movements when using tools or equipment
- Reach and stretch to position equipment and fixtures while maintaining balance
- Bend or twist the body into unusual positions while working
- Perform physical tasks all day without becoming overly tired
- Use hands to manipulate small wires and objects

Amazon is looking for an energetic, detail-oriented individual to join our Data Center Engineering Operations Team in the Greater Milan Area. Specifically, this team works to ensure that the data center's MEP operates at 100% availability while maintaining first-class customer service to the teams and groups within the data centers.

The Data Center Chief Engineer (CE) is responsible for ensuring that all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center is operating at peak efficiency. This involves both planned preventative maintenance of equipment, daily corrective work, and emergency response to emergent issues. The CE serves as an expert technical resource interacting with onsite Engineering Operations Technicians (EOT) and any third party vendors. They are expected to be a singular focal point for all facility operations and to support Amazon within its owned and operated data centers.

Also expected from the CE is the ability to manage large scale impacting projects and new region support from conception to completion. These projects involve large amounts of independent work as well as collaboration with external support groups including engineering, automation, procurement, and finance in both local and global settings. The CE will be tasked with creating and delivering on key milestones, obtaining and tracking quotes for all necessary costs, and documenting project results for future implementation at other facilities. The goals of such projects are for the CE to drive innovation and resiliency while reducing operational costs in the facilities.

The CE directs, trains and supports EOTs in their role of providing hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting and operations. Implementation and execution of site/equipment-specific training exercises is also expected. This equipment includes, but is not limited to, stand-by diesel generators, switchgear, UPSs, PDUs, AHUs, chillers, cooling towers, chemical treatment systems, pumps, motors, VFDs, and building automation systems.

The role will be based in the Greater Milan area, however flexibility is required to travel to other locations within the EMEA region if required.


Key job responsibilities
- Oversee the day-to-day operations and maintenance of mechanical and electrical equipment in data centers
- Assist in the design and build out of new facilities

- Perform root cause analysis of equipment failures
- Troubleshoot and report of facility and data sever-level events within internal SLA
- Create and deploy new standard practices for Engineering Operations Technicians, Chief Engineers, and vendor support teams
- Provide training and guidance to Engineering Operations Technicians and assisting in recruiting efforts for the same
- Ensure all safety procedures are adhered to by vendor and Amazon staff
- Utilize internal Change Management Systems to manage building workflows
- MV/LV Isolation to facilitate MV maintenance
- Provide metric availability reporting on a weekly basis

- Ability to solve problems at their root, stepping back to understand the broader context.
- Aptitude for troubleshooting and problem solving.
- Ability to maintain SLAs through the implementation of proactive issue detection and immediate response.
- Proven experience of reading SLDs and control schematics.
- Ability to follow support procedures, system documentation, and issue tracking entries into a trouble ticket system.
- Shows good judgment and instincts in decision making.
- Ability to prioritize in complex, fast-paced environment.
- Ability to demonstrate their ability to take ownership of technical issues brought to them by their customer base

title: Engineering Operations Technician, RNO101
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for an Engineering Operations Technician to join our team at Amazon. You will operate, maintain, and troubleshoot the electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety systems that power a new machine learning cluster serving internal engineering teams who train and deploy large-scale models. Your technical judgment will help keep this infrastructure highly available — directly supporting the compute capacity that these teams depend on to meet production deadlines.

You will work with three-phase electrical systems including switchgear, uninterruptible power supplies, power distribution units, and battery systems, along with mechanical systems such as chillers, cooling towers, air handlers, and pumps. You will identify equipment deficiencies, complete risk assessments, and improve processes that keep the facility running well. This is a ground-floor opportunity to grow with a site that has years of expansion ahead.

Key job responsibilities
- Operate and maintain electrical and mechanical infrastructure including generators, switchgear, uninterruptible power supplies, chillers, cooling towers, and air handling units while following safety protocols
- Troubleshoot moderate to high-complexity equipment issues using technical documentation, prints, and drawings, and escalate abnormal conditions to site leadership as needed
- Review operational dashboards to assess site conditions, plan preventive and corrective maintenance, and carry out change management procedures
- Coordinate with vendors on-site to ensure contractor work meets established procedures, safety standards, and site requirements
- Train and mentor less-experienced team members on equipment operation, maintenance procedures, and troubleshooting

A day in the life
You will start your shift by checking dashboards and outstanding work orders to figure out what needs attention first. From there, you might walk the building to inspect equipment, respond to alarms from the Building Management System, or run scheduled maintenance on generators or cooling systems. You will work with your Facility Manager on any emerging issues and bring in vendors when specialized help is needed. You will also log what you find and update maintenance records so the rest of the team stays informed.

About the team
Our team supports a new machine learning cluster at Amazon, providing the power and cooling that keep thousands of accelerator hosts online around the clock. We are hands-on engineers and technicians who work across electrical, mechanical, and controls disciplines to fix problems and improve how we operate. You will work closely with your peers and site leadership to maintain the systems that enable uninterrupted model training and inference workloads.

Because this cluster is new, you will help build operational processes from the start and grow with the facility over the coming years. There is room to deepen your technical skills, take on process improvement work, and move into more senior roles in critical facility engineering.

- 2+ years of electrical and mechanical facilities maintenance, or 2+ years of electrical facilities maintenance and 1+ years of mechanical facilities maintenance experience

As part of the AWS Managed Operations team, you will play a pivotal role in building, operating and evolving operations and development teams dedicated to delivering high-availability AWS services, including EC2, S3, Dynamo, Lambda, and Bedrock, exclusively for EU customers. For more information on ESC please check out our blog: https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/aws/in-the-works-aws-european-sovereign-cloud/

Your responsibilities will encompass overseeing the ongoing operations and expansion of the ESC, working closely with global AWS teams, and influencing the evolution of AWS services and technology. A typical day in this role involves collaborating with technology leaders, contributing to the enhancement of day-to-day operations, and ensuring continuous improvements in availability, reliability, latency, performance, and efficiency of the ESC. You will be required to occasionally participate in “on-call” rotations to resolve incidents occurring out-of-hours.

The overarching goal is to deliver scalable services and ensure a high-availability experience for EU customers. If you are an experienced professional ready for a challenging and impactful opportunity, we invite you to join our efforts in operating and scaling a best-in-class development engineering and operations team that aligns with AWS' commitment to customer satisfaction and continual innovation.




A day in the life
Embark on a week filled with meaningful contributions to the operation and improvement of significant software systems. You dedicate a substantial portion of your time to carefully review the operational health of services within your team's responsibility. In the process, you diligently identify anomalies and craft actionable bug reports, aspiring to enhance the overall efficiency and performance of your systems.

In addition to these responsibilities, you offer constructive feedback on change management documents and work earnestly to address your team's operational backlog. Through a collaborative effort, you strive to navigate challenges and ensure the seamless functionality of your systems. Additionally, you engage in the development and testing of scripts, hoping to provide practical solutions to enhance your workflows.

Beyond the technical aspects, you assume a role as an educator, sharing insights on the complexities of the European Sovereign Cloud with service teams. It's a humbling experience for you to contribute to the collective knowledge of the team, fostering a culture of mutual understanding.

This week encapsulates your commitment to continuous learning and improvement, acknowledging that every effort, no matter how small, contributes to the collective success of your team and the reliability of your software systems.

In addition to these responsibilities, your position involves 24x7 on-call responsibility. You work as a team to root-cause issues and ensure your systems remain resilient and fault-tolerant, underscoring your commitment to maintaining operational excellence.

* Fluency in written and spoken English is required.
* Candidate must be a national of an EU member state and residing in the EU to operate the AWS European Sovereign Cloud.
* Amazon will provide relocation support for successful applicants relocating within the European Union.

AWS Utility Computing (UC) provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. title: Senior Manager, Contact Center & Customer Support, Amazon Travel and Events
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, innovative and driven leaders. We are seeking an experienced and innovative Senior Manager of Contact Center & Customer Support to build, scale, and operate the support organization behind a global travel and events program spanning 60+ countries. This leader will own the end-to-end contact center operating model, from strategy and technology implementation to daily performance, ensuring all customers including travelers, arrangers, event planners, and internal stakeholders receive fast, consistent, high-quality support across every channel, time zone, and language.

This is a builder role for a leader who has stood up or transformed a contact center function, designing the operating model, building the organization, and setting the standards that a global operation runs on. The right candidate brings the discipline of SLAs, KPIs, case management, and technology-enabled automation that a 24/7 travel and events program spanning 60+ countries demands. Deep familiarity with the travel, hospitality, and events industry (bookings, intake, changes, disruptions, traveler safety, vendor/supplier coordination) is essential to earning credibility with the business and designing support workflows that fit how travel and events programs must operate.

This role oversees the development of front line customer care and contact center automation and is accountable for setting the strategic direction across the functions automation, AI, and self-service goals.

Key job responsibilities
Strategy & Operating Model
- Design, build, and continuously improve a structured contact center operating model including workflows, service standards, escalation paths, quality expectations, performance metrics, and reporting cadence fit for a global, multi-country, multi-language travel and events program.
- Define the channel strategy (phone, chat, messaging, email, social, self-service, in-app) and the customer journey across planning, booking, pre-trip/event, in-trip/event disruption/emergency support, and post-trip/event resolution.
- Partner with regional and global stakeholders to ensure the support model reflects local regulatory, language, and cultural requirements across all 60+ countries while maintaining a globally consistent standard of service.
- Act as a strategic partner to senior leadership, bringing data-driven recommendations on staffing, technology investment, and process design to executive planning and business reviews; drive automation and reduce operating costs.
- Influence cross-organizational priorities aligning technology, product, procurement, and regional operations teams around a shared support vision without direct reporting authority over those teams

Technology, Automation & AI
- Own the cross-channel automation strategy (based on the data and customer insight that frames the problem to solve) panning voice, chat, messaging, email, and social, other. Sets the customer experience using automation capabilities and systems that understand and respond to customer requests and automates repetitive back office workflows.
- Partner with internal technology teams including product managers to drive the contact center technology roadmap leveraging world-class solutions including the telephony platform, case/ticket management systems, workforce management tools, and AI-enabled support.
- Drive the agent-assist technology roadmap including AI-generated summaries, real-time suggestions, knowledge retrieval, and speech/interaction analytics to improve agent efficiency and customer outcomes.
- Identify and implement automation opportunities that reduce cost-to-serve while improving speed and consistency of resolution, with clear governance around accuracy, data privacy, security, and human oversight for AI-assisted support.
- Set the vision for personalization and proactive support experiences across channels, leveraging customer journey data, sentiment analysis, and behavioral analytics.
- Build the requirements for new tools and solutions; manage third-party vendor relationships, contracts, and performance against SLAs.
- Drive adoption of self-service and containment strategies appropriate to travel and events support to free agents for complex, high-touch, or time-sensitive cases (disruptions, emergencies).

Process & Case Management
- Establish and enforce superior case/ticket management practices: intake, triage, prioritization, ownership, escalation, and closure, ensuring nothing falls through the cracks in a high-volume, always-on environment.
- Develop and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and playbooks for common and edge-case travel and events scenarios (cancellations, rebookings, disruptions, emergencies, VIP handling, vendor escalations).
- Lead root-cause analysis on recurring issues, automation failures, and escalation patterns turning support data into upstream fixes with product, policy, technology and supplier/vendor teams.
- Build scalable processes that flex with seasonality, program growth, and new market/country launches without degrading service.
- Drive a culture of continuous process improvement leveraging structured methodologies (Lean, Six Sigma) to systematically eliminate waste and improve quality.

Performance Management: SLAs & KPIs
- Own and continuously refine the performance dashboard: response time, resolution time, first-contact resolution, abandonment rate, service level (SL%), CSAT/CES/NPS, quality scores, schedule adherence, cost-to-serve, deflection rate, average handling time impact, and automation containment rate.
- Leverage journey analytics, speech analytics, and real-time interaction analytics to identify optimization opportunities across channels and automation touchpoints.
- Set clear SLAs and KPIs by channel, region, and case type, and hold the organization accountable through regular operating cadences (daily/weekly/monthly/quarterly reviews).
- Build forecasting, staffing, and capacity models that account for global time zones, seasonality (peak travel periods), and event-driven volume spikes.
- Translate performance data into action plans that close gaps in service levels, quality, or efficiency.

Workforce & Leadership
- Lead the contact center function through managers, supervisors, and specialized leads setting strategy, priorities, budgets, and performance expectations, and developing bench strength for succession.
- Ensure automation strategy is tightly integrated with workforce planning as self-service and AI capabilities mature, proactively realign agent roles, training, skill requirements, and capacity models.
- Build a culture of accountability, customer focus, continuous improvement, and data-driven decision-making across a globally distributed team (in-house and/or outsourced/BPO).
- Own recruiting, training curricula, coaching frameworks, and quality assurance programs that scale across regions and languages including agent readiness for new automation tools and workflows.
- Manage relationships with outsourced partners where applicable, including performance management and program economics.

Financial & Vendor Stewardship
- Own the contact center budget: staffing, technology, and vendor costs balancing service quality with cost-to-serve discipline.
- Manage strategic vendor and supplier relationships (technology platforms, business partners, travel suppliers) including contract performance and renewal strategy.

Basic qualifications

- 10+ years of progressive experience in contact center, customer support, or customer experience operations, including experience building or transforming a support function at scale.
- Direct experience implementing and migrating contact center technology, workforce management, and AI/automation tools.
- Track record of building and managing SLAs and KPIs in a high-volume, multi-channel environment.
- Experience operating a support function across multiple countries, languages, and time zones global or regional (EMEA/APAC/Americas) scope strongly preferred.
- Strong analytical skills; comfortable building and interpreting dashboards, forecasts, and business cases.
- Excellent executive communication skills and experience influencing senior stakeholders.
- Bachelor's degree required; MBA or related advanced degree a plus.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in the travel, hospitality, or events industry (corporate travel, travel management, hospitality, airlines, or events) understanding of booking and event systems, itinerary management, travel disruption response, and traveler duty-of-care.
- Experience managing in-house or outsourced contact center partners.
- Familiarity with 24/7 or "follow-the-sun" support models and after-hours/emergency travel assistance programs.
- Change management experience leading an organization through technology or process transformation.
- Experience with contact center automation, conversational AI platforms at scale.
- Familiarity with speech analytics, journey analytics, or real-time interaction analytics.
- Background in Lean, Six Sigma, or structured process improvement methodologies.

title: Security and Loss Prevention Expert, NA
descriptionHtml:
The Security and Loss Prevention Expert (SLP Expert) is a key leadership position within the Amazon Security and Loss Prevention (S&LP) team. This role leads the effort to efficiently and effectively provide End-to-End (E2E) S&LP services across all assigned operational business units. This position reports to the SLP Cluster Manager.

Key job responsibilities
* Identify vulnerabilities and conduct root cause analysis using data to define mitigating actions while ensuring compliance with legal and ethical standards.
* Actively monitor and report outcome for systems and tools that generate data indicating site/region opportunities.
* Manage confidential investigations and prepare prompt reports of theft, fraud, and workplace violence/critical incidents.
* Utilize continuous improvement to drive process enhancements and increase efficiency.
* Serve as department's liaison and security/crisis management subject matter expert keeping site leadership informed on department's key issues, strategies and the performance.
* Identify, promote and implement security best practices while effectively partnering with internal customers to evaluate current and future security needs, processes, and initiatives, incident response planning, facilitating and management.
* Domestic regional travel up to 50% of the time when applicable.
* Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach; Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts; Work in an environment where the noise level varies and can be loud; Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments); Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs).
* This role covers 24/7 operations and must be able to work all shifts, including nights, weekends, and holidays.

A day in the life
As a SLP Expert, you will join a team of S&LP professionals providing security as a service to business customers across multiple business units within a dedicated geographical area. You perform regular physical security audits and investigate policy violations, security-related incidents, and loss events. During your investigations, you will collect information by monitoring systems and tools, analyzing data reports, and conducting interviews. Your findings contribute to identifying vulnerabilities in various processes to identify and drive mitigating measures. You play a key role in maintaining the physical integrity of our sites by auditing and monitoring the health status of our systems and, jointly with subject matter experts and external suppliers, maintain their functionality. Furthermore, you identify and act upon initiatives improving our physical security infrastructure and contribute directly to the budgetary planning for our external suppliers. You interact on a daily basis with our external security service providers to ensure delivery of high-quality security services and a smooth customer experience. You will be working on multiple high-impact initiatives/projects by collaborating with stakeholders across organizational levels to deliver measurable outcomes through effective project management. Finally, you deliver loss prevention-related education and awareness programs to other teams across all management levels and manage the implementation of our S&LP plan.

About the team
Worldwide Operations Security (WWOS) is the global organization that supports field Loss Prevention and is designed to support Amazon's Worldwide Operations, as well as affiliate and retail businesses, by creating and maintaining a work environment that is both prepared and secure through global security centers of excellence staffed by subject matter experts in people and asset protection. We accomplish this by creating policy and implementation guidelines; training leadership and staff; using technology to eliminate subjectivity, complexity, and variation; identifying, preparing for, and mitigating risk; and auditing our practices to ensure compliance.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 4+ years of relevant professional or military experience
- 2+ years of security service, loss prevention, asset protection, investigations, or law enforcement, or 2+ years of Amazon (Blue Badge/FTE) experience

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in implementing metric-based strategies utilizing continuous improvement concepts
- Experience in physical security systems maintenance/implementation and coordinating scope of work with security vendors
- 2+ years of operational experience in risk management, audit, data analytics, inventory control, quality assurance, retail, warehouse, distribution center services, delivery service, or supply chain
- Investigative interviewing experience; Wicklander and Zulawski, Loss Prevention Qualified, Certified Protection Professional, Loss Prevention Certified, Certified Forensic Interviewer, Certified Threat Assessment Certification or other relevant certifications
- Workplace incident mitigation or de-escalation and business continuity planning experience
- Proficient in Microsoft Office; including use of Excel pivot tables and development of charts/graphics

title: Automation Engineer, AMZL
descriptionHtml:
*Note this role will require travel between regional sites within North West England and Ireland*

Operations is at the heart of everything Amazon does, and automation is one of the ways we optimise our processes. As an Automation Engineer, you’ll make sure that our automated systems are working at their best so that our customers get their orders on time. By exploring data on everything from control systems to sensors, you’ll maximise the availability of equipment at your sites. This role puts you at the forefront of Amazon’s emerging technology to solve complex productivity challenges.



Key job responsibilities
- Monitor, troubleshoot and repair issues with key systems
- Work with the EU Controls network to monitor
- Material Handling Equipment (MHE) metrics
- Provide data visualisations of troubleshooting to internal stakeholders
- Own or actively participate in continuous improvement projects run by the EU Controls network
- Work with different departments to ensure all systems are correctly documented and that accurate backup libraries are maintained
- Work with global colleagues to install and commission new equipment
- Support other sites in the EU Controls network as needed
- Interpret mechanical and electrical drawings, and develop improvement strategies for code conforming to IEC 61131-3

A day in the life
As an Automation Engineer, you’ll be the site expert when it comes to keeping key automated systems running smoothly. You’ll be working with our automation machinery, from conveyors to sortation systems, and ensuring they’re working efficiently. If something has gone wrong or can be done better, you’ll take the lead in coming up with and implementing a solution.

You’ll also share your expertise with your close colleagues. You’ll be keeping your Engineering Technicians up to date with device troubleshooting and preventative maintenance control training, so that your team can keep our automation systems in order.

About the team
Our Reliability Maintenance Engineering or RME team keep our equipment performing at its best. We're a technically minded team, made up of excellent team players and guided by experienced leaders. We work together to maintain, troubleshoot and repair equipment across our global network of fulfilment centres. Some of our people are leaders, who oversee the team as they work on exciting technology – some of which only exists at Amazon.

From installing automated packaging systems to overseeing the general maintenance of a site to repairing key distribution equipment, our team handles most aspects of Amazon’s technical side. This includes keeping buildings legally compliant, so everyone is safe, and our sites are operating at maximum efficiency. There are lots of opportunities for progression, both within the RME team and more widely across Amazon.

Everything we do focuses on reducing downtime in Amazon’s crucial operations sites, so customers get their orders on time. We often work during early or late hours to carry out maintenance with minimal disruption, including night shifts. If we spot a better way to do something, we have the skills and the opportunity to develop and introduce completely new processes or cutting-edge tech like Amazon Robotics and our Complex Item Sorter.

Basic qualifications

- Experience with PLC controlled automation and issue diagnosis in a continuous process or production environment
- Relevant experience supporting different conveyors and sortation systems
- Relevant experience dealing with material handling, flow and capacity visualisation, and monitoring
- Experience with at least one of the following tools:
- Microsoft Office, project management tools and EPLAN
- Ladder Logic and structure programming from Siemens, Allen-Brady or Codesys PLCs
- Ignition SCADA or similar platform and Human Machine Interface (HMI)
- EthernetIP, Profinet, Profibus and AS-i or other fieldbus networks
- VFDs, safety gateways and input and output devices
- Advanced proficiency in verbal and written English and local language

Preferred qualifications

- A degree in computer science, electrical engineering, industrial electronics or another technical subject
- Experience working within ISO 13849 and ISO 62061 frameworks
- Experience working in a multi-site environment
- Project management experience with multiple frameworks such as Agile and Waterfall
- Experience of Six Sigma, data analysis or process improvement techniques

title: Software Engineer, S3 Discovery
descriptionHtml:
Managing trillions of objects in storage, retrieving them in sub-x ms, building software that deploys to tens of thousands of hosts, achieving 99.999999999% (you didn’t read that wrong, that’s 11 nines!) durability. These are just a few of the numbers that give you a sense of the scale of the exciting problems you will find every day working in Simple Storage Service (S3). Amazon S3 powers businesses across e globe that make the lives of consumers better daily. Whether its electronic content delivered to your home, technology that betters your remote working experience, allows you to plan travel to exotic places or simply get stuff delivered to your home.

As a Software Development Engineer in the S3 Distribution Plane team, you will deliver services at scale to delight our customers and support the routing of billions of requests per minute to S3’s globally distributed server fleet. You will have the opportunity to design and develop systems and services in the domains of DNS, IP and Network Connectivity, TLS Certificates, VPC Endpoints and Private Connectivity. You will work alongside engineers and leaders who obsess about operations, performance, availability, scalability, and durability of customer data. Our services run at scale worldwide and as a member of this team, you will have the opportunity to ship code often, and see the impact your code has on a wide range of S3 customers.

Day to day you will be responsible for designing, delivering and maintaining the operational health of our services, maintaining our build & release systems, and ensuring maximum up-time for our developers and customers. You will provide coaching and mentoring for junior engineers and participate in design reviews, operations meetings and leadership discussions. You will partner with service teams across AWS to build ground-breaking DNS, networking and security solutions in code for S3. You will work closely with the likes of Amazon Route 53, AWS EC2 and AWS Networking to achieve the combined goals of AWS and S3. You will transcend a single organization in order to deliver solutions that require broader integration across AWS. For this reason, thinking big and thinking outside of S3 is one of the key tenets you will have to practise on a daily basis.

As a Software Development Engineer in our team, you are constantly striving to raise our operational bar and improve our infrastructure, enabling our teams to move faster. Your responsibilities will include:

Developing tools to streamline operations as we scale to reduce operational load and improve our overall operational posture. Influencing & driving operational excellence and best practices within the organization.

Identifying ways to increase the automate and improve our test infrastructure and make our CI/CD more robust and flexible.

Playing a key role in investigating and recommending best practices for maintaining and improving code quality, fleet health, and security & reliability of our service.

Growing our talent through actively mentor junior system development engineers, improving their skills, their knowledge of our systems, and their ability to get things done.

Sharing your knowledge with wider teams and writing clear and concise documentation to allow other system development engineers to get the most out of the service and tools.

Our team works together to provide work/life balance for all team members. We recognize that the circumstances of our team members vary, and we balance work across the team so that we’re all able to maintain high standards on behalf of our customers, while at the same time allowing for rich and happy personal lives.

In AWS, if you build it, you own it. S3 is a highly available 7x24 worldwide service requiring dedicated support from our engineering teams. We pride ourselves on a high level of ownership in the work we do. This means we hold a high bar for test automation, verification processes, design and code reviews to ensure that our systems meet the exacting standards our customers demand. We maintain a regular on-call rotation across our teams with engineers and managers all taking part to resolve the inevitable issues that arise. We work hard to minimize getting paged in the middle of the night as we recognize that a well-rested employee is a productive employee.

Upon joining S3, every employee is paired with a peer buddy who will help you to quickly come up to speed in understanding the technology we’re building, the tools we use and the business problems we’re trying to solve. We hire exceptional people and we recognize the importance of coaching others. We have a formal mentor search application that lets you find a mentor that works best for you based on location, job family, and job level. On our internal “Broadcast” video streaming website, you’ll find countless presentations by some of the brightest minds in computing discussing solutions to many of the exciting problems we’re solving in AWS today with new live-streaming videos added every week.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We have ten employee-led affinity groups, reaching 40,000 employees in over 190 chapters globally. We have innovative benefit offerings, and host annual and ongoing learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 14 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.

Work/Life Balance
Our team puts a high value on work-life balance. It isn’t about how many hours you spend at home or at work; it’s about the flow you establish that brings energy to both parts of your life. We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.

Mentorship & Career Growth
Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. Our members enjoy one-on-one mentoring and thorough, but kind, code reviews. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded engineer and enable them to take on more complex tasks in the future.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Falls Du für die Stelle umziehst und Deine Heimatadresse mindestens 80 km vom Standort entfernt liegt, unterstützen wir Dich mit einem Umzugsbonus in Höhe von 6.045$ brutto.

Unser Wartungs- und Instandhaltungsteam (Reliability Maintenance Engineering Team oder RME-Team) ist der Kern von Amazons Engagement für Innovation. Amazon entwickelt sich weiter und dieses Team sorgt dafür, dass dies auch die von uns verwendeten Technologien und Tools tun. Als Senior RME Technician hilfst Du uns, der Entwicklung einen Schritt voraus zu bleiben. Du setzt die neuesten Technologien ein und identifizierst neue, effiziente Arbeitsmethoden. In dieser Rolle achtest Du genau auf unsere Prozesse und trägst dazu bei, dass wir unsere höchsten Sicherheitsstandards befolgen und weiter erhöhen.

*** Die Stelle beinhaltet die Arbeit in einem rotierenden Dreischichtsystem, welches Samstage, Nachtschichten sowie Rufbereitschaft umfassen kann. ***

Key job responsibilities
- Best Practice und Unterstützen im Bedienen von Geräten und Anlagen mit den höchsten Sicherheitsstandards
- Verfolgen der Geräteleistung durch visuelle Prüfungen, zustandsorientierte Überwachung und vorbeugende Wartungsmaßnahmen und Einplanen zusätzlicher Wartung je nach Bedarf

title: Business Analyst, Network Strategy and Performance
descriptionHtml:
Business Analyst in Network Strategy and Performance owns owns processes & analytics that directly shape how Amazon serves customers globally. They are an analytical problem solver who is comfortable in a fast-paced, multi-tasked, high-energy environment. They are self-motivated, operating independently in an autonomous environment to deliver an exceptional customer experience with little to no guidance. - Independently apply AI tools (e.g., Amazon Q, generative AI assistants, AgentZ) to accelerate analytical workflows, identifying opportunities to improve speed and quality of outputs.

title: Construction Estimator, AMER Estimating and Cost Control
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. Our Data Center Planning and Delivery (DCPD) organization builds and scales the infrastructure that powers AWS. We are seeking a Construction Estimator specializing in electrical scope to join the newly formed AMER Estimating and Cost Control (ECC) organization as a discipline subject matter expert.

This is a technical individual contributor role. You will provide bottoms-up and top down electrical estimating capability for AWS data center construction across AMER and even globally in collaboration with EMEA and APJC Regional Estimating functions. Your focus spans the full electrical scope of a data center — medium- and low-voltage distribution, switchgear, generators and paralleling, UPS and battery systems, transformers, busway, feeders, grounding, lighting, fire alarm, and the electrical content of mechanical and controls packages.

You will collaborate globally with estimating teams across all AWS regions on BOD cost inputs that inform design standards. When Design Engineering introduces a electrical design change or innovation, you are the first call — delivering rapid, discipline-specific cost impact assessments that enable informed decisions. This role is foundational to ECC’s mission of creating a structured feedback loop between estimate and actual, so estimates improve every cycle.


Key job responsibilities
- Produce detailed, bottoms-up electrical construction cost estimates — MV/LV distribution, switchgear, generators/paralleling, UPS and battery, transformers, busway, feeders, grounding, lighting, and fire alarm
- Collaborate globally with regional estimating teams on Basis of Design (BOD) electrical cost inputs that inform design standards across all AWS regions
- Deliver rapid cost impact assessments for electrical PDCM intercepts, first-of-kind designs, and innovation proposals from Design Engineering
- Support new regions planning with electrical estimates for market entry — pre-GBT cost intelligence where local pricing data is thin
- Perform detailed electrical quantity takeoff and pricing from one-lines, panel schedules, specifications, and design documents at all design stages
- Develop and maintain the electrical cost database — unit rates, $/MW parametric models, and equipment pricing reflecting current market conditions and AWS standards
- Serve as the electrical estimating SME for Estimating Managers, reviewing and validating 3P vendor electrical estimates
- Analyze electrical subcontractor pricing, bid tabulations, and awarded contracts to identify trends, anomalies, and cost optimization opportunities
- Benchmark electrical estimates against portfolio actuals through the estimate-to-actual feedback loop with Cost Control
- Contribute to estimating tools and templates, incorporating lessons learned from completed projects into improved electrical estimating methodologies


A day in the life
Your morning begins with a quantity takeoff on a Design intercept from Design Engineering — a proposed switchgear lineup change that could shorten lead time but adds installed cost. You model the delta against the current BOD electrical estimate and prepare a cost impact memo for DE’s design review.

Midday, you join a global call with electrical estimating counterparts in EMEA and APJC to align on BOD electrical cost inputs — medium-voltage distribution unit rates, generator $/MW, and UPS pricing — for the next design standard revision. Your AMER actuals are the benchmark. Afterward, an Estimating Manager asks you to gut-check a 3P vendor’s electrical estimate; you spot a conduit and feeder routing assumption that doesn’t match the latest one-line and flag it.

You close the day updating your electrical cost database with final account data — a switchgear package landed 6% above estimate in a competitive-bid market. You document the driver and adjust unit rates for the next round of estimates.


About the team
AMER Estimating and Cost Control (ECC) is a newly formed organization within DCPD that unifies Estimating and Cost Control under a single leader. ECC provides end-to-end cost lifecycle ownership — from initial estimate through final account.

You will be one of several Discipline Estimators (Electrical, Mechanical, CSA) working alongside the Estimating Managers who cover cluster groups across AMER, all reporting to the Manager, Construction Estimating (Chief Estimator Equivalent). Estimating provides the inputs — methodology, rates, benchmarks, discipline takeoffs, and 3P vendor products — that support Preconstruction’s owned estimates and CAR deliverables. Your electrical expertise directly supports both project-level estimating and global design standard development.

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
- Knowledge of engineering documentation, electrical diagrams and standard operating procedures
- Knowledge of electrical engineering principles including switchgear, UPS, transformers, and circuit breakers
- Experience interpreting and modifying mechanical and electrical drawings
- 5+ years of experience in electrical construction cost estimating for commercial, industrial, or infrastructure projects
- Demonstrated experience with detailed electrical quantity takeoff and pricing from one-lines, panel schedules, and specifications
- Proficiency with estimating tools (e.g., Accubid, Trimble/McCormick, Bluebeam, On-Screen Takeoff, RSMeans, or equivalent)

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of critical data center equipment

title: Sr Real Estate Development Manager
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking a Senior Real Estate Development Manager to join the Real Estate Development Management (REDM) team within Data Centre Supply Solutions (DCSS) EMEA. Based in London, this role carries responsibility for managing the full lifecycle of data centre developments across EMEA — with assignments spanning the United Kingdom, Ireland, and additional regions as to meet business need.

The REDM function exists because data centre land acquisitions are not simple property transactions. Each development requires complex planning and zoning entitlements navigated through local regulatory frameworks, infrastructure obligations negotiated with statutory authorities, performance bonds managed over multi-year delivery programmes, sustained relationships with Authorities Having Jurisdiction, and coordination across a dozen internal stakeholder teams. Without a Single-Threaded Owner, accountability fragments, decisions drift, costs escalate, and programmes delay.

You will be that owner. You will exercise strategic and commercial judgement across complex, high-value development programmes. You will define and execute strategy with limited guidance, influence outcomes across organisations and geographies, and take end-to-end accountability for the developments assigned to you — from the first introduction of an opportunity through to close-out.

Travel: Regular travel across EMEA

About the Team

The REDM function sits within DCSS EMEA and serves as the Single-Threaded Owner for the development management of all Hybrid, Build-to-Suit (BTS), and Owned Land developments across the region. The team currently manages approximately 60 developments with an aggregated Capital Approval value exceeding $14 billion, spanning 9 regions across EMEA.

The team comprises in-country real estate development professionals positioned across key EMEA markets — including the UK, Germany, Spain, Italy, France, and Ireland — each bringing deep local expertise, regulatory knowledge, and established AHJ relationships in their respective jurisdictions. The function holds a broad and expanding mandate: Single-Threaded Ownership of all Hybrid and BTS development agreements, all Collateral Development Obligations (CDO) and Supporting Public Infrastructure (SPI) on land acquisitions, and all site development permitting from pre-acquisition through to Adoption/Taken-In-Charge (ATIC) and release of securities.

You will join a high-performing, internationally diverse team and work directly with counterparts in Business Development, Design Engineering, Pre-Construction, Construction, Legal, Finance, Environmental, Power, Water, and Public Policy.

The Role

Senior REDMs operate as the development owner — not as a support function, an advisor, or a coordinator. You will be the single point of authority and accountability for every development assigned to you, with the mandate to act on behalf of AWS and the judgement to know when to escalate.

The scope of the role spans three interconnected domains. In practice, you will be working across all three simultaneously:

Development Agreement Management

You will be the STO for Hybrid and BTS development agreements from pre-transaction through to close-out. In the pre-transaction phase, you will provide expert development management input to deal negotiations — shaping the commercial structure, specifications, cost arrangements, risk allocation, and change control provisions that will govern the development. Post-transaction, you will take ownership of delivering against the terms of the agreement: establishing the Development Business Plan, managing costs against approved budgets, managing the counterparty relationship, chairing progress meetings, preparing monthly development reports, and identifying and resolving adverse impacts before they crystallise into programme delay or cost overrun.

You own the budget and the delivery date. You are the only party authorised to instruct change. You exercise commercial judgement daily — on cost challenges, counterparty claims, specification queries, and programme risks — and you are accountable for the outcomes.

Land Development & Permitting

You will lead the entire site development permitting process for land acquisitions in your assigned regions — from the earliest point a land opportunity is introduced, through planning and zoning, CDO/SPI delivery, and onwards to ATIC of completed works and release of securities.

This is where the role demands local expertise. Site development permitting is deeply rooted in local regulation, planning law, and political stakeholder dynamics. It requires you to build and maintain sustained relationships with local planning authorities and government bodies; navigate zoning, planning, and building permit processes with confidence and authority; represent AWS directly before AHJs as the landowner — not through intermediaries; negotiate development obligations, planning agreements, and urban development contracts; and develop permitting and phasing strategies that protect the critical path to capacity delivery.

Your portfolio may include developments across multiple jurisdictions, each with its own regulatory framework. You will be expected to navigate these differences with the adaptability, cultural awareness, and local engagement that the role demands.

Stakeholder Leadership & Cross-Functional Coordination

The REDM sits at the centre of a complex stakeholder ecosystem. Externally, you will manage counterparties, AHJs, local elected officials, statutory undertakers, community stakeholders, and external consultants. Internally, you will coordinate across Business Development, Design Engineering, Pre-Construction, Construction, Legal, Environmental, Power, Water, and Public Policy to ensure strategic and consistent messaging on development goals and priorities.

You will take the central role in strategy and decision-making on all development matters. You will establish the collaboration model with Design Engineering — where DE defines what the Data Centre requires from the site, and you define how to secure those conditions through local processes. You will maintain Memoranda of Understanding with Pre-Construction on infrastructure categorisation and actively lead escalations through the organisation when alignment is not achieved at working level.

What Success Looks Like

Our incumbent Senior REDMs set the benchmark for this role. Across the team, successful performance is characterised by:

Owning a multi-site portfolio of developments worth hundreds of millions of dollars, managing each as an integrated programme with full commercial and programme accountability.

Building and leading the AHJ engagement strategy in-country — establishing direct, senior-level relationships with planning authorities, meeting regularly with council officers and elected representatives, and being recognised as the AWS voice in the room.

Identifying and surfacing material cost savings against approved investment decisions through rigorous analysis of development agreements and obligations.

Leading complex permitting processes end-to-end — including zoning modifications, full planning applications, environmental assessment processes, and planning obligation negotiations.

Establishing the REDM function from the ground up in a new country or region, becoming the coordination hub for the entire development portfolio in that geography.

Developing and owning urban development contracts, inter-administrative agreements, and territorial agreements with municipalities and regional governments.

Driving strategic permitting pathway decisions at critical gates — evaluating alternative routes, recommending approaches, and managing risk where the regulatory environment is uncertain or contested.

Protecting capacity delivery by identifying and mitigating development risks proactively — including regulatory challenge risk, AHJ capacity constraints, design misalignment, and third-party dependencies.

Contributing to the evolution of the REDM function through development of tools, mechanisms, and reporting frameworks that raise the standard across the team.

A day in the life
Infrastructure Services (AIS) AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
