Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, AWS

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fuelled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent in business, management, real estate, or another related field
- 10+ years of progressive experience in real estate development management, infrastructure programme delivery, or development-stage asset management.
- Demonstrable experience as a development manager or equivalent role with end-to-end accountability for programme delivery, cost control, and counterparty or contractor management on complex, multi-stakeholder projects.
- Experience engaging with planning authorities, local government bodies, and regulatory agencies in connection with building permits, zoning, and development consents.
- Experience negotiating and administering commercial development agreements (BTS, forward fund, development agreement, or equivalent structures) including provisions for work scope, cost control, change control, and risk allocation.
- Experience managing development cost plans and budgets at significant scale, with the judgement to challenge costs, exercise audit rights, and protect commercial interests.
- Willingness to travel regularly across EMEA and comply with the 5-day return-to-office policy in London.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience building and cultivating relationships with internal and external stakeholders
- Experience directly related to the design or construction of data centers or critical infrastructure or large-scale mechanical and electrical plants
- Master's degree in a relevant discipline (Real Estate, MBA, Construction Law, Urban Planning, or equivalent) and professional qualification: RICS (MRICS or FRICS), CIOB, RIBA, RTPI, or equivalent.
- Multi-country EMEA experience navigating diverse regulatory frameworks, planning regimes, and cultural contexts.
- Experience with UK and/or Irish planning processes, including planning obligation agreements, environmental assessment, and engagement with local and national planning authorities and Experience with GMP, fixed-price, and open-book development cost structures.
- Experience managing development obligations, urbanisation works, and performance bond or security management over multi-year delivery programmes.
- Fluency in one or more additional European languages (French, German, Italian, or Spanish).

Are you curious about how live data centers are upgraded without switching off the servers that millions of customers depend on?
Do you want to learn how large-scale construction and engineering projects are planned, coordinated, and delivered inside mission-critical facilities?

Cloud computing and generative AI are changing how the world uses technology. Since 2006, AWS has provided companies of all sizes with an infrastructure web services platform in the cloud. The Critical Projects Implementation (CPI) team, part of Data Center Capacity Delivery (DCCD) team, is a project management and execution team that manages construction activity within operational data center spaces. These activities are outside of the scope of standard construction delivery and regular preventative maintenance tasks. descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic Data Center Engineering Operations Team and become a critical architect of the infrastructure that powers global cloud computing. You'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of Amazon Web Services' physical infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that support millions of customers worldwide.
The Data Center Chief Engineer (CE) is responsible for ensuring that all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center is operating at peak efficiency. This involves planned preventative maintenance of equipment, daily corrective work, and emergency response. The CE serves as an expert technical resource interacting with onsite Engineering Operations Technicians (EOT) and any third-party vendors. They are expected to be a singular focal point for all facility operations within a given data center and to support AWS.
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. descriptionHtml:
Application deadline: Nov 11, 2026

We are seeking a talented cleared engineer to help enable and expand AWS Marketplace into isolated and government cloud regions. You'll build the tooling, automation, and infrastructure that empower service teams to deploy into new partitions — from infrastructure-as-code and deployment pipelines to regional onboarding automation and operational support tooling. If you thrive at the intersection of software development, systems engineering, and cloud operations in high-security environments, we want to talk.

Amazon Web Services is seeking a Systems Development Engineer to join the AWS Marketplace Special Regions Enablement Team (SRET), which owns the infrastructure, automation, and deployment tooling that enables Marketplace services to operate in air-gapped government regions. You'll work across the stack — building CDK constructs, CI/CD pipelines, AI-powered operational tooling, and automation that unblock service teams deploying into classified partitions where standard commercial patterns don't apply.

Key job responsibilities
As a Systems Development Engineer you will:

- Design, build, and maintain infrastructure-as-code (CDK/CloudFormation) for deploying Marketplace services into classified partitions

- Build and operate CI/CD pipelines tailored to air-gapped and isolated environments

Our mission is to fundamentally change how customers shop on Amazon by leveraging the state of the art in AI. Every month, hundreds of millions of customers use Alexa for Shopping to help with shopping decisions. title: Junior Logistik Manager - Mannheim
descriptionHtml:
Als Nachwuchsführungskraft wirst du in unserem 11-wöchigen internen Onboarding Programm auf deine neue Aufgabe als Führungskraft vorbereitet.
Nach dieser umfangreichen Einarbeitung übernimmst du Führungsverantwortung für dein eigenes Team und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Kunden Ihre Waren pünktlich und in guter Qualität erhalten. In dieser Position bist du wichtiger Teil unseres globalen Unternehmens und arbeitest Hand in Hand mit deinen Mitarbeitenden vor Ort. Zudem arbeitest du standortübergreifend an Themen wie Arbeitssicherheit, Prozessoptimierung, Nachhaltigkeit und technischem Fortschritt.


Key job responsibilities
- Sicherstellung der Einhaltung der Arbeitssicherheitsvorschriften und des Umweltschutzes
- Ableitung von Handlungsempfehlungen und konkreten Maßnahmen zur Prozessverbesserung auf Basis von Kennzahlen wie Arbeitssicherheit, Produktivität und Qualität
- Leitung und Weiterbildung eines Teams (bis zu 100 Mitarbeitende)
- Planung und Steuerung der innerbetrieblichen Prozesse
- Teilnahme in übergeordneten Projekten zur Optimierung der Kundenzufriedenheit
- Effektives Ressourcen- und Workflowmanagement
- Zusammenarbeit mit den vor- und nachgelagerten Abteilungen vor Ort

A day in the life
Du arbeitest in einer unserer Schichten (Früh-, Spät- oder Nachtschicht). Dabei ist das Einhalten der Sicherheitsstandards an deinem gesamten Standort für dich höchste Priorität. Als Schichtleitung führst du routinemäßig Teammeetings durch und führst Feedbackgespräche mit deinen Mitarbeitenden und deinen Stakeholdern. Mit Hilfe von Datenauswertungen nimmst Du Einfluss auf die Produktivität und die Qualität deines Standortes. Als wichtiges Mitglied des Teams vor Ort arbeitest Du mit anderen Abteilungen, sowie externen Stakeholdern zusammen und sorgst dafür, dass wir die Anforderungen unserer Kundschaft, ebenso wie unsere eigenen Vorgaben jederzeit erfüllen. Durch die Analyse von Daten mit Führungskräften und die Besprechung der betrieblichen Vor- und Nachteile von technischen Verbesserungen mit den Fachabteilungen trägst du zu „best in class“ Lösungen bei.

About the team
Die Logistikabteilung bei Amazon (AMZL) ist für die „Last-Mile-Logistik“ zuständig – also die Auslieferung unserer Pakete in Partnerschaft mit Drittanbietern. Wir denken kreativ und realisieren Initiativen zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung, um Millionen von physischen Produkten an unsere Kund:innen zu liefern. Unser Ziel ist es, das Liefererlebnis für unsere Kund:innen so reibungslos wie möglich zu machen und globale Lieferlösungen für unsere neuesten Angebote einzuführen, darunter Amazon Fresh, Prime Now und Amazon Restaurants.
Diese Tätigkeiten werden von zwei Mitarbeitergruppen ausgeführt. Unsere „internen“ Mitarbeitenden bereiten Millionen von Produkten auf den Versand an unsere Lieferteams vor. Unser Team ist menschenorientiert und hilfsbereit. Das ist besonders wichtig, weil viele unserer Mitarbeitenden in Nachtschichten arbeiten. Unser Fokus liegt vorwiegend auf dem operativen Betrieb. An den meisten unserer Standorte wird rund um die Uhr gearbeitet.
Unsere „Außendienst“-Mitarbeitenden arbeiten währenddessen mit Amazon Flex – einem Auftragnehmer-Netzwerk für die Lieferung. Jedes Jahr setzen wir neue Maßstäbe in puncto Kundenerlebnis und bieten neue, innovative Lieferdienste an. Wir suchen nach neuen Möglichkeiten, um branchenweite Logistikherausforderungen zu überwinden, sowie nach neuen Ideen, um unseren CO2-Fußabdruck zu reduzieren. Ein Fuhrpark innovativer Fahrzeuge (einschließlich E-Fahrzeugen) und modernste Technologie unterstützen uns dabei.

descriptionHtml:
Amazon Transportation Services is looking for a Regional Operations Linehaul Manager to join our ATS Middle Mile Ground Brazil team. This is a senior, high-complexity position that requires experienced leadership to manage middle mile linehaul operations across Southeast region.

In this role, you will lead and optimize linehaul operations at a regional level, ensuring operational excellence across the full middle mile transportation process. Unlike a single-carrier or station-focused role, this position is cross-functional and regional — you will work across all carriers and programs in your region, acting as the bridge between central strategy and local execution.

You will be part of a highly collaborative, dynamic, and innovative environment where ideas are valued and experimentation is encouraged. We are looking for professionals with a strong track record of operational excellence and customer focus, who thrive in fast-moving, ambiguous environments and are ready to lead through complexity and constant change.

If you enjoy challenges and are ready to deliver results in an environment that combines the energy of a start-up with the scale of a global company, we want to meet you.

Key job responsibilities
Regional Operations & Performance Management

• Lead regional linehaul operations cross-functionally across all carriers and programs in the region
• Manage performance of multiple carriers, ensuring achievement of OTP (On-Time Pickup) and OTA (On-Time Arrival) targets
• Conduct daily and weekly operational reviews, leading calls with operational teams and developing action plans for continuous improvement
• Perform Gemba walks and on-road monitoring to identify process gaps and implement corrective actions
• Communicate daily metrics and report exceptions to other operational departments

Carrier Management & Development
• Coordinate onboarding, training and ramp-up of new carriers in the region, including supporting on-site audits
• Implement and scale the Amazon Excellence Program with regional carriers
• Develop strategic relationships with carriers, serving as primary point of contact for performance and problem resolution regionally/locally

Operational Excellence & Cost Management
• Drive continuous improvement initiatives using Lean and Kaizen methodologies
• Identify optimization opportunities and implement solutions to improve operational efficiency
• Contribute to cost reduction initiatives through identification of regional optimization opportunities
• Support regional implementation of network optimization and routing efficiency initiatives

Collaboration & Leadership
• Collaborate with central and represent regional operations in business reviews, act as bridge between central strategy and regional execution
• Serve as voice of carriers within regional operations

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Work a flexible work schedule including evenings, overnights, and weekends
- Experience in managing teams
- Experience in a logistics/operations environment
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English at C1 level or above

title: Supply Chain Manager, Amazon SEND
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a Supply Chain Manager to help scale Amazon SEND, a cross-border logistics solution for FBA sellers worldwide. In this role, you will work backwards from customer problems and partner closely with carriers to elevate the seller experience on Amazon SEND.

You will sit at the core of supply chain innovation, where your ability to drive alignment across internal and external teams directly shapes both seller and carrier outcomes.

You will identify opportunities, lead process improvements, and strengthen the value proposition of Amazon SEND. Success in this role demands expertise in cross-border logistics, strong stakeholder management, and a proven ability to drive progress across diverse teams. If you are a collaborative, data-driven problem solver who wants to deliver impact at scale, we want to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities
- Develop and track performance metrics that measure business results, using data analysis to surface trends and recommend supply chain improvements for cross-border logistics.
- Collaborate with external partners — including carriers and vendors — to negotiate solutions, close deals, and grow shipping volume across international lanes.
- Work with internal teams such as Operations, Procurement, Fulfillment Centers, Seller Support, and Product and Tech to align on priorities and remove roadblocks.
- Monitor cross-border logistics market trends and proactively flag opportunities or risks that affect customer experience and business continuity.
- Build trusted relationships with local and global stakeholders, document findings for leadership, and create process improvements that support the team's goals.


A day in the life
You will start your morning reviewing business metrics and carrier performance dashboards, then jump into calls with partnered carriers to discuss volume targets or resolve operational issues. Midday might find you working with Procurement on a new proposal or pulling together a market trend analysis for your manager. In the afternoon, you will document your findings, update stakeholder reports, and collaborate with teammates to refine outreach strategies — all while picking up best practices and sharpening your analytical skills.

About the team
Amazon SEND is a cross-border logistics solution integrated into Seller Central that enables FBA sellers to ship inventory from their home country to Amazon fulfillment centers in destination countries. The team's mission is to make cross-border shipping easy, reliable, and competitively priced for selling partners located anywhere in the world. We are in an exciting growth phase, actively scaling volume and expanding into new lanes. As part of this team, you will work closely with partnered carriers and collaborate across Amazon to help shape the future of global seller logistics.

- Experience with business development, partnership management, or sourcing new business
- Bachelor's degree

title: Hardware Development Specialist – Harnessing, Amazon Leo DevOps
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

Space-rated wire harnesses don’t get a second chance once they’re integrated onto a satellite — every splice, crimp, and routing decision has to be right the first time. We’re looking for a Hardware Development Specialist who lives and breathes aerospace harnessing: someone who can look at a bundle, a connector, or a routing plan and immediately know whether it meets the standard. You’ll be the harnessing authority inside our development lab — the person engineering teams come to when a new build needs to get off the ground, and the person our harnessing technicians come to when a build needs a second set of expert eyes.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
● Fabricate, inspect, and rework space/aerospace-grade wire harnesses and cable assemblies to standardized workmanship specifications
● Serve as the primary lab point of contact for engineering teams standing up new harness builds — reviewing drawings/ICDs, flagging manufacturability issues, and helping scope build approach before work starts
● Perform quality checks and workmanship verification on harnessing work produced by lab technicians, providing hands-on coaching and correction against workmanship standards
● Support the full arc of harness development: prototyping, development builds, and test/qualification support
● Maintain and troubleshoot harnessing-specific tooling (crimpers, calibration status, splice/solder equipment) and identify process or tooling gaps
● Own harnessing material and lab stock — wire, connectors, backshells, splices, heat shrink, and consumables — including recommending what stock the lab should carry
● Maintain accurate inventory levels, conduct regular stock audits, and flag shortages or obsolete/expired material (e.g., shelf-life-limited adhesives or solder)
● Contribute to and help refine harness build documentation — work instructions, build travelers, inspection criteria
● Operate within documented procedures and standards; escalate ambiguous or non-conforming conditions appropriately rather than making unilateral calls outside the standard


About the team
The Amazon Leo Development Operations (DevOps) team builds and maintains the labs and technical infrastructure that support hardware development across the program — from early prototyping through qualification testing. Our harnessing capability is a critical part of that infrastructure: nearly every subsystem that moves through our labs depends on a harness built right the first time.
We’re looking for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, hands-on development environment and takes real pride in workmanship. You’ll work side-by-side with engineering teams standing up new hardware and with lab technicians building it, so clear communication and a coaching mindset matter as much as technical skill.

Basic qualifications

- Knowledge of tools and measurement devices (oscilloscope, frequency analyzer, or equivalent)
- Can lift up to 49 pounds, stand/walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Experience fabricating, inspecting, and/or reworking wire harnesses or cable assemblies to a standardized workmanship specification such as IPC/WHMA-A-620, NASA-STD-8739.4, MIL-W-5088, or T.O. 1-1A-14 (or service equivalent)
- Experience reading and interpreting wiring diagrams, ICDs, and harness drawings
- Experience with hand tools and equipment used in harness fabrication (crimpers, strippers, splice/solder equipment)
- Associate’s degree in Electronics, Manufacturing Technology, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience

Preferred qualifications

- Current IPC/WHMA-A-620 and/or IPC J-STD-001 (Space Addendum) certification
- Experience supporting satellite, spacecraft, or other space-flight hardware programs
- Experience conducting quality inspections or workmanship audits against IPC/J-STD/NASA/military wiring standards
- Experience managing lab or shop material inventory, including stock audits and shelf-life-limited consumables
- Experience mentoring or training technicians on harnessing techniques and workmanship standards
- Familiarity with data acquisition, instrumentation, or test support in a development lab environment

title: Principal Product Designer, Robot Animation and Character, Fauna
descriptionHtml:
Fauna Robotics is building capable, safe, and delightful robots for everyday life. We are hiring a Principal Product Designer to animate our robots and build a consistent character. This is the person who decides what our robot feels like as a sidekick in someone's home — and the person who animates it to get there.

You are an animator first, at the top of your craft. You will define the robot's personality and its expressive motion vocabulary — how it greets someone, shows curiosity, hesitates, celebrates, or settles into calm — and you will craft the performances that establish it, from first concept through what ships.

This is a hands-on animation and design role. You spend your days animating: blocking performances, refining timing, and dialing in the character. You'll work alongside Design Technologists, HRI researchers, and roboticists who own the tools, pipeline, and hardware — you bring the performance and the personality; they help you land it on a real robot. Our process is iterative and demo-led: block it out, put it on hardware, watch how it reads in the room, and let each pass sharpen the next.

Key job responsibilities
- Craft the robot's key performances — from concept and blocking through final motion — setting the character and the quality bar in the animation itself

- Build the expressive motion vocabulary: locomotion styles, conversational gesture, emotional reactions, idle behavior, and the small moments that make a character feel alive

- Define the robot's personality — its point of view, emotional range, and behavioral signature — and keep it consistent across every animation as the product evolves

- Iterate on real hardware: test how a performance reads in person, from every angle, and refine timing and weight until it lands

- Work with motion capture and reference where it helps, then adapt and refine performances for the robot's form factor and joint constraints

- Capture character intent in animation-ready artifacts — performance references, motion studies, behavioral scripts, and concept videos — so the rest of the team can build on it

About the team
Fauna Robotics, an Amazon company, is building capable, safe, and genuinely delightful robots for everyday life. Our goal is simple: make robots people actually want to live and interact with in everyday human spaces.
We believe that future won’t arrive until building for robotics becomes far more accessible. Today, too much effort is spent reinventing the fundamentals. We’re changing that by developing tightly integrated hardware and software systems that make it faster, safer, and more intuitive to create real-world robotic products.
Our work spans the full stack: mechanical design, control systems, dynamic modeling, and intelligent software. The focus is not just functionality, but experience. We’re building robots that feel responsive, expressive, and genuinely useful.
At Fauna, you’ll work at the frontier of this space, helping define how robots move, manipulate, and interact with people in natural environments. It’s an opportunity to solve hard problems across hardware and software with a team focused on making robotics accessible and joyful to build.
If you care about making robotics real for everyone and building systems that are as delightful as they are capable, we’re interested in hearing from you.

Basic qualifications

- 12+ years of professional experience in character animation
- A body of work — reel required — that demonstrates authorship of character and personality through motion: timing, weight, appeal, and performance
- Mastery of animation craft across a range of characters and emotional registers, from broad performance to subtle, quiet moments
- Experience carrying a character from concept through finished, polished animation
- Ability to work within real production or technical constraints without losing the performance

Preferred qualifications

- Background in feature, episodic, or games animation, or themed entertainment, where animation drives character and story
- Experience animating stylized or non-human characters — robots, creatures, mascots — where personality must come through a non-human form
- Experience with physically embodied characters: robots, animatronics, or real-time/interactive systems where motion plays out in the physical world
- Experience with motion capture: directing sessions, cleaning data, retargeting to non-human characters
- Comfort working within physical or real-time constraints (joint and timing limits, hardware platforms) without losing the performance
- Experience defining character for a new product or franchise, where no performance language exists yet

This role sits at the intersection of our Business Intelligence, Data Engineering, FP&A, Operations, Product and Controllership partners — building out the imports cost reporting pipeline, standardizing the definitions, metrics and KPIs the imports team reports on, and partnering with central FP&A to embed those standards in weekly business reviews, month-end close, and the OP and quarterly guidance cycles.

Key job responsibilities
- Build and own the US Imports cost reporting pipeline in partnership with Business Intelligence and Data Engineering teams, acting as the finance product owner from requirements through acceptance and validation.
- Establish and govern the metric and KPI standards for imports — cost per container, cost per unit, cost per FEU, dwell, utilization and mix ratios — defining the grain and scope boundary for each, and enforcing consistent use across Finance, Operations, and Forecasting teams.
- Support building the network-level cost bridge, decomposing volume/mix/rate variances across all eight import cost legs and reconciling bottoms-up leg builds into one auditable view each reporting cycle.
- Partner with central FP&A to standardize reporting mechanisms across weekly business reviews, month-end close and planning cycles, improving both cycle time and accuracy.
- Proactively identify unowned and misallocated cost streams — new corridors, new program launches, cross-org entitlements — quantify the exposure, and drive each to a named owner.


A day in the life
You will start your day on the network bridge, tracing an unexpected transload adjustment back to a source data field before anyone builds commentary on a number that is incorrect. You might then spend an hour with Data Engineering mapping a new charge code that is currently landing in an unallocated bucket, then give Topology the leg-level cost build for a proposed new node — not a single blended number, but the underlying input assumptions that will actually drive the decision. In the afternoon you settle a definitional conflict with central FP&A where the same cost-per-container figure does not tie between the business review and the planning file because the denominators differ, and you update the template so the decision is enforced by the mechanism instead of by your memory. Throughout, you will balance the recurring weekly and monthly review cadences against the longer-horizon work to streamline and automate recurring issues.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of finance or a related analytical field experience
- Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, business, economics, or a related analytical field (e.g., engineering, math, computer science)

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of identifying incomplete or inaccurate data, identifying the root cause and creating/implementing an escalation plan experience
- 5+ years of solving complex business challenges by delivering accurate and timely financial models, analysis, and recommendations that have a proven impact on business (e.g., financial savings, operational improvements, or customer benefits) experience
- Experience delivering forecasting, budgeting, and variance analysis, and data interpretation of results
- MBA, or CPA

AWS is building a new AI-powered GRC service that delivers continuous compliance, real-time risk quantification, and governance for AI agent workloads. About the Opportunity

The GRC market is $60B+ and undergoing a fundamental transformation. Point-in-time audits are becoming untenable as enterprises operate across multi-cloud and hybrid environments that change daily. AI agents are proliferating faster than compliance programs can adapt. No incumbent GRC vendor has a credible solution for continuous, AI-native governance. AWS is uniquely positioned to win here — and we're building the team to make it happen.

In this role, you will own the product strategy, roadmap, requirements, and go-to-market for a core set of capabilities within a new cloud-native GRC service. You will work backwards from enterprise GRC buyers — compliance officers, risk managers, CISOs, and audit teams — to define what we build and why. You will partner with engineering, science, UX, marketing, sales, and legal to deliver capabilities that win in a competitive and rapidly evolving market.

This is a high-ownership role. You will define the product vision for your area, author PRFAQs and requirements documents, make pricing and packaging decisions, and drive adoption post-launch. You will operate at the intersection of deep domain expertise in compliance/audit/risk and strong technical product management fundamentals.

Key job responsibilities
Leverage deep audit and compliance expertise — direct experience conducting, managing, or overseeing audits — to define product requirements that solve real practitioner pain points

Own the product strategy and roadmap for a core domain within a new AI-powered GRC service — from vision through delivery and adoption

Work backwards from enterprise GRC customers to define requirements, acceptance criteria, and prioritization

Author PRFAQs, pricing narratives, and requirements documents that align engineering execution with customer outcomes

Analyze market trends, competitive landscape, and customer telemetry to identify opportunities and inform prioritization

Work cross-functionally with marketing, field sales, solution architects, professional services, and GSI partners to drive enterprise adoption

Represent the service in customer meetings, industry events, and executive reviews

Influence cross-AWS strategy by collaborating with adjacent governance and security teams to deliver integrated experiences

A day in the life
On a typical day, you might review customer feedback from a Fortune 500 enterprise, author a requirements for a new capability, meet with engineering to finalize scope for the next release train, join a customer call with a solution architect to understand an auditor's workflow, analyze service telemetry to identify adoption blockers, and sync with marketing on positioning for an upcoming industry event. title: Product Quality Analyst, Worldwide Grocery Stores Private Brands Product Quality
descriptionHtml:
The Worldwide Grocery Private Brands team is looking for a Product Quality Manager who is passionate about ensuring our products meet or exceed customer expectations. You will join a dynamic, fast-paced, collaborative work environment where you will help build and scale our business across physical stores and online channels in North America.
This role ensures that products are consistently produced and meet our quality expectations. You will drive activities across several stakeholder teams including Product Development, Category Managers, Food Safety, Marketing, Supply Chain, Operations, and suppliers to ensure the maintenance of quality expectations for our food and other CPG items. The position focuses on monitoring product performance of launched products, managing trend analysis, customer complaint issue identification, and facilitating product and process improvement initiatives with suppliers and internal cross-functional teams.
This is a hands-on role that combines product quality management with laboratory work. In addition to driving quality programs, you will conduct and oversee quality assurance testing, including first production testing, shelf-life verification, and consumer complaint investigations, while maintaining accurate documentation, laboratory equipment, and retention sample inventory. You will also leverage data and mechanisms to identify defects, track quality performance, and drive improvements that maintain customer trust in our brands and products.
The right person for this role must be customer obsessed and enjoy using data and mechanisms to drive improvements. The successful candidate will be self-motivated, comfortable working with data and identifying trends from large data sets, have high attention to detail, a strong vision for quality standards and programs, and the ability to develop sound recommendations for product and process improvements. This candidate must be able to build and maintain strong working relationships across teams, earn trust and influence others, be solution oriented, have solid problem-solving skills, communicate clearly (verbal and written) with technical and non-technical teams alike, and be motivated by a fast-paced dynamic environment.

Key job responsibilities
- Support a robust product quality program across both pre-launch and post-launch initiatives.
- Conduct and oversee laboratory quality testing, including first production testing, shelf-life verification, and consumer complaint investigations; execute testing protocols and document results accurately in designated quality data management systems, adhering to standard operating procedures and safety protocols.
- Maintain laboratory equipment, perform calibration, and manage retention sample inventory and storage monitoring.
- Support the Quality Surveillance program to monitor product performance post-launch, analyzing large sets of customer feedback data (ratings, concessions, complaints) to identify product, process, and supplier improvement opportunities and drive improvement initiatives.
- Support business selection health assessments, influencing cross-functional teams based on quality performance metrics to drive remediation, reformulation, or product discontinuation decisions.
- Use and help optimize quality dashboards and reporting mechanisms to track program, product, and supplier performance metrics.


A day in the life
No two days look exactly alike in this role, but most blend hands-on lab work with product quality program management. You might start your morning in the laboratory, running first-production or shelf-life testing on newly launched items and documenting results in our quality systems, then shift to reviewing customer feedback trends (ratings, concessions, and complaints) to spot emerging quality issues. Throughout the week, you will partner closely with a product category, supporting the product quality development of new items from early formulation through launch, helping ensure quality requirements are built in from the start. By midday, you could be working with Product Development, Food Safety, or a supplier on a defect investigation or a business selection health assessment, translating what the data and the bench tell you into concrete remediation or reformulation recommendations. Afternoons often involve maintaining lab equipment and retention samples, refining a quality dashboard, or preparing performance metrics to influence cross-functional decisions. Throughout, you will balance the precision of laboratory testing with the bigger-picture work of keeping our food and other CPG items meeting the quality standards our customers expect.

About the team
Our team is dedicated to identifying and mitigating WWGS PB product quality risks that protect Amazon's customers, partners, and operations. We work collaboratively across the organization to build and refine the processes, controls, and mechanisms that keep our business compliant and resilient. We value curiosity, clear communication, and a commitment to continuous improvement. As we look ahead, we are focused on scaling our programs and integrating new tools and approaches to stay ahead of emerging challenges. Joining our team means contributing to work that has a direct, meaningful impact on trust and quality at Amazon.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in the Quality Assurance/testing domain
- Experience performing accurate data entry and analysis
- Experience managing multiple projects, prioritizing, planning, and managing time
- Experience handling ambiguous or undefined challenges through strong problem solving abilities
- 2+ years of experience in product or program management, product development, or quality management of food and other CPG items.
- Hands-on experience with laboratory equipment and food testing methodologies (physical, chemical, or microbiological).
- Experience with laboratory equipment maintenance and calibration, and retention sample inventory management.
- Strong analytical skills, including the ability to distill, synthesize, and draw conclusions from large amounts of data.
- Experience in analyzing customer feedback data and trend analysis.
- Excellent communicator (written, oral, presentation), comfortable communicating with technical and non-technical team members.
- Proven track record for cultivating strong relationships with key internal and external partners.
- Ability to drive decisions under time pressure without compromising safety or compliance of products.
- 2+ years of experience using Microsoft Excel.
- Bachelor's degree or above

Preferred qualifications

- Experience interpreting data and making business recommendations across leadership and cross-functional teams
- Bachelor's degree in Food Science, Chemistry, Biology, or a related field.
- Knowledge of HACCP and food safety systems.
- Food manufacturing quality assurance experience, site operations, or site quality controls.
- Familiarity with food industry regulations, standards, and quality management systems.
- Experience with Private Brands or consumer goods manufacturing, preferably in regulated spaces.
- Experience leveraging AI tools, including validating quality of output.
- Diversified experience with the entire product lifecycle and supply chain (R&D, scale-up, material sourcing, operations management, customer feedback).
- Experience with continuous improvement programs and procedures.
- Experience with advanced use of SQL for data mining and business intelligence, or experience working with Excel, reporting tools, and large-scale data mining tools, such as Power BI, Python, SQL, or Tableau

descriptionHtml:
IN Pricing team is looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager (PMM III), to work on the suite of products designed to enable seller to make informed decisions on Pricing, at scale, and with high agility. This role is pivotal in driving adoption of the said products with the end users (Category Managers, Account Managers, Sellers), with both playbook and non-playbook interventions. The role requires a strategic thinker who can translate complex technical capabilities into compelling value propositions, drive stakeholder alignment for increasing adoption, and deliver measurable business impact.

Key job responsibilities
1. Own and execute end-to-end marketing strategies for complex product suites, driving adoption across multiple stakeholder groups and achieving measurable business outcomes.
2. Develop comprehensive go-to-market plans, including product positioning, launch strategies, and adoption frameworks for new and existing products
3. Create and implement user enablement programs, including training materials, playbooks, and documentation to ensure successful product adoption
4. Lead cross-functional initiatives to drive product adoption, working closely with Category Management, Account Management, and Product Management teams
5. Define and track success metrics, conducting deep-dive analyses to optimize performance and identify areas for improvement. Develop and maintain scalable mechanisms for tracking, reporting, and improving product adoption metrics
6. Identify and mitigate adoption barriers through data analysis, stakeholder feedback, and implementation of alternative solutions
7. Influence product roadmaps through voice-of-customer insights, market analysis, and adoption feedback loops, flowing into product roadmap decisions.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- 5+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
- Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
- Experience creating and managing complex, cross-team project plans
- Experience communicating results to stakeholders

Preferred qualifications

- MBA
- Experience using any of SQL or other analytical tools for conducting data analysis
- Experience prior success in driving execution of large-scale project plans with multiple teams in support of business goals

title: Construction Safety Manager, International Construction Safety
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, safety is our top priority. We are looking for a WHS Construction Manager to drive health and safety across our construction projects. In this role you ensure our construction sites and vendors meet Amazon's safety standards and local regulations, partnering with contractors and project teams to embed safe working from design through delivery. You'll be the safety point of contact for construction activity in your area, keeping the people who build our sites safe.

Key job responsibilities
- Ensure construction projects and vendors comply with Amazon safety standards and local construction regulations.
- Conduct construction site safety inspections and review vendor safety documentation.
- Partner with project teams and contractors to embed safe working from design through delivery.
- Track construction safety performance and drive closure of identified gaps.
- Support the wider WHS team in maintaining construction safety standards across projects.

A day in the life
You spend your time between construction sites and project teams, checking that contractors are working safely and in line with Amazon standards and local construction regulations. You carry out site inspections, review vendor safety documentation, and coach project and contractor teams on safe practices. You track safety performance across your projects, flag risks early, and work with vendors to close gaps. One day you're on a live construction site, the next you're reviewing safety plans for an upcoming build.

About the team
The Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) team plays a crucial role in keeping our people mentally and physically well at work. Our team works with managers, associates and local governments across our sites, ensuring compliance with Amazon's policies and legal regulations, and guaranteeing the safety of our work environments. The team offers a variety of opportunities, from Safety Technicians to Programme Managers. Regardless of your role, you'll contribute to the development and implementation of the safety strategy across the entire network.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in English-language communication skills, both written and verbal
- A Bachelor's degree, or equivalent level of qualification in-line with the European Qualifications Framework (EQF), in the Construction, Civil/Structural Engineering, Occupational Safety field.
- Practical understanding and application of WHS risk assessment and safety standards.
- Experience managing health and safety within construction environments.
- Working knowledge of construction safety regulations and vendor/contractor safety management.

Preferred qualifications

- Preferred qualifications are not required to apply for a position at Amazon. If you have all the basic qualifications above, we'd love to hear from you.
- Experience with Lean, 5S or Kaizen methodologies and continuous improvement.
- Experience using data and metrics to identify gaps and drive improvements.
- NEBOSH General Certificate (or equivalent safety certification).
- Experience with digital safety management systems.

title: Program Manager, US-East CPI
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Program Manager to join the Critical Projects Implementation (CPI) team. CPI manages retrofit projects within operational data center spaces, tasked with critical infrastructure improvement projects to optimize utilization of space, power, and cooling within operational data centers around the globe. These activities are outside the scope of standard construction delivery and regular preventative maintenance tasks.

The Program Manager will provide essential operational and administrative support to CPI Project Managers by managing vendor onboarding, access and compliance workflows, financial tracking, tool administration, and closeout enforcement. This role ensures the CPI team operates efficiently and maintains high standards of execution across all administrative functions.

The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, demonstrates strong organizational skills, has a bias for action, and can independently manage multiple administrative workstreams while maintaining exceptional attention to detail. This role requires someone who is comfortable working across multiple systems and stakeholders to drive process compliance and remove barriers for project delivery teams.


Key job responsibilities
Vendor Onboarding & Access Management

Manage end-to-end vendor onboarding including documentation, system setup, and badge/access requests across data center facilities
Monitor training compliance and submit Door Masking/SGR tickets, escalating issues to project managers

Financial & Procurement Support

Follow up on CAR approvals, contract approvals, and PO issues to maintain project schedules
Troubleshoot invoicing discrepancies and track PO utilization by coordinating with Finance, Procurement, and DCSP teams

Tool Administration & Data Quality

Create and configure Procore project shells, manage user access, and conduct regular data quality checks
Track warehouse inventory (receipts, distribution, reconciliation) and collect inputs for business reviews

SLA Enforcement & Compliance

Monitor and enforce MCM and closeout action plan SLA targets, tracking submissions and execution timelines
Generate weekly compliance reports and escalate at-risk items to project managers

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent
- • 2+ years of program or project coordination/administration experience
- • 2+ years of experience working in construction, data center, or critical infrastructure environments
- • Experience with vendor management and onboarding workflows
- • Proficiency in project management tools (Procore, Smartsheet, or similar)
- • Strong written and verbal communication skills
- • Experience with Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook)

Preferred qualifications

- • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Construction Management, or related field
- • Experience with Amazon internal tools (MCM, Procore, ARIBA, COUPA, or similar procurement systems)
- • Knowledge of data center security protocols and access management systems
- • Experience supporting construction project closeout processes
- • Familiarity with PO lifecycle management and invoice reconciliation
- • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams with competing deadlines

title: Delivery Consultant - AI/ML, AWS Professional Services
descriptionHtml:
Are you excited about building software solutions around large, complex Machine Learning (ML) and Artificial Intelligence (AI) systems? Want to help the largest global enterprises derive business value through the adoption and automation of Generative AI (GenAI)? Excited by using massive amounts of disparate data to develop AI/ML models? Eager to learn to apply AI/ML to a diverse array of enterprise use? Thrilled to be a key part of Amazon, who has been investing in Machine Learning for decades - pioneering and shaping the world’s AI technology?

The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled ML Engineer to join our team as a Delivery Consultant at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you'll work closely with customers to design, implement, and manage AWS AI/ML and GenAI solutions that meet their technical requirements and business objectives. You'll be a key player in driving customer success through their cloud journey, providing technical expertise and best practices throughout the ML project lifecycle. You will lead customer-focused project teams as a technical leader, and perform hands-on development of ML solutions with exceptional quality

Possessing a deep understanding of AWS products and services, as a Delivery Consultant you will be proficient in architecting complex, scalable, and secure AI/ML and GenAI solutions tailored to meet the specific needs of each customer. You’ll work closely with stakeholders to gather requirements, assess current infrastructure, and propose effective migration strategies to AWS. As trusted advisors to our customers, providing guidance on industry trends, emerging technologies, and innovative solutions, you will be responsible for leading the implementation process, ensuring adherence to best practices, optimizing performance, and managing risks throughout the project.

The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.

221100

Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities
As an experienced technology professional, you will be responsible for:
1. Implementing end-to-end AI/ML and GenAI projects, from understanding business needs to data preparation, model development, deployment and monitoring
2. Designing and implementing machine learning pipelines that support high-performance, reliable, scalable, and secure ML workloads
3. Designing scalable ML solutions and operations (MLOps) using AWS services and leveraging GenAI solutions when applicable
4. Collaborating with cross-functional teams (Applied Science, DevOps, Data Engineering, Cloud Infrastructure, Applications) to prepare, analyze, and operationalize data and AI/ML models
5. Serving as a trusted advisor to customers on AI/ML and GenAI solutions and cloud architectures
6. Sharing knowledge and best practices within the organization through mentoring, training, publication, and creating reusable artifacts

This is a customer-facing role with potential travel to customer sites as needed.

About the team
Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
 
Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud. 

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

title: EHS Specialist
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon’s mission to become Earth’s safest place to work! At Amazon, we’ve set the ambitious goal to become the benchmark of safety excellence across all industries in which we operate. As a Workplace Health & Safety Specialist (WHSS), you'll be at the forefront of transforming workplace safety culture at one of the world's most innovative companies. Your expertise and dedication will directly protect employees, ensuring they return home safely to their families every day. You'll facilitate new approaches to safety, combining technology with human-centered solutions to create an environment where safety and productivity thrive together. This isn't just about maintaining safety standards – it's about revolutionizing how we think about and implement workplace safety, making a lasting impact on our people and operations. As your building's designated safety champion, you'll have the unique opportunity to build relationships, influence positive change, and help write the next chapter in Amazon's commitment to becoming Earth's Safest Place to Work.

Core Impact Areas:
Safety Program Excellence & Implementation - Drive comprehensive safety programs through data-driven strategies. Lead daily safety audits, incident investigations, and risk assessments while implementing innovative solutions to prevent injuries. Deliver engaging safety training that resonates with associates and promotes a proactive safety culture. Champion continuous improvement initiatives that enhance workplace safety while maintaining operational efficiency.

Associate Advocacy & Cultural Leadership - Serve as a trusted safety advisor and advocate for associate wellbeing, building strong partnerships across all levels of the organization. Foster a culture where safety is everyone's priority through effective communication, coaching, and positive reinforcement. Develop strong relationships with frontline associates and leadership to drive behavioral changes and ensure safety best practices become natural habits. Transform safety data into compelling narratives that influence positive change and drive engagement in safety initiatives.

Additional Job Elements include:
- Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
- Work in an environment where the noise level varies
- Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
- Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)
- Maintain effective care delivery in emergencies and assist emergency response at the site

Must be available to work flexible shifts including days, nights and/or weekends.

For those that do not have an adult First Aid, CPR, AED certification from the American Heart Association or American Red Cross, must obtain within 3 weeks of start date.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent
- A minimum of 1 year in an Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) related field OR; A Bachelor’s degree in EHS-relevant background OR; 6 months experience performing in a safety-related role within Amazon
- Knowledge of OSHA regulations specifically 29 CFR 1910
- Experience using Microsoft Word and Excel in a professional capacity
- Experience maintaining confidentiality in matter involving security and/or personnel issues in the workplace

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree or higher, preferably in a safety related field
- Strong communication, teamwork, analysis, judgment, and customer focus skills
- Experience leading and managing a team, ability to analyze accident data, new processes, and machinery for potential safety concerns, and conduct job hazard and job safety analyses
- Experience in emergency response and currently holds First Aid and CPR certificates
- Experience in workers compensation case management

title: Regional Construction Manager, GES NA, Startup Engineering Risk Management (ERM)
descriptionHtml:
Amazon created one of the most sophisticated supply chains in the world. From the introduction of Amazon Prime, to the use of advanced technology for package delivery; Amazon consistently drives change from the front of the pack.

As a Regional Construction Manager (RCM) within Global Engineering Services (GES) North America (NA) Startup Engineering Risk Management (ERM), you will be a key contributor within the lifecycle of challenging cross-functional projects, developing and delivering the next generation of sortation and distribution solutions. You are a customer obsessed leader that will play an integral part in planning and implementation of the facility network infrastructure including new builds, retrofits, expansions and program initiatives. Partnering with internal customers and internal/external stakeholders to engage as a team and ensure a timely handover will be part of your critical tasks.

You lead and develop a team of Construction Managers across NA, operating in environments where the strategy may not yet be fully defined. You bring deep expertise and sound judgment to build team structure, set priorities, and drive execution against business goals. You translate diverse inputs from customers and stakeholders into clear goals and achievable plans — distinguishing between one-way and two-way door decisions and operating with independence and accountability.

You will work with some of the most talented engineers in the design, development, and delivery of physical distribution systems around the globe. You are responsible for managing a technology or integration project, successfully delivering the solution to meet project goals. You may work directly with external equipment vendors, customers, or partners, and you have a solid understanding of the design approaches and industry technologies utilized in fulfillment and distribution center designs. To meet timelines and minimize disruption to support teams, you manage the overall schedule, proactively mitigate risks, and keep the scope of engineering deliverables under control.

This role requires 50% regional travel on a yearly basis. When not traveling, you must have availability to work from a corporate office. Candidates should either live near or be willing to relocate within a reasonable commuting distance of one of the corporate office locations listed. Relocation assistance may be provided.



Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities

- Work independently with internal and external teams to successfully manage the lifecycle of challenging projects, and act as owner in delivering on project objectives and targets. Projects may span organizations or geographies in support of business objectives.
- Actively participate in firm engineering reviews, and make tangible impact on the proposed solutions on an individual system or its components, on the overall systems architecture, and on facility processes.
- Partner with internal teams, stakeholders and external vendors to set project priorities, establish milestones, and drive schedules to meet deadlines. Proactively assess stakeholders’ dependencies and milestones, problem-solve and drive solutions to mitigate the impact from the issues.
- Lead and coordinate all execution efforts in delivering systems and automated equipment designs per established standards and guidelines. Perform equipment/system installation, throughput and safety qualifications. Simplify, optimize, remove bottlenecks and provide feedback while resolving difficult system problems or technical deficiencies.
- Lead effective meetings by setting the objectives, putting the right people in the room and driving detailed business and technical discussions/alignment. Document meeting discussions, decisions and future steps, ensuring alignment on expectations with internal partner teams and outside vendors.
- Promptly and accurately communicate project status, risk analysis and risk mitigation plans. Effectively answer project questions in detail, and regularly produce clear and concise summaries for the project to leadership/management team.
- Competently articulate system and/or equipment designs, including layouts, technical specifications and functional capabilities to internal customers and partner teams.
- Efficiently manage change order controls, purchase orders, and invoice validation/approvals.
- Excel at building strong working relationships with internal and external stakeholders across multiple projects.
- Identify and lead process improvement initiatives that improve the Engineering and cross-teams’ efficiencies, optimizing the teams’ value and delivery. Through collaboration, generate high-quality, cost-effective solutions in compressed periods of time.
- Up to 50% travel domestically although travel intensity can be variable and consist of up to three weeks in a row; however, weekend travel is limited.

A day in the life
Each day, you operate as Amazon's regional construction leader — driving the safe, on-time, and on-budget delivery of complex construction programs.

You are managing one or multiple projects that can vary in scope, complexity and duration.
Daily tasks may comprise of site coordination with operations teams and contractors on project execution activities or changes; deep diving project progress, schedule and resources, while identifying barriers, creating solutions and driving resolutions. You may be facilitating the planning and/or implementation meetings with projects’ stakeholders, ensuring alignment in objectives, expectations, and the next steps; you would capture and publish detailed notes after each meeting to drive ownership and follow-through on the actions and decisions. Reviewing and approving Sorter System Functional specification document is one of the essential tasks, and you may be tracking the on-time creation of the sorter configurations with the internal automation teams. You may be brainstorming and developing workaround solutions while mitigating the project delays or design issues. As a part of the acceptance testing, you may be performing systems installation quality, safety, throughput, and performance qualifications, frequently communicating the progress to internal and external stakeholders. In addition, you may be supporting/training other engineering team members, utilizing the knowledge of Amazon’s safety, mechanical, electrical and controls installation standard and guidelines.

Global Engineering Services (GES) North America (NA) works to deliver Material Handling System launches, retrofits, and innovations. A day in the life can take place on a jobsite, in an active facility, or in one of Amazon’s corporate offices. GES NA is highly team-oriented, working daily be smarter together, be faster together, and to grow together.

About the team
The Engineering Risk Management (ERM) team manages the implementation of GES NA’s new launches and retrofits, bridging conceptual design milestones to operational go-live. Operating under five core tenets, the team coordinates complex projects across multiple internal stakeholders and external vendors, ensuring timely delivery while maintaining quality standards. Through tight collaboration with cross functional teams, we aim to eliminate process gaps to optimize project execution. Success is measured through effective program management, risk mitigation, and stakeholder alignment. The team's value lies in translating these strategic plans into operational reality, by providing clear project visibility, and fostering cross-functional collaboration to remove project barriers and achieve GES's broader network optimization goals.

At Amazon, we are all Owners and leverage unique opportunities presented to us by owning everything from firm engineering to project execution and final hand-off to our customers. We are a diverse, upbeat, creative team of engineers and managers working on a daily basis to ensure that our internal customers have capabilities to deliver on the Customer Promise.
We not only build, but we are also consistently improving our capabilities at Amazon. Continuous improvement is the ongoing enhancement of our systems through incremental and breakthrough developments. We are continually raising the quality bar, and are never satisfied. We seek to improve through captured lessons learned that are incorporated back into our mechanisms as a way to perpetually improve upon the next design and processes iterations. We continually learn, grow, and develop throughout the organization and our Subject Matter Expertise is leveraged globally.

We are the Team! We collaborate, support, help and leverage each other in delivering on the business objectives.

Basic qualifications

- Experience managing a team
- Experience in management of construction quality systems
- Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Construction Management, Engineering, or a related field
- 7+ years of experience as an Engineer, Construction Manager, Architect, or in a related construction discipline
- 7+ years of project and program management experience spanning design phase through construction completion and operational handover
- 7+ years of experience negotiating construction, procurement, and/or labor contracts
- Experience leading and managing a team of construction professionals, including coaching and performance management
- Experience managing geographically distributed teams across a multi-project or multi-site portfolio
- Proficiency with AutoCAD and/or BIM, and scheduling software (Primavera, MS Project, or similar)
- Position includes travel up to 50% (Nationwide). Travel involves air travel to regional airports and driving to site locations. A valid driver's license is required due to project assignments in areas with limited public transportation and rideshare options.

Preferred qualifications

- Project Management Professional (PMP) or equivalent certification
- Experience managing complex, large-scale construction programs ($50M+) end-to-end with budget, design, and team ownership across multiple concurrent projects
- Experience across multiple disciplines within the construction industry (e.g., General Contracting, Owner's Representation, Commercial Development, Engineering & Design)
- Demonstrated success leading contract negotiations and managing external partner performance across a portfolio of concurrent projects
- Experience developing and implementing construction processes, playbooks, or best practice frameworks at a regional scale
- Experience managing Construction Managers and building high-performing teams
- Demonstrated ability to communicate complex decisions and program performance to senior leadership
- Experience as a facilities manager or in a related facilities management role
- CMIT/CMAA certification or equivalent

title: Logistics Coordinator - PPF, Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon’s low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Project Amazon Leo's Payload Processing Facility (PPF) is seeking an experienced logistics professional to assist with every day activities listed below in both Florida as well as in French Guiana. This role is expected to travel up to 25% of the time internationally. Successful candidates must also be able to pass the federal security checks to receive an access badge to Kennedy Space Center.


Key job responsibilities
- Execute Transportation related SOPs related to warehousing and inventory activities at the PPF
- Receive Amazon Leo managed and supplier shipments
- Use proprietary software and ERP systems to virtually receive and manage material
- Accurately track and account for all inventory located at the PPF warehouse
- Efficiently deliver material to PPF stakeholders, both physically and virtually
- Coordinate trailer or container movements within the PPF Yard
- Meet operational metrics related to warehouse receiving and inventory activities
- Effectively communicate high priority matters with Transportation leadership
- Shift schedule will vary, depending on production/launch schedules
- Operate equipment including: forklifts, pallet jacks, electric pallet jacks, and hand cart
- Role requires up to 25% travel

About the team
Here at Amazon we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we are building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship.

Innovation is part of our DNA. Our goal is to be Earth's most customer centric company, and we are just getting started. We need people who want to join an ambitious program that continues to push the state of art in space-based systems design and wireless system.

Basic qualifications

title: Security Engineer II, Amazon GuardDuty
descriptionHtml:
Amazon GuardDuty is a customer facing threat detection service that was built to protect applications and services running in AWS. The service processes trillions of events and applies advanced analytics and machine learning to detect threats. If you are interested in learning about operating a service at massive scale and working alongside world class engineers, then this role is for you.

The Security Engineer position will be working on Amazon GuardDuty, which is a managed threat detection service that continuously monitors for malicious or unauthorized behavior to help you protect your AWS accounts and workloads. It monitors for activity such as unusual API calls or potentially unauthorized deployments that indicate a possible account compromise. GuardDuty also detects potentially compromised instances or reconnaissance by attackers. This is an advanced engineering team that is using cutting edge techniques to help customers assess, monitor and protect their cloud based resources. We are looking for an experienced security engineer with red team penetration testing skills to join this team to research, tune and validate our detection mechanisms.

A successful candidate for this role will have a deep understanding of both information security and computer science. If you can exploit at scale while remaining stealthy, identify and exploit misconfigurations in network resources, develop out of the box techniques, and communicate complex info in a digestible manner, you could be an ideal candidate.

The scope of this role includes researching attack patterns, building attack simulations, active testing, and mentoring data scientists and software engineers. In this role, you will interface with many internal security teams to keep up to date with the latest attack techniques.


Key job responsibilities
As a Security Engineer, you’ll:

- Recognize and safely utilize attacker tools, tactics and procedures

title: Senior Software Development Engineer, Software Defined Network Control Plane, Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is building a constellation of Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellites to deliver low-latency, high-speed broadband connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the world. With hundreds of satellites already in orbit and the service now in beta, we are scaling rapidly and building new features across the network. As a Senior Software Development Engineer on the Software Defined Networking (SDN) Control Plane team, you will lead the design and development of the network control plane that orchestrates traffic across satellites, customer terminals, gateways, and terrestrial infrastructure. You will tackle multi-dimensional problems at global, set technical direction for your team, and collaborate closely with hardware teams, scientists, embedded software engineers, and mission operations to shape how our network performs and grows.

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and deliver scalable, high-throughput, low-latency services for the SDN control plane, defining conventions and technical solutions that guide the team's engineering direction.
- Build link planning, routing, and control plane delivery services in Rust for network nodes spanning satellite and terrestrial infrastructure.
- Develop highly available control plane services along with the operational tooling, dashboards, and observability features needed to monitor and maintain system health.
- Collaborate with hardware teams, scientists, embedded software engineers, mission planning, and mission operations to ensure the control plane integrates cleanly across the broader Leo network.
- Drive software quality across the full lifecycle — from technical design and code review through testing, deployment, and on-call operational support — while mentoring other engineers on best practices.

A day in the life
Your week balances focused, heads-down engineering with regular collaboration. You participate in standups, design reviews, operations reviews, and weekly demos where the team shares progress and gathers feedback. Between those touchpoints you work independently on roadmap-driven projects — designing control plane features, writing and reviewing code, or building observability tooling that keeps the network running smoothly. Because the SDN sits at the center of the Leo network, you regularly connect with partner teams in hardware, embedded software, and mission operations to align on interfaces and resolve cross-system challenges.

About the team
The SDN Control Plane team builds and operates the brain of the Leo network. We own the distributed systems that route traffic across a growing constellation of LEO satellites, customer terminals, gateways, and terrestrial links. Our work directly determines the quality of service our customers experience.

We are a collaborative, roadmap-driven team that values thoughtful design and operational rigor. You will receive guidance from peers and engineering leadership, and you will have the opportunity to grow your technical leadership skills by setting architectural direction and influencing decisions that span multiple teams.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
- 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

descriptionHtml:
※このポジションの勤務地は東京都府中市を予定しています。

私たちのグローバルオペレーションネットワークは、日々何百万もの荷物と笑顔をアマゾンのお客様にお届けしています。私たちは、エリアマネージャーとして私たちのチームに加わってほしいと考え、意欲的で顧客重視の人材を探しています。この役割では、複数メンバーのチームをリードし、シフト中のチームの安全性、品質、出勤率、およびパフォーマンスを最高水準に維持するため、チームに働きかける責任があります。また、お客様の注文が適切な時間に適切な場所へ確実にお届けされるよう、お客様の期待に応えることにおいても重要な役割を担います。

私たちの業務の流れには3つの主要な要素があります。
商品が保管され注文に備える「ファーストマイル」、注文品をお客様のエリアまで輸送する「ミドルマイル」、そして商品をお客様の玄関先までお届けする「ラストマイル」です。各拠点で運営方法に若干の違いはありますが、一貫して変わらないものが一つあります、それは顧客を第一に考える私たちのビジョンと献身的な姿勢です。

本ポジションはAmazonの新しいエキサイティングな物流拠点で業務を行います。可能な限り最速でお客様のご自宅に商品をお届けすることでお客様のカスタマーエクスペリエンスを向上します。私たちと一緒に歴史をつくりましょう！

Amazonでは、最新のAI Tool, 生成AIを日々の業務の中に積極的に取り入れています。
AI Toolは私たちの意思決定のスピードを加速させ、私たちを本当に重要な「判断」と「議論」に集中させることを可能にしています。Amazon では学習を継続する文化が根付いているため、ご自身のペースでAIに関する知識を深めることができるリソースが用意されています。

Key job responsibilities
■業務内容■
「エリアマネージャー」には、他業種・職種も含めこれまでの経験、スキルを活かし、改善点を模索しながら、「People First」の考え方で、各種プロジェクトをリードし、またピープルマネージメントを行っていただきます。また、「エリアマネージャー」は拠点の全ての工程を担当し、上司の示す部署全体の方針や安全・品質・生産性の年間目標に沿って、担当工程における改善を積み重ね、日々の計画、進捗、実績管理に責任をもち活動いただきます。

具体的な業務は以下の通りです。

主な責任と職務内容：
① チームメンバーの育成とサポート
現場の最前線にいるマネージャーとしてチームメンバーと積極的に関わり、メンバーからの意見に基づく職場改善によりエンゲージメントを高めます。また、数名から数十名のチームのマネージャーとして、業務上の知識・スキル、アマゾンカルチャー等の指導を行うことはもちろん、部下の悩みに傾聴し、問題の解決に向けて自ら動きます。さらに、部下の勤怠や労働時間等の把握、管理を適切に行います。

② 担当プロセスの安全・品質・作業効率の向上
マネージャーはそれぞれ特定のプロセスを担当し、そのプロセスの安全・品質・作業効率の向上をリードします。日々の安全活動、品質チェックに加え、作業環境の改善、トレーニングの進捗管理など多岐にわたる改善活動が該当します。問題を特定し、対策を立案し、チームメンバーを巻き込みながら実行に移し、結果を出していくことが求められます。

③ 日々のオペレーション対応
物流拠点のすべての工程を管理し、商品の管理からお客様へお届けするまでの一連の流れの中で計画を立案し管理していただきます。日々のオペレーションにおいてお客様にお約束した納期を確実に守るため、物量の上振れや下振れ、急な労働力不足、システムトラブル等の変動要素に際し、適切に判断して対応していくことが求められます。

④ プロジェクトリーダーとして改善を推進
Amazonでは日々改善が推進されています。エリアマネージャーは通常業務と並行して、安全上のリスクや生産性を改善するプロジェクトのリーダーとして拠点内の年次/月次プロジェクト活動を推進します。これらのプロジェクトにおいては関連部署との協業等も含まれます。
