descriptionHtml:
Il team Operations è il cuore pulsante di Amazon. Svolge un ruolo fondamentale per il nostro business, perché ci permette di evadere e spedire gli ordini in modo efficiente, così che i nostri clienti li ricevano nei tempi previsti. Nel ruolo di Area Manager, dovrai garantire la regolare operatività del tuo sito logistico, per riuscire a soddisfare le richieste dei clienti. Sarai a capo di un team che contribuisce a garantire la sicurezza, l’efficienza e l’alta qualità dei nostri processi e ti occuperai di una serie di progetti su tutta la nostra rete con lo scopo di incrementare la produttività.

Il contratto collettivo nazionale di lavoro applicabile a questo ruolo è Logistica, Trasporto Merci e Spedizione. La posizione è inquadrata al Livello 1 o superiore, in base alle competenze, capacità ed esperienza del/della candidato/a.

Key job responsibilities
- Creare, portare avanti e promuovere una cultura incentrata sulla sicurezza e sul benessere.
- Analizzare e implementare cambiamenti per mantenere qualità e produttività a livelli costantemente elevati.
- Supervisionare progetti di miglioramento dei processi, ottimizzare la produttività e incrementare la qualità del servizio ai clienti all’interno della tua area di responsabilità.
- Analizzare le prestazioni dei turni rispetto agli obiettivi aziendali e mettere in atto azioni per migliorare la nostra eccellenza operativa.
- Lavorare in collaborazione con i colleghi manager per standardizzare le prassi adottate nei turni.

A day in the life
Lavorerai su turni presso uno dei nostri siti logistici, garantendo la massima produttività possibile. Il tuo obiettivo principale sarà promuovere una cultura della sicurezza e il rispetto degli standard di qualità e di performance durante i turni. Dovrai inoltre supervisionare le attività di miglioramento dei processi nella tua area e agevolarne l’implementazione. La tipica giornata di lavoro è molto varia: dovrai occuparti di attività di routine di gestione del team, avrai responsabilità quotidiane volte al miglioramento dei processi e iniziative contingenti di gestione operativa su più ampia scala. Dovrai anche fungere da esempio e da guida per i nuovi manager.

About the team
Il team Customer Fulfilment, o CF, è il nucleo originario di Amazon. Tutto è partito da un piccolo gruppo di librai, per poi diventare un team sofisticato dalla presenza globale, che gestisce oltre 1,5 milioni di ordini al giorno. Questo team è alla base della nostra attività ed è grazie al suo impegno che l’azienda ha saputo diversificarsi, ampliando la propria presenza geografica e l’offerta di servizi. Grazie alle nuove tecnologie, siamo sempre alla ricerca di modi per offrire una gamma di prodotti più ampia e migliore, con consegne tempestive a costi contenuti.
Il team CF è il primo anello della catena che ci permette di consegnare i prodotti con la velocità che ci contraddistingue. Opera all’interno dei Fulfilment Centre, aree chiave della frenetica rete operativa di Amazon e che a volte vengono definiti “First Mile”, primo miglio, perché è proprio lì che la maggior parte dei pacchi Amazon inizia il suo viaggio. Il team aiuta a gestire un inventario dinamico e agevola consegne tempestive 24 ore su 24.
Nei Fulfilment Centre operano le figure più disparate, quindi le opportunità abbondano e c’è bisogno di competenze eterogenee. C’è chi gestisce fisicamente i prodotti e chi si occupa di analizzare i dati per aiutare il personale a prendere decisioni oculate.

- Esperienza nella gestione di team
- Esperienza nella comunicazione con un'ampia gamma di stakeholder, inclusi colleghi e leadership

descriptionHtml:

title: Employee Relations Manager , Global Corporate Employee Relations (GCER)
descriptionHtml:
The Global Corporate Employee Relations (GCER) team at Amazon is seeking an Employee Relations Manager to support all Corporate lines of business in the Asia Pacific, Japan and China region (APJC). This role requires an individual who can operate across the full employee relations spectrum with strong judgment and the ability to work independently and collaborate effectively across multiple stakeholder groups—including PXT partners, Legal, business leadership, and regional subject matter experts—to drive alignment across Amazon's wide geographic and cultural scope.

The central objective of GCER is to ensure our organization's treatment of every employee is fair, respectful, and consistent with our core business values, policies, and objectives as we Strive to be Earth's Best Employer. This position balances prevention-oriented work (enhancing the employee experience, assessing organizational risk, building positive ER programs) with response-driven work (complex investigations into discrimination, harassment, and retaliation, crisis response, and time-sensitive escalations).

Critically, this role requires the ability to operate fluidly between micro-level and macro-level work, managing discrete investigations and individual conflict resolution while simultaneously maintaining the strategic perspective to recognize when unresolved issues signal broader systemic risk or have the potential to galvanize collective employee action. The ability to see around corners, connect disparate signals, and escalate before issues compound is essential to success.

The position reports to the APJC Principal of Employee Relations, and will be based in Tokyo, Japan. This is a full-time position that could require travel up to 30% of the time over the course of the year, varying based on business needs and regional support requirements.

At Amazon, you'll work alongside the latest AI and GenAI tools that are increasingly woven into how teams operate: from AI-powered capabilities that accelerate decision-making, to Generative AI that helps you focus on work that truly matters. You'll have opportunities and resources to develop AI fluency at your own pace, with continuous learning built into the culture.

Key job responsibilities
Strategic Partnership
• Partner with business leaders, HRPs, HRBPs, Labor and Employment Legal, regional SMEs, and compliance teams to create, sustain, and evolve positive Employee Relations programs, policies, and practices that support a healthy employee relations environment.
• Analyze, diagnose, design, and revise people programs, policies, and practices to sustain positive employee relations, address emerging workforce dynamics, and ensure ER strategies are legally sound and regionally appropriate.
• Manage and resolve conflicts at all levels of the organization, developing proactive response strategies that address employee concerns at the earliest opportunity.

Expert Consultation & Coaching
• Provide expert guidance to HRBP’s, managers, and business leaders on complex Employee Relations matters, including conflict resolution and one-on-one coaching at all levels of the organization.
• Work directly with Amazon employees at all levels to identify, address, and resolve concerns through conflict resolution, coaching, and structured engagement.

Workplace Investigations
• Lead and manage high-complexity workplace investigations into allegations of discrimination, harassment, retaliation, and other serious policy violations, ensuring they are thorough, timely, well-documented, and result in fair, defensible outcomes.
• Partner with centralized investigation resources as appropriate, maintaining oversight and ensuring investigative quality and consistency.

Proactive Employee Experience
• Leverage a combination of AI-powered sentiment analysis, data-driven workforce intelligence, and direct engagement methods (e.g., listening sessions, focus groups) to surface and address employee concerns at the earliest opportunity — evolving the approach as new tools and capabilities mature.
• Conduct Employee Experience Assessments (EEAs) and develop targeted mitigation strategies to remediate pain points in the employee experience.

Dual-Lens Risk Assessment
• Operate with a dual lens: manage individual (micro-level) employee matters while continuously assessing whether unresolved issues could escalate into broader (macro-level) organizational risk — including collective employee action, reputational exposure, or systemic breakdowns in trust.
• Ensure holistic case awareness so that individual investigations inform broader labor relations strategy.
• Maintain awareness of workforce dynamics and employee sentiment, ensuring trusted relationship with employees and respond to concerns.

Data Analytics & AI-Powered Insights
• Analyze and synthesize a variety of data sources to identify emerging trends, predictive patterns, and areas of opportunity across both ER and LR.
• Translate insights into actionable and compelling recommendations for business leaders through regular reporting; actively engage GenAI tooling to augment Employee Relations reporting, analysis, and process improvements.

Training & Program Development
• Design and deliver training programs on positive employee relations and leadership best practices using a tiered approach.
• Assist in strategic business writing and contribute to or lead the development of business operational documents and strategic initiatives.

Basic qualifications

- Five (5)+ years of direct experience in Employee Relations and/or Labor Relations
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent years of relevant experience
- Fluency in both English and Japanese is essential for this role, including strong verbal and written communication skills in both languages
- Experience working with and applying employment and labor laws throughout the Asia Pacific Japan and China region (APJC)
- Experience managing complex workplace investigations, including investigations into discrimination, harassment, and retaliation
- Experience conducting organizational assessments, with demonstrated ability to identify when individual employee issues signal broader systemic risk
- Experience assessing complex quantitative and qualitative data to identify root causes, recognize patterns, and develop innovative recommendations that influence action by HR and/or business leaders
- Experience developing and implementing ER programs, initiatives, and training
- Strong interpersonal, persuasion, and written communication skills — able to establish productive partnerships across multiple management levels and influence senior leadership across a large, dispersed, and culturally diverse organization
- Proven ability to manage conflict, operate autonomously in highly ambiguous environments, and manage competing priorities simultaneously
- Experience with GenAI tools and applications
- Proficient in MS Word, Outlook, Excel, and PowerPoint
- Ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with discretion
- Alignment with Amazon's Leadership Principles

Preferred qualifications

- Advanced degree, law degree, or other specialized training in Labor/Employee Relations
- International or multi-region Employee Relations and Labor Relations experience

title: Network Development Engineer, Direct Connect
descriptionHtml:
Do you like to use network and Unix systems engineering to deliver simple, sustainable and repeatable solutions? Would you like to play a key role in driving the stability and sustainability of next-generation IP networks?

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Amazon is looking for best-in-class Network Engineers to drive the deployment, scaling and automation of one of the world’s largest and complex networks: the AWS Direct Connect service - the service that connects AWS to our largest customers in data centers around the world. With Amazon Web Services (http://aws.amazon.com), our goal is to become “The Infrastructure Platform” to the world. Our customers demand the highest quality and reliability for their services and challenge us to be better, faster, and cheaper every day. We are expanding at a tremendous rate; it is our responsibility to maintain quality and reliability while developing innovative ways to automate the scaling of our network.

The AWS Direct Connect team delivers solutions that make it easy for customers to establish a dedicated network connection from their premises to the AWS cloud. These connections help to reduce network costs, increase bandwidth throughput, and provide a more consistent network experience than Internet-based connections. AWS Direct Connect is currently available in more than 100 locations, which span nearly 70 cities in 30 different countries.

Key job responsibilities
As a Network Development Engineer you will:
- Support and maintain our next generation networks.
- Deliver simple, sustainable and repeatable solutions and processes.
- Work closely with our broader Network Engineering & Deployment teams to ensure operational readiness for new deployments.
- Drive standards across the network and ensure that we are fully compliant to those standards and policies.
- Participate and drive impact mitigation during large-scale events utilizing an established Event Management process.
- Drive event deep dives for large-scale events, deliver high-quality documentation for the events and drive corrective actions to completion.
- Improve our detection mechanisms by designing and implementing new alerts.
- Create and review documentation and process regarding recurring issues, new standard operating procedures, knowledge transfer material, etc.
- Troubleshoot interconnectivity issues, including troubleshooting of network device configuration and low level application interaction.
- Identify and drive opportunities to repeatable tasks through creation and maintenance of scripts and tools.

A day in the life
We work with internal partners to develop and implement the next gen platforms
along with the tooling ecosystems to support with these platforms driving efficiency and scalability
through the automation of builds, configuration deployment, and the scaling of capacity. As our
network is one of the largest in the world, there is no blue print at our scale allowing our engineers to
develop solutions to the complex challenges that we face daily. We encourage durable solutions that
look around corners while taking into consideration our customer needs from a cost, performance, and
reliability perspective. Our team develops tooling that provides the required visibility and control of
traffic across the network, while prioritizing the automatic mitigation of events to minimize the impact
to our customers during events.
• Work in a 24x7 team on call rotation, with ability to drive into workplace for critical events/needs.
• Manage customers during problem resolution and operating efficiently under pressure.
• Sit at the computer during scheduled work hours with appropriate breaks while maintaining a high level of alertness and attention to detail.
• Travel to data center/network sites and Amazon/customer offices as needed.


About the team
About AWS

Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

- Experience with IP networking fundamentals and TCP/IP, UDP, DNS & DHCP
- Experience in internet routing protocols and concepts: TCP/IP, BGP, MPLS, ISIS and/or OSPF
- Experience troubleshooting issues and root cause analysis

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working in large-scale networking environments

title: WHS Manager, WHS Manager
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking an experienced and results-driven Multi-Site Workplace Health & Safety (WHS) Manager to lead the expansion, standardization, and compliance of WHS programs across our growing Sub-Same Day (SSD) delivery operations in Mexico. This is a strategic leadership role at the forefront of our operational growth, ensuring every new and existing site meets the highest safety standards from day one.

In this role, you will be the primary WHS leader responsible for driving a culture of safety across multiple sites. You will develop and administer compliance frameworks built on both leading indicators (proactive safety activities, training completion, hazard identification) and lagging indicators (incident rates, severity metrics, lost-time injuries), using data to anticipate risks before they materialize and to measure the effectiveness of corrective actions.

You will work hand-in-hand with operational teams to implement safety policies, ensure adherence to Amazon global WHS standards, and guarantee full compliance with Mexican federal and local regulations — including STPS NOMs, IMSS requirements, and Proteccion Civil mandates. Your ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders and embed safety into every operational process will be critical to our success.

Key job responsibilities
Data-Driven Decision Making

Own the safety data narrative — "numbers without context are noise"
Real-time dashboards, trend modeling, evidence-based culture
WBR/MBR/QBR readiness — every recommendation rooted in data
Effective Communication with Senior Leadership.

Primary WHS voice to Managers — concise 6-pagers and narratives
Proactive escalation — "surface hard truths early, not surprises late"
Influence without authority, earn trust through results
Incident Analysis (IA) Effectiveness & Productivity

Standardized investigation framework, cycle-time targets
Tiered IA rigor matched to severity

title: Sr Engagement Manager | Gestionnaire senior de l'engagement, Public Sector Professional Services | Services professionnels du secteur public
descriptionHtml:
Do you have a deep passion for utilizing technology to empower businesses? Would you like to have a career that supports customers and partners reach their outcomes faster and cheaper through Cloud Services?

We are hiring a Senior Engagement Manager capable of leading internal AWS, external partners, and customer teams to deliver AWS cloud products and services that enable our customers to realize their business outcomes. You will need to draw on your customer-facing skills and technical acumen to understand customer requirements and enable them to implement their digital transformation projects.

You will be collaborating with many stakeholder groups to support requirements gathering and scope definition. You will be working on an ongoing basis to proactively implement best practices for our customers and help identify and close project gaps working with all levels of organizations. Typical engagements include: Cloud Strategy and Business Case Development, Cloud Suitability and Migration Assessments, Cloud Architecture Design and Implementation, On-Premise to Cloud Migrations, and Cloud Organizational Alignment.
--------------------------------------
Avez-vous une passion profonde pour l'utilisation de la technologie afin d'outiller les entreprises? Aimeriez-vous poursuivre une carrière qui aide les clients et les partenaires à atteindre leurs objectifs plus rapidement et à moindre coût grâce aux services infonuagiques?

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un(e) gestionnaire principal(e) de l'engagement capable de diriger des équipes internes d'AWS, des partenaires externes et des équipes clients afin de livrer des produits et services infonuagiques AWS qui permettent à nos clients de réaliser leurs objectifs d'affaires. Vous devrez mettre à profit vos compétences en relation client et votre sens technique pour comprendre les exigences des clients et les accompagner dans la mise en œuvre de leurs projets de transformation numérique.

Vous collaborerez avec de nombreux groupes d'intervenants pour soutenir la collecte des exigences et la définition de la portée des projets. Vous travaillerez de façon continue à mettre en œuvre de manière proactive les pratiques exemplaires pour nos clients et à cerner et combler les lacunes des projets en collaboration avec tous les échelons des organisations. Les mandats typiques comprennent : l'élaboration de stratégies infonuagiques et d'analyses de rentabilité, les évaluations d'admissibilité et de migration vers l'infonuagique, la conception et la mise en œuvre d'architectures infonuagiques, les migrations de l'infrastructure sur site vers l'infonuagique, ainsi que l'harmonisation organisationnelle liée à l'infonuagique.

Key job responsibilities
Delivery
• Collaborate with AWS field sales, pre-sales, training, and support teams to seek to understand our customers’ needs, their business, how success is defined, and ensure that we are exceeding expectations in developing and delivering customer outcomes.
• Plan, organize, and manage all phases of the project lifecycle to ensure successful delivery. This includes developing and managing project governance plans, project schedules, team goals, project milestones, budgets and defining success criteria.
• Manage engagement goals and lead teams to achieve customers’ business outcomes by managing issues, risks, decisions, dependencies, and action items.
• Work with stakeholders and AWS sales teams to amend the contractual scope, financials, and expected timelines
• Ability to take ownership, work under pressure, stay within budget, and meet deadlines
• Hold internal and external teams accountable, redirect when needed, and manage customer expectations throughout engagements.
• Works effectively in a dynamic environment with changing priorities and able to take proactive steps to ensure teams meet or exceed customer expectations.
• Ability to be self-directed and effective working independently, yet equally comfortable contributing in a global team environment
• Results-oriented, prioritizes work activities, plans and stays organized in order to meet commitments.
• Ensures AWS and Partner teams meet or exceed customer business objectives

Solutions
• Lead individuals, teams, or multiple groups and play an active role in analyzing project goals, creating a plan to achieve those goals, and then guiding AWS team members, customer stakeholders/SMEs and potentially other third parties to achieve those goals while understanding the client environment and any limitations to execution.
• Actively looks for ways to improve process efficiencies and effectiveness.
• Ability to apply strategic thinking and demonstrate understanding of requirements to execute.
• Ability to make decisions guided by policies, procedures and business plans with limited guidance.
• Ability to apply business and financial acumen to achieve measurable business results for customer success.
• Support and influence the sales lifecycle by engaging clients in defining next phases of cloud projects as appropriate to meet client needs.
• Participate in practice development by contributing to the development of practical solutions and methodologies, and the development of knowledge sharing artifacts.

Communication
• Excellent written, verbal communication, and presentation skills with team members and audiences of all levels.
• Ability to build relationships with various customer and internal AWS stakeholders which consists of senior leadership teams (C-level execs, SVP/VP, Directors) and project level resources such as SMEs.
• Plans and oversees the preparation and distribution of project communications.
• Understand the operating styles of others as well as team/client relationships, team dynamics, and adjusts behavior accordingly to succeed. Recognizes environmental or cultural nuances and adapts.
• Foster an inclusive and diverse work environment.

Team Work
• Proven success in working with teams and executive leadership in a complex customer environment.
• Team player who effectively integrates, motivates and builds relationships with cross-functional team members (local or remote), sponsors, key stakeholders, executives, and other individuals or organizations involved with or affected by the project.
• Proven experience working in a matrix environment, managing multiple stakeholders.
• Excellent people management skills, including the ability to influence, negotiate and achieve results through others who are not direct reports.
This is a customer-facing role. You may be required to travel to customer locations to deliver professional services when needed when travel resumes. We offer a flexible work environment to help you balance your work and personal life, while still remaining customer obsessed.
-----------------------------------------
Livraison
• Collaborer avec les équipes de vente, d'avant-vente, de formation et de soutien d'AWS sur le terrain afin de chercher à comprendre les besoins de nos clients, leur entreprise, la façon dont le succès est défini, et veiller à ce que nous dépassions les attentes en matière de développement et de livraison des résultats clients. • Planifier, organiser et gérer toutes les phases du cycle de vie des projets afin d'assurer une livraison réussie. Cela comprend l'élaboration et la gestion de plans de gouvernance de projet, de calendriers de projet, d'objectifs d'équipe, de jalons de projet, de budgets et la définition de critères de succès.
• Gérer les objectifs des mandats et diriger les équipes afin d'atteindre les résultats d'affaires des clients en gérant les enjeux, les risques, les décisions, les dépendances et les mesures à prendre.
• Travailler avec les intervenants et les équipes de vente d'AWS pour modifier la portée contractuelle, les aspects financiers et les échéanciers prévus.
• Capacité à prendre en charge les responsabilités, à travailler sous pression, à respecter les budgets et les échéances.
• Tenir les équipes internes et externes responsables, réorienter au besoin et gérer les attentes des clients tout au long des mandats.
• Travailler efficacement dans un environnement dynamique où les priorités changent et être en mesure de prendre des mesures proactives pour s'assurer que les équipes répondent aux attentes des clients ou les dépassent.
• Capacité à travailler de façon autonome et efficace de manière indépendante, tout en étant également à l'aise de contribuer au sein d'une équipe mondiale.
• Axé(e) sur les résultats, priorise les activités de travail, planifie et demeure organisé(e) afin de respecter les engagements.

Solutions

• Rechercher activement des moyens d'améliorer l'efficacité et l'efficience des processus.
• Capacité à appliquer une réflexion stratégique et à démontrer une compréhension des exigences pour mener à bien l'exécution.

• Capacité à appliquer un sens des affaires et des finances pour obtenir des résultats d'affaires mesurables favorisant le succès des clients.

• Participer au développement de la pratique en contribuant à l'élaboration de solutions et de méthodologies concrètes, ainsi qu'au développement d'outils de partage des connaissances.

Communication
• Excellentes compétences en communication écrite, verbale et en présentation avec les membres de l'équipe et les auditoires de tous les niveaux.
• Capacité à établir des relations avec divers intervenants internes d'AWS et clients, y compris les équipes de haute direction (cadres de niveau C, PVP principal/VP, directeurs) ainsi que les ressources au niveau des projets telles que les experts en la matière.
• Planifier et superviser la préparation et la distribution des communications de projet.
• Comprendre les styles de fonctionnement des autres ainsi que les relations d'équipe/client, la dynamique d'équipe, et adapter son comportement en conséquence pour réussir. Reconnaître les nuances environnementales ou culturelles et s'adapter.
• Favoriser un environnement de travail inclusif et diversifié.

Travail d'équipe
• Succès démontré dans le travail avec des équipes et la haute direction dans un environnement client complexe.
• Esprit d'équipe qui intègre efficacement, motive et établit des relations avec les membres d'équipes interfonctionnelles (locaux ou à distance), les commanditaires, les intervenants clés, les cadres et les autres personnes ou organisations touchées par le projet.
• Expérience avérée de travail dans un environnement matriciel, gérant de multiples intervenants.
• Excellentes compétences en gestion des personnes, y compris la capacité d'influencer, de négocier et d'obtenir des résultats par l'entremise d'autres personnes qui ne sont pas des subordonnés directs.

Il s'agit d'un poste en contact avec la clientèle. Vous pourriez être appelé(e) à vous déplacer chez les clients pour offrir des services professionnels au besoin, lorsque les déplacements reprendront. Nous offrons un environnement de travail flexible pour vous aider à concilier votre vie professionnelle et personnelle, tout en demeurant obsédé(e) par le client.

- 7+ years of leading and delivering enterprise-level IT engagements experience
- Experience in leading multiple Agile teams (like Scrum Masters, Product Owners) concurrently or at scale
- Experience with large scale IT/digital/business transformation or migration programs in a customer facing role

title: Seasonal MyHR Live Support Sr. Advisor, Bereavement Centralization
descriptionHtml:
The MHLS Bereavement Centralization Team is hiring an MHLS Sr. Advisor to support our Bereavement Centralization program.

Our team plays a vital role in supporting Amazonians through one of life's most difficult moments. As part of High Touch Services, we provide compassionate, personalized support to Amazon employees navigating bereavement leave, ensuring they receive the care and guidance they need during a challenging time.

Bereavement Centralization Advisors assist Amazon employees across phone, chat, ticketing, and case channels. Advisors are expected to navigate SOPs and knowledge resources effectively, respond to evolving situations, and deliver a connected, trusted case management experience.

The ideal candidate brings strong communication and organizational skills, attention to detail, the ability to prioritize in a fast-paced environment, and a customer service mindset aligned with Amazon's global standards. title: Data Center Manager
descriptionHtml:
Manage a team that maintains cloud infrastructure for global data center operations!
AWS is looking for technology managers with experience in people management, strong technical understanding and the drive and vision to take AWS Data Center Operations to the next level. The successful candidate will have experience creating/devising strategies, mentoring people at all levels, sponsoring projects, and proposing technical solutions. This position involves leading teams in hardware and network diagnostics followed by physical repair and includes participation in an on-call rotation.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Effective May 15, 2017, logical access to the AWS GovCloud region will be restricted to Amazon employees who are U.S. Citizens. (GovCloud may NOT be accessed from outside of the United States)

Basic qualifications

- 4+ years of Information Technology (IT) experience, or Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent
- 2+ years of people management experience
- 2+ years of operations and on-call support for data center facilities, mission critical plants, or production facilities experience

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of computer hardware experience, including troubleshooting and repairing experience
- Experience in technical writing in a relevant field
- certification in an applicable field like A+, Net+, Sec+, CCNA, LPIC, Linux+, AWS certification, or A+ or CND (Certified Network Defender) or Network+ or Security+

title: AWS Technical Consultant (TAM), Enterprise Support NZ
descriptionHtml:
Join AWS as we invest NZ$7.5 billion in New Zealand over the next 15 years. We're looking for a Technical Account Manager to join our Enterprise Support team and work directly with New Zealand's most ambitious Independent Software Vendors (ISVs) as they build, scale and innovate on AWS.

As a TAM in our ISV segment, you'll be the trusted technical consultant for software companies that are shaping industries across New Zealand and beyond. You'll help ISV customers architect for scale, optimise their cloud operations and accelerate their product roadmaps on AWS. Your day will involve conducting application reviews, leading operational readiness assessments, driving adoption of AWS services that unlock new capabilities and presenting insights at business reviews that influence customer strategy.

This isn't a reactive support role. It's a consulting role where you earn trust through deep technical expertise and deliver measurable impact. You'll work across the full customer lifecycle, from onboarding and migration through to optimisation and innovation, solving complex technical challenges alongside some of the sharpest engineering teams in the country.

You'll be part of a growing Enterprise Support team in New Zealand, backed by the depth of AWS's global technical community. You'll develop your skills across cloud architecture, security, cost optimisation and operational excellence while contributing to Technical Field Communities and earning AWS certifications.

If you want to work at the intersection of cloud technology and software innovation, and you're ready to have a direct impact on how New Zealand's ISVs build and grow, we'd love to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities
- Serve as the primary technical advisor to ISV customers, helping them architect, optimise and scale their software products on AWS
- Conduct Operational Reviews, operational readiness assessments and architecture deep-dives tailored to SaaS and multi-tenant workloads
- Drive operational excellence across customer environments by identifying risks, reducing cost and improving reliability before issues impact production
- Lead technical discussions on incident management, trade-offs and risk mitigation, translating complex scenarios into clear recommendations for both engineering teams and senior leadership
- Proactively identify opportunities to accelerate customer outcomes through AWS service adoption, cost optimisation and architectural improvements
- Deliver business reviews that provide actionable insights, track progress against customer goals and strengthen the strategic relationship
- Collaborate with AWS Solutions Architects, Business Developers, Professional Services and Account Managers to deliver coordinated support across the customer lifecycle
- Enable customer teams through targeted workshops, hands-on labs and technical enablement sessions that build lasting cloud capability
- Lead service event reviews and pre-launch planning to ensure customers are prepared for critical launches and operational milestones
- Engage with stakeholders across all levels, from platform engineers to CTOs, earning trust through technical depth and consistent delivery

A day in the life
No two days are the same, but here's what a typical day might look like.

Your morning starts by reviewing operational dashboards and findings across your customer portfolio, identifying any emerging risks before they become incidents. You notice one customer's database latency has been trending upward and flag it for a deeper review later in the week.

Mid-morning, you lead an Well-Architected Review with a SaaS customer who is preparing to expand into a new market. You work through their multi-tenant architecture, identify areas where they can improve resilience and reduce cost, and leave them with a prioritised set of recommendations they can action immediately.

Over lunch, you join a cross-functional call with the account team to plan an upcoming business review for one of your largest ISV customers. You pull together operational insights, service adoption trends and risk reduction metrics to ensure the review delivers real strategic value.

In the afternoon, you run a hands-on workshop with a customer's engineering team on observability best practices, helping them instrument their platform so they can detect and resolve issues faster. This is the kind of enablement that builds lasting capability and earns trust.

Later, you spend time preparing a pre-launch review for a customer about to release a major product update. You assess their architecture for readiness, review their scaling strategy and ensure their operational runbooks are solid before go-live.

Between meetings, you're contributing to your Technical Field Community, reviewing a SpecReq from a colleague and catching up with your ESM on a customer risk you've been tracking. Every day is a mix of deep technical work, strategic thinking and relationship building.


About the team
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud.

Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

- Experience working within software development or Internet-related industries

descriptionHtml:
Join our Reliability Maintenance Engineering (RME) team as an apprentice and launch your career in automation and maintenance engineering. Over two years, you will gain hands-on experience working with control systems and sensors while earning a competitive salary and receiving structured training from industry professionals.

In addition to solving technical problems, you will develop skills in planning, prioritisation, analytical thinking, communication, and teamwork. Throughout the programme, a dedicated mentor will support your growth and development. At the end of the programme, you will be fully trained and eligible for an Automation Engineer position within our maintenance teams.

Our programme is the perfect opportunity to learn the profession while achieving the required qualifications, as you will be studying at the same time as gaining experience in a real working environment, all while earning a competitive salary. Apply today, we are waiting for you! (If you would like to add a cover letter to your CV, please attach them in a single PDF.)

What Amazon Offers

A competitive salary throughout the two-year programme
• Career outlook: upon successful completion, you will be eligible for a full-time Automation Engineer role within Amazon's RME team, with clear progression pathways into senior engineering, controls specialisation, or team leadership
• Training curriculum delivered by industry professionals, combining on-site experience with our training facility in Milan, Italy
• Mentorship and continuous professional development
• Access to local benefits such as 5 weeks paid vacation (25 days), subsidised meals, life and accident insurance from Day 1, 10% Amazon.de employee discount, and more
• The opportunity to work with innovative automation technology in a fast-paced environment

Key job responsibilities
• Act as the site-level Subject Matter Expert (SME) for all control systems and sensors within the building; actively monitor, diagnose, and repair systems to ensure high equipment availability
• Train technicians in the fundamentals of control systems fault-finding to raise the overall level of technical knowledge on site
• Collaborate within the EU Controls network to enhance monitoring of Material Handling Equipment (MHE) metrics, and provide visualization and data to internal customers through troubleshooting and prioritisation
• Participate in or lead continuous improvement projects coordinated by the EU Controls network
• Work with IT, EU Controls Engineering, and Operations Engineering to ensure all systems are accurately documented and that backup libraries are maintained

A day in the life
As an apprentice in our RME programme, you will split your time between our facilities in Kojetín and our training facility in Milan, Italy.

During a typical month, you will spend approximately three weeks on site in Kojetín, where you will be fully embedded in the RME team, working alongside experienced engineers on live systems, participating in maintenance routines, troubleshooting equipment, and contributing to improvement projects. The remaining week will be spent at the training facility in Milan, where you will follow a structured curriculum covering automation theory, control systems, and hands-on lab exercises that complement your on-site learning.

This combination of real-world experience and formal training ensures you build both practical expertise and a strong technical foundation throughout the two-year programme.

title: Principal Engineer:  Annapurna Labs Training and Inference , Annapurna Labs, AWS Neuron SDK
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, Principal Engineers are both technical leaders and hands-on builders. As Amazon's most senior individual contributors, Principal Engineers work on our hardest problems, help establish technical standards, and drive the overall technical architecture, engineering practices, and methodologies for products that delight our customers. On the AWS Neuron SDK team within Annapurna Labs, that mandate is AI model performance on Amazon's custom silicon.

We are looking for a Principal Engineer to drive AI model performance across the lifecycle on AWS Trainium — pre-training, post-training and alignment, and inference serving — with deep hands-on expertise in one of these areas and the drive to influence across all three. Neuron is Amazon's software stack: the layer between customer ML frameworks and Trainium / Inferentia silicon. The responsibilities are broad: you will have the opportunity to drive deeply into model enablement across the path from a model's first pre-training step through aligned post-training to cost- and latency-optimized serving at scale.

You will drive performance for a wide range of AI models, including the leading open-source models and direct collaborations with foundation-model developers, as well as supporting Amazon's own internal model development initiatives. This is a deep hands-on builder role: you will write code, own the forward and backward path, and make binding technical decisions, while influencing direction across the broader Neuron organization, partner teams (EC2, EKS, VPC, Bedrock, HyperPod), and leading ML customers. Annapurna offers full-stack ownership — chip to server to network to compiler to cloud — so you see your work run at customer scale, something that doesn't exist at a standalone chip company or startup. Over time, this person ends up owning the whole process end-to-end.

Key job responsibilities
As the Principal Engineer for Annapurna Labs Training and Inference, you will bring deep hands-on expertise in one of the following areas and influence across all three:
Pre-Training Performance
●Kernel optimization for ML training — forward and backward path — and drive performance out of it, with training collective algorithms (collectives, all-reduce, cross-accelerator coordination) as the primary source of gains.
●Prove top-tier performance even at small scale, and clear the path so customers can land AI models on the chip out of the box. This is a performance role, not an Applied Science role — you partner with scientists but own making it fast, not making it correct.
Post-Training & Alignment
●Supervised fine-tuning, preference optimization, reinforcement learning, and alignment stack that turns pretrained base models into production-grade, aligned models on Trainium — the main lever on delivered model quality and the fastest-growing, least-covered workload class on Trainium today.
●Deliver first-class RLHF/RLAIF and preference methods (PPO, GRPO, DPO/IPO/KTO, reward modeling) with training-plus-inference co-location and convergence safeguards (KL control, reward-scaling, policy-collapse detection), and native performance for the post-training ecosystem (TRL, veRL, NeMo-Aligner, TorchTitan/TorchAO, JAX).
Inference / Serving
●Inference optimization strategy within the Neuron SDK — adapting inference algorithms to Trainium's unique architecture to unlock performance existing industry approaches leave on the table, and maximizing the chip's compute and memory bandwidth to drive cost and latency improvements for large-scale model serving.
●Influence hardware-software co-design by partnering with Annapurna's chip architecture teams so future silicon incorporates lessons from production model serving.
Influence across all three
●Serve as a technical leader on demanding, cross-functional projects spanning pre-training, post-training, and inference; functionally decompose complex problems into simple, straightforward solutions.
●Exert technical influence across multiple teams, mentor senior engineers, and raise the technical bar across the organization.
●Balance technical leadership with strong business judgment to make the right technology choices.

About the team
The AWS Neuron team builds the software stack — compiler, runtime, and ML frameworks — that powers Amazon's Trainium and Inferentia accelerators in EC2 Trn1/2 and Inf1 servers. Our Post-Training group focuses on making Trainium the best place to align and refine frontier models: reinforcement learning (RLHF/RLAIF), preference optimization (PPO, GRPO, DPO), and reward modeling at massive scale. We work end-to-end across a vertically integrated stack — hardware, compiler, runtime, PyTorch/JAX (XLA), and the open-source post-training ecosystem (TRL, veRL, OpenRLHF, NeMo-Aligner, Ray) — turning research techniques into production-grade, high-throughput systems that run efficiently across thousands of nodes.

We are a hands-on, customer-obsessed team that values deep technical ownership and collaboration across chip and software boundaries. You'll work directly with AWS customers and internal science teams to bring up new model families, remove scaling bottlenecks, and ship capabilities that let builders post-train and align large language and multi-modal models faster and more cost-effectively on AWS.

Basic qualifications

- 10+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 7+ years with distributed training or RL systems at scale; strong C/C++ and Python; experience with AI/ML model execution, inference serving, or compiler optimization; and technical leadership/mentorship of engineering teams.

Preferred qualifications

- Deep hands-on expertise in one of the following, with the ability to influence across all three (not expected to be expert in all): ML model architecture (transformers, MoE, diffusion) and distributed training at scale; post-training methods (SFT, RLHF/RLAIF, DPO/IPO/KTO, reward modeling, PPO/GRPO) with convergence/alignment depth; AI inference optimization and LLM serving on custom accelerators (TPU/GPU/ASIC); ML/post-training framework development (JAX, PyTorch/XLA, TRL, veRL, NeMo-Aligner, TorchTitan/TorchAO); algorithmic optimization (compiler, graph, kernel) and numerical debugging; or adjacent backgrounds (EDA, video pipeline, GPU graphics, HPC).

title: Financial Analyst, Inventory Quality Finance, Defect Cost Controllership (DCC)
descriptionHtml:
Every defect whether damaged, defective, missorted package or item has a cost story behind it, and you'll be the one uncovering it and quantifying it so you can drive the fix. Amazon's Central Operations Finance team is looking for a Senior Financial Analyst to serve as a trusted finance partner for Defect Cost Controllership (DCC), supporting operational and functional leaders across the network.

The NACF DCC finance team provides cost controllership and project return on investment alongside financial insights for end-to-end defect reduction processes and initiatives across the supply chain. This role will directly influence controllership over defect costs spanning damages, concessions, and missorts, driving measurable cost reduction across fulfillment centers. Our team translates operational KPIs into financial impact so stakeholders have the most current and reliable information to make the best possible decisions for Amazon.

As DCC expands its scope and takes on end-to-end defect reduction workstreams, we need a Senior Financial Analyst to help scale our controllership and cost insights capabilities. The team is investing in automated defect cost attribution and expanded reporting coverage while building new financial models to support warehouse damages initiatives.

You'll work with SQL, Excel, and financial systems like SAP to build models and mine large-scale data while automating reporting. This role sits within the NACF Finance organization and partners closely with operations, Retail & FBA business partners, and customer service finance teams. Your time will be split between deep analytical work, building forecasts, cost bridges, and ROI models, and collaborative sessions with cross-functional stakeholders to align on strategy and present findings to senior leadership.

There is significant room to grow in this role. You'll gain exposure to senior leaders and deep expertise across multiple cost domains, plus the opportunity to shape how DCC approaches financial controllership as the team scales.

Key job responsibilities
• Own end-to-end financial planning cycles including forecast modeling, variance bridging, network partnership, and presentations to senior leadership.
• Analyze large-scale quantitative data to build meaningful reports that drive defect cost reduction strategy and business improvement.
• Validate project financials to ensure accurate return-on-investment insights and track financial impact against budget baselines.
• Partner with senior stakeholders to align on cost strategy, challenge assumptions with data, and communicate financial insights clearly across audiences.
• Build and automate scalable processes that improve efficiency across finance workflows related to defect costs.

A day in the life
The DCC team focuses on finance controllership, cost savings, and end-to-end defect cost reduction across North America Customer Fulfillment. Your primary focus will be on workstreams that identify opportunities leading to cost reduction and process improvement that strengthen financial controllership. You'll also own project financial validations and return-on-investment analyses while tracking financial impact on budget baselines. The team plays a key role in decision making and developing financial insights as part of monthly and quarterly business reviews, leading cost business reviews, and providing ad-hoc analysis on large or ambiguous deliverables. Recent projects have ranged from building automated cost bridges for monthly business reviews to quantifying the financial impact of new defect reduction pilots across the network.

About the team
The DCC team supports multiple teams across North America Customer Fulfillment and collaborates with NA Quality, Customer Service, and end-to-end financial controllership. In cases of worldwide workstreams, the team collaborates with business partners across the globe. What sets this team apart is the breadth of exposure. You'll work across every major defect category in the fulfillment network, partnering with operators and finance leaders alike to turn cost data into action.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of finance, accounting, or related analytical field experience
- Bachelor's degree in business, finance, accounting, tax, economics, or a related analytical field
- Experience with advanced use of SQL for data mining and business intelligence

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working with large-scale data mining and reporting tools (examples: SQL, MS Access, Essbase, Cognos) and other financial systems (examples: Oracle, SAP, Lawson, JD Edwards)
- MBA, or CPA
- Experience in financial modeling, P&L management or analysis
- 3+ years of identifying, leading, and executing opportunities to improve, automate, standardize or simplify finance or business tools and processes experience
- Experience participating in continuous improvement projects in your team to scale and improve controllership with measurable results
- Experience in creating process improvements with automation and analysis

The Reliability Maintenance Engineering (RME) team at Amazon is fundamental to our operations – they’re the ones keeping vital machinery running at all times. As an RME Technician, you’ll maintain a wide range of equipment and workspaces while upholding Health and Safety best practices.

You'll help to keep your colleagues safe and prevent machine downtime. Our RME Technicians boost the availability and quality of our equipment and work to enhance the operational environment too.

A day in the life
Our RME Technicians are based on-site, so they can respond quickly to any machinery issues. You’ll carry out a range of planned preventative maintenance to our sites’ equipment to make sure it’s working safely. As an RME Technician, you’ll also respond promptly to breakdowns, investigating, finding, and implementing solutions as quickly as possible. You’ll also make suggestions for long-term improvements.

Working alongside senior colleagues, you’ll undertake day-to-day maintenance tasks and will liaise with contractors if you need external expertise. You’ll work on a range of shifts to make sure our sites are supported around the clock – allowing Amazon to deliver at the speed we’re known for.

About the team
Our Reliability Maintenance Engineering or RME team keep our equipment performing at its best. We're a technically minded team, made up of excellent team players and guided by experienced leaders. We work together to maintain, troubleshoot and repair equipment across our global network of fulfilment centres. Some of our people are leaders, who oversee the team as they work on exciting technology – some of which only exists at Amazon.

From installing automated packaging systems to overseeing the general maintenance of a site to repairing key distribution equipment, our team handles most aspects of Amazon’s technical side. This includes keeping buildings legally compliant, so everyone is safe, and our sites are operating at maximum efficiency. There are lots of opportunities for progression, both within the RME team and more widely across Amazon.

Everything we do focuses on reducing downtime in Amazon’s crucial operations sites, so customers get their orders on time. We often work during early or late hours to carry out maintenance with minimal disruption, including night shifts. If we spot a better way to do something, we have the skills and the opportunity to develop and introduce completely new processes or cutting-edge tech like Amazon Robotics and our Complex Item Sorter.

title: Innovation lab Lead, Fulfillment Centre Operations
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, we strive to be Earth's most customer-centric company where people can find and discover anything they want to buy online. We hire the world's brightest minds, offering them an environment in which they can relentlessly improve the experience for customers. Innovation and creativity are built into the DNA of the company and are encouraged at all levels of employment. Every day we solve complex technical and business problems with ingenuity and simplicity. We're making history and the good news is we've only just begun.

Summary: Amazon is a highly data-driven company that is passionate about its customers. As our operations network grows across Fulfilment Centres, Sort Centres, IXDs, Return Centres, Last Mile Stations, Quick Commerce hubs and Micro Fulfilment Centres, automation is key to delivering orders on time, with quality, safely and at lower cost. The Innovation Lab at BLR8 is where new automation solutions, such as Autonomous Mobile Robots (AMRs), automated packing equipment and internally developed tools, are piloted, tested and proven on a live floor before they scale across the network.

The Team Lead is a hands-on role at the centre of every pilot. They run the trials themselves, keep the pilot area safe, collect the data that proves or disproves each solution, and turn what works into standard work that other sites can adopt. This role suits someone with strong operations floor experience who is curious about technology, works well without direct supervision, and can get engineering, vendor and site teams moving toward the same outcome without having authority over them.

A day in the life
**Job Deliverables:**
- Pilot execution:
- Run pilots on the floor to the agreed test plan, including operating and testing the equipment yourself
- Set up pilot stations, material flow and test scenarios before each trial window
- Flag deviations from the test plan, and equipment or process failures, the same day they happen
- Safety in automation zones:
- Enforce the safety controls for the pilot area
- Carry out pre-trial safety checks and risk assessments for every new setup or process change
- Report and investigate near-misses and incidents in the pilot area
- Data and reporting:
- Collect physical pilot data (time studies, cycle times, downtime and fault logs, exception counts) according to the Business Analyst's data plan
- Check data accuracy at the end of each trial day and publish the daily pilot report
- Keep a live issue log (equipment faults, process gaps, user feedback) and follow up with Engineering, Controls and vendors until each item is closed
- Standard work and scale readiness:
- Draft and update SOPs and Standard Job Instructions (SJIs) for each pilot as the process changes
- Build training material and train site associates and teams on new equipment when a pilot moves to a live site
- Capture floor learnings for the deployment package that goes with a solution when it scales to other sites
- Conduct 4M and 5S audits on pilot workstations every day and keep the lab audit-ready for leadership and vendor visits
- Coordinate vendor and engineering teams on the floor during installation, trials and troubleshooting windows
- Work with site operations teams to schedule trials at their sites without disrupting their production
- Deep-dive on pilot metrics and propose clear actions and process improvements
- Stand in for the Ops Lead when needed

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Experience with Microsoft Office products and applications
- Experience with Excel

Preferred qualifications

- 1+ years of customer-facing environment, warehousing, logistics or manufacturing experience

title: Senior Solutions Architect, National Security Solutions Architecture Team
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services is seeking a Senior Solutions Architect to support our US Government customers in the Northern Virginia / DC Metro area. (Relocation assistance is available.)

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen and must currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph. The position further requires the candidate to opt into a commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work.

As a Solutions Architect on the National Security team, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor to your Intelligence Community customers. You are the “face of Amazon” to your customers, and they will consult you regarding a broad variety of technical challenges that are complex and mission-critical. You can build sample solutions, “think big,” and provide architecture designs and cloud enablement strategy that suit your customer’s business and technical needs. This is a high-visibility role where you collaborate with and influence external stakeholders (our government customers) and internal AWS teams like Sales and Platform Engineering.

National Security Solutions Architects are regarded as technical “thought leaders” within the Intelligence Community who evangelize emerging technologies on a conceptual level and on a practical, architectural level. Our SAs have played a critical role in the widespread adoption and advancement of cloud computing capabilities within the Intelligence Community. SAs think outside of the box to deliver results to our customers and provide solutions that are cost-effective, time-saving, and secure. As a National Security SA, you’ll solve problems at both the business and technical levels. You'll work backwards from our customers’ requirements and envision new mechanisms and strategies we can leverage that would enable agencies to operate more efficiently and better execute on their goals. Then, you'll figure out how to make the puzzle pieces fit together from the technical side and deliver the offering to the customer at scale. Frequently, you will be responsible for mission-critical solutions with life-saving implications.

Sometimes, the best way to innovate around a customer pain point is to create a new product altogether. This position offers you the unique opportunity to drive the AWS service roadmap to support our customers’ requirements within the complex technical constraints of the cleared environment.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for technologists who align with our Leadership Principles and possess a unique balance of technical depth and strong interpersonal skills. You will partner with customers, AWS Sales, and several other AWS teams to craft highly scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures that address Intelligence Community customer business problems and accelerate the adoption of AWS services. In collaboration with Sales, you will drive revenue growth across a broad set of customers. As a trusted customer advocate, the solutions architect will help organizations understand best practices around advanced cloud-based solutions and how to migrate existing workloads to the cloud. You will have the opportunity to help shape and execute a strategy to build mindshare and broad use of AWS within the Intelligence Community. The ideal candidate is be self-motivated, with a proven track record in software/technology sales or consulting. The ability to connect technology with measurable business value is critical to a solutions architect. You should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically about business, products, and technical challenges.

We are looking for someone who is passionate about the following:
- Be great fun to work with at AWS. We have a credo of “Work hard. Have fun. Make history." In this role, you will love what you do and instinctively know how to make work fun. You will be dynamic, creative, and willing to take on any challenge and make a big impact.
- Enjoy working with Intelligence Community customers. You will have a passion for educating, training, designing, and building cloud solutions for a diverse and challenging set of Intelligence Community customers.
- Have a strong understanding of large-scale computing solutions. The ideal candidate will have past experience working as a systems or support engineer and pre-sales experience. You will enjoy keeping your existing technical skills honed and developing new ones, so you can make strong contributions to deep architecture discussions. You will regularly take part in deep-dive education and design exercises to create world-class solutions built on AWS.

This position can have periods of up to 25% travel.

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen and must currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph.

Key job responsibilities
- In partnership with the sales team, formulate and execute a sales strategy to exceed revenue objectives through the adoption of AWS
- As a key member of the business development and sales team, ensure success in building and migrating applications, software and services on the AWS platform
- Educate customers of all sizes on the value proposition of AWS, and participate in deep architectural discussions to ensure solutions are designed for successful deployment in the cloud
- Conduct one-to-few and one-to-many training sessions to transfer knowledge to customers considering or already using AWS
- Capture and share best-practice knowledge among the AWS solutions architect community
- Author or otherwise contribute to AWS customer-facing publications such as whitepapers and other reusable content
- Build deep relationships with senior technical individuals within customers to enable them to be cloud advocates
- Act as a technical liaison between customers, service engineering teams and support

About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

- Bachelor's degree, or CASP+ (CompTIA Advanced Security Practitioner) or CCSP (Certified Cloud Security Professional) or Cloud+ or CSSLP (Certified Secure Software Lifecycle Professional)

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) provides a highly reliable, scalable, and low-cost cloud platform that powers thousands of businesses in over 190 countries. AWS’ Infrastructure Supply Chain & Procurement (AIS SC) organization works to deliver industry leading solutions to source, build and maintain our socially responsible data center supply chains. We are a team of highly-motivated, engaged, and responsive professionals who enable the core sustainable infrastructure of AWS.

We are seeking a highly effective supply chain program manager to lead an our procurement management program. In this role, the candidate will create and lead the best practices across AWS' semiconductor supply chain in close collaboration with both internal and external cross functional teams. This program is critical to help enable AWS’s ISCaP team achieve continuity of supply and cost goals.

The successful candidate must be a self-starter comfortable with ambiguity, with high attention to detail, and a proven ability to work in a fast-paced and ever-changing environment. Candidates must have excellent analytical capabilities, particularly in Finance, program management experience, be comfortable diving deep into data, have strong writing skills, lead executive-level reviews, and communicate clearly and effectively to all levels of the company, both in writing and in meetings.

The ideal candidate will not only raise the bar on delivering a best-in-class process to manage a complex supply chain and procurement operation, but is also a person who actively participates with a strong curiosity to understand the business end-to-end, and has a track record of using data to influence decision makers.

In this role, you will:

- Serve as a key member of the AWS Infrastructure supply chain team in helping to define and deliver key processes to manage complex supply chain strategies.
- Build robust and scalable sourcing processes that interface with many critical components within AWS' server architecture
- Manage complex financial and legal requirements and lead key inventory activities that will impact our supply chain.
- Produce written recommendations and insights for key stakeholders to help shape solution design.
- Handle multiple projects at once, deal with ambiguity and rapidly-changing priorities.
- Drive the development of scalable and reliable analytical tools, dashboards, and metrics that drive key decisions and resource prioritization.

Our environment is fast-paced and requires someone who is hard-working, meticulous and energetic, who gets things done at an effective pace, gets results, and is comfortable working with tight deadlines and changing priorities.

title: Editor-in-Chief, AWS Blogs, AWS Cross Category Product Marketing
descriptionHtml:
AWS Blogs is one of the most widely read technology publications in cloud computing, reaching millions of developers, architects, and technology leaders. It spans more than 50 channels covering AI, cloud infrastructure, security, databases, and more. We are transforming AWS Blogs into a newsroom-model publication that prioritizes editorial quality, expert perspectives, and reader trust over publishing volume.

We are looking for an Editor-in-Chief to lead this transformation. This person is equal parts editorial craftsperson and technology enthusiast. You follow the technology landscape closely, form strong opinions about where it is heading, and translate that judgment into editorial decisions about what to publish, when, and for whom. You think like a journalist, edit with precision, and understand how editorial rigor builds audience trust and business impact.

In this role, you will set the publication's editorial strategy, define quality standards, and select the stories that appear on our front page. Equally important, you will determine what does not fit with the publication’s editorial direction. You will commission, write, and edit stories alongside subject-matter experts, preserving each author's voice while raising every piece to a consistent bar. You will assign and manage a team of desk editors and topic owners.

This role sits in AWS Marketing and partners with product teams, developer relations, field marketing, and communications.


Key job responsibilities
• Define the editorial charter, voice, and quality bar for AWS Blogs.
• Stay current on AI, cloud, developer tools, and software architecture. Surface the topics and technical developments that will matter to practitioners before they become obvious.
• Commission, assign, and edit content, from light copy edits to full rewrites. Hold every post to a standard of one practitioner speaking to another.
• Write original articles and executive bylines grounded in customer stories, data, and real-world impact.
• Own the editorial calendar and manage two publishing paths: a hands-on desk-led path for top stories and a self-serve path for scaled submissions.
• Coordinate the v-team of desk editors and topic owners across AWS. Provide editorial direction and build a culture of quality without direct reporting authority.
• Partner with PR, communications, and marketing teams to shape announcement narratives into clear, story-forward content.
• Drive content discoverability through SEO, AI-engine optimization, and structured content for answer-engine citation.
• Track performance metrics and use data to inform editorial decisions and raise the quality bar.
• Identify new formats, channels, and distribution strategies to extend reach and keep the publication relevant to how practitioners discover content.

Basic qualifications

- 10+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
- Experience building cross-functional partnerships and influencing stakeholders across the organization to act without having a direct reporting relationship
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Business, Journalism, Marketing, Communications, or a related field
- Experience running a blog or editorial program at scale, including calendar management, contributor coordination, and review workflows.
- Experience writing and editing skills across formats: technical content, thought leadership, customer stories, and executive communications.

Preferred qualifications

- Genuine enthusiasm for technology, with fluency in cloud computing, AI/ML, developer tools, or enterprise software.
- Experience in technology journalism or editorial leadership at a technology company.
- Understanding of SEO and AI-engine optimization (AEO), including structuring content for AI discoverability.
- Experience with CMS platforms at enterprise scale.
- Comfort writing about technical topics for a practitioner audience without oversimplifying.
- Experience ghostwriting for executives and adapting tone across audiences.
- Data-driven approach to editorial decisions using content performance metrics.
