title: Security and Loss Prevention Expert, NA
descriptionHtml:
The Security and Loss Prevention Expert (SLP Expert) is a key leadership position within the Amazon Security and Loss Prevention (S&LP) team. This role leads the effort to efficiently and effectively provide End-to-End (E2E) S&LP services across all assigned operational business units. This position reports to the SLP Cluster Manager.

Key job responsibilities
* Identify vulnerabilities and conduct root cause analysis using data to define mitigating actions while ensuring compliance with legal and ethical standards.
* Actively monitor and report outcome for systems and tools that generate data indicating site/region opportunities.
* Manage confidential investigations and prepare prompt reports of theft, fraud, and workplace violence/critical incidents.
* Utilize continuous improvement to drive process enhancements and increase efficiency.
* Serve as department's liaison and security/crisis management subject matter expert keeping site leadership informed on department's key issues, strategies and the performance.
* Identify, promote and implement security best practices while effectively partnering with internal customers to evaluate current and future security needs, processes, and initiatives, incident response planning, facilitating and management.
* Domestic regional travel up to 50% of the time when applicable.
* Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach; Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts; Work in an environment where the noise level varies and can be loud; Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments); Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs).
* This role covers 24/7 operations and must be able to work all shifts, including nights, weekends, and holidays.

A day in the life
As a SLP Expert, you will join a team of S&LP professionals providing security as a service to business customers across multiple business units within a dedicated geographical area. You perform regular physical security audits and investigate policy violations, security-related incidents, and loss events. During your investigations, you will collect information by monitoring systems and tools, analyzing data reports, and conducting interviews. Your findings contribute to identifying vulnerabilities in various processes to identify and drive mitigating measures. You play a key role in maintaining the physical integrity of our sites by auditing and monitoring the health status of our systems and, jointly with subject matter experts and external suppliers, maintain their functionality. Furthermore, you identify and act upon initiatives improving our physical security infrastructure and contribute directly to the budgetary planning for our external suppliers. You interact on a daily basis with our external security service providers to ensure delivery of high-quality security services and a smooth customer experience. You will be working on multiple high-impact initiatives/projects by collaborating with stakeholders across organizational levels to deliver measurable outcomes through effective project management. Finally, you deliver loss prevention-related education and awareness programs to other teams across all management levels and manage the implementation of our S&LP plan.

About the team
Worldwide Operations Security (WWOS) is the global organization that supports field Loss Prevention and is designed to support Amazon's Worldwide Operations, as well as affiliate and retail businesses, by creating and maintaining a work environment that is both prepared and secure through global security centers of excellence staffed by subject matter experts in people and asset protection. We accomplish this by creating policy and implementation guidelines; training leadership and staff; using technology to eliminate subjectivity, complexity, and variation; identifying, preparing for, and mitigating risk; and auditing our practices to ensure compliance.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 4+ years of relevant professional or military experience
- 2+ years of security service, loss prevention, asset protection, investigations, or law enforcement, or 2+ years of Amazon (Blue Badge/FTE) experience

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in implementing metric-based strategies utilizing continuous improvement concepts
- Experience in physical security systems maintenance/implementation and coordinating scope of work with security vendors
- 2+ years of operational experience in risk management, audit, data analytics, inventory control, quality assurance, retail, warehouse, distribution center services, delivery service, or supply chain
- Investigative interviewing experience; Wicklander and Zulawski, Loss Prevention Qualified, Certified Protection Professional, Loss Prevention Certified, Certified Forensic Interviewer, Certified Threat Assessment Certification or other relevant certifications
- Workplace incident mitigation or de-escalation and business continuity planning experience
- Proficient in Microsoft Office; including use of Excel pivot tables and development of charts/graphics

title: IT Support Associate II, OTS
descriptionHtml:
About Operations Technology Solutions (OTS)
Operations is at the heart of Amazon’s business. We are known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service. Our buildings deliver tens of thousands of products to hundreds of countries worldwide, every day. OTS provides nonstop global IT support to Amazon Operations as a vital piece to the puzzle. We are looking for self-motivated individuals to take
on new challenges and motivate teams in fostering solutions to the hurdles we face. Together, we take ownership for what we do — whether supporting IT infrastructure, developing new technology in-house, launching a new Amazon Operations facility, or delighting our customers by delivering packages directly to them.

About The Role
As an IT Support Associate II, you will use your skills to support the operations team in resolving technical problems within Amazon operations facilities in a defined geographical area that span across a multitude of technical disciplines. We are committed to improvement; you will be encouraged to participate in career development opportunities as presented to progress your career at Amazon.

What Do We Offer?
Amazon offers competitive compensation packages including comprehensive healthcare benefits starting on Day 1, matching 401(k) program, and up to 20 weeks of paid parental leave. But wait, there’s more: we are a casual dress code at each of our locations (jeans, t-shirts, safety shoes and at times a neon safety vest will be your daily outfit). Learn more about Amazon in Andy Jassy's most recent letter to shareholders at https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/company-news/2021-letter-to-shareholders.

Key job responsibilities
Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
- Allocating, maintaining, and troubleshooting of IT equipment used in Amazon Operations facilities.
- Handling support requests and procedures across the network.
- Assisting in training new hires.
- Continuous learning of new technologies.
- Supporting customers from multiple buildings in the area, as well as remote customers.
- Traveling within your local or regional area to support our customers.

Basic qualifications

- Experience troubleshooting integrated and interdependent computer systems
- Experience in a dynamic environment with a high degree of customer service
- Can lift up to 49 pounds, stand/walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, and be able to frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- 1+ years of Windows, Mac or Linux Operating systems support experience or equivalent experience

Preferred qualifications

- CompTIA A+, CompTIA Network+, Cisco/CCNA, Linux (Redhat), Microsoft hardware (installation), AWS, or other industry relevant certifications

title: Software Dev Engineer II,  Amazon Interactive Video Service (IVS)
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Interactive Video Service (Amazon IVS) is AWS's fully managed live streaming service, built on the same battle-tested technology that powers Twitch and trusted by thousands of enterprises across gaming, social, live commerce, sports, and entertainment.

Our mission: enable developers to build communities around live video. We handle everything from ingest to processing to delivery at global scale, so developers can focus on creating interactive, engaging live experiences for their audiences. Whether you're streaming to tens of millions of concurrent viewers or just getting started, Amazon IVS removes the complexity so developers can move fast.

The IVS Stream Management team builds and operates the distributed systems that coordinate stream sessions end-to-end and keep the underlying fleet healthy under bursty, unpredictable load. As a software engineer on this team, you'll design and build systems that start and manage live streams for millions of viewers worldwide — working on systems that sit behind the customer-facing APIs and make every live stream possible.


Key job responsibilities
- Own the technical direction of one or more services in the Stream Management portfolio; write the design docs, socialize them across IVS and adjacent teams, and drive them to implementation.
- Work closely with engineers, product managers, and applied scientists to deliver seamless customer experiences.
- Ensure backend systems are highly available, scalable, and secure at AWS scale.
- Apply backend best practices including testing, performance optimization, observability, and maintainable code.
- Collaborate with other AWS service teams to integrate shared services and deliver consistent AWS service experiences.
- Participate in code reviews, architecture discussions, design reviews, and on-call rotations.
- Drive operational excellence through automation, metrics, alarms, and runbooks.
- Lead post-incident investigations for high-severity events in our services; drive the resulting action items to completion.

A day in the life
You might start the morning by reviewing operational dashboards for anything anomalous in transcode start rates, then jump into a design review for a proposal to extend one of your services to a new region. Mid-morning you pair with a teammate on a tricky race condition in stream session teardown. In the afternoon you meet with a partner team to align on a protocol change and write a short doc summarizing the tradeoffs of two capacity-planning approaches. The work spans distributed systems, live video infrastructure, and cross-team coordination, and no two days look the same.

About the team
Amazon Interactive Video Service (Amazon IVS) is a managed live streaming solution from AWS that enables low-latency and real-time video experiences for millions of viewers worldwide. We power engaging live experiences for some of the largest customers in the live video space and continuously push the boundaries of what’s possible with interactive video technology.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- 5+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Familiarity with live video concepts: common streaming protocols, transcoding, and codecs
- Experience implementing AWS services in a variety of distributed computing environments
- Experience with real time media streaming: HLS, DASH, WebRTC, MOQ or equivalent

title: Software Development Engineer II, Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is building a global e-commerce experience for Internet Service Provider (ISP) customers, and we need a Software Development Engineer II. You will build the backend-for-frontend layer, the service that sits directly behind the customer-facing surfaces and orchestrates over the many backend systems that make satellite internet work: ordering, payments, billing, equipment and network provisioning, and support. The job is to shape what the frontend needs, route and orchestrate requests across those systems, translate between them, and compose their responses into reliable operations the customer experience can depend on. The core of the work is integration: calling many APIs, handling partial failures gracefully, mapping between different service models, and keeping latency and reliability high across a lot of moving parts. Much of this is built zero-to-one and expanding into new countries, so you will move from ambiguous problems to working products. You will own the full development lifecycle and work closely with frontend, product, and partner service teams.

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and build backend gateway APIs in Java that route and orchestrate requests across many downstream services, from concept through deployment and operation.
- Integrate with ordering, payments, billing, equipment and network provisioning, and support services: calling their APIs, translating between their models, and composing their responses.
- Handle the realities of a distributed system: partial failures, retries, timeouts, error translation, and keeping latency and reliability high across many dependencies.
- Work with product managers, frontend engineers, and partner service teams, and help the platform expand into new countries.
- Use agentic development workflows and generative AI tools to deliver faster, and improve the system with AWS native services.
- Review code, give feedback, and coach teammates on service integration patterns and well-tested code.
- Document your team's software and train new team members on how it is built, tested, and operated.

About the team
We build the e-commerce experience for a global ISP customer base at Amazon Leo. Our team owns the backend-for-frontend layer: the single API the customer-facing app talks to, and the orchestration behind it that connects to the systems provisioning and running satellite internet. We work hand in hand with the frontend team, shaping our APIs around what their experiences need. We are scaling the team and investing in AI-based development and operational workflows.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- 3+ years of programming using a modern programming language such as Java, C++, or C#, including object-oriented design experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience testing back end services

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- 2+ years of contributing to new and current systems architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) experience
- Experience with test-driven development
- Experience with dependency injection, API modeling, and clean layering (separating API endpoints, business-logic orchestration, and downstream service clients)
- Experience building API gateway, orchestration, or backend-for-frontend services that integrate many downstream dependencies

title: エリアマネージャー, SSD
descriptionHtml:
※このポジションの勤務地は東京都町田市を予定しています。

私たちのグローバルオペレーションネットワークは、日々何百万もの荷物と笑顔をアマゾンのお客様にお届けしています。私たちは、エリアマネージャーとして私たちのチームに加わってほしいと考え、意欲的で顧客重視の人材を探しています。この役割では、複数メンバーのチームをリードし、シフト中のチームの安全性、品質、出勤率、およびパフォーマンスを最高水準に維持するため、チームに働きかける責任があります。また、お客様の注文が適切な時間に適切な場所へ確実にお届けされるよう、お客様の期待に応えることにおいても重要な役割を担います。

私たちの業務の流れには3つの主要な要素があります。
商品が保管され注文に備える「ファーストマイル」、注文品をお客様のエリアまで輸送する「ミドルマイル」、そして商品をお客様の玄関先までお届けする「ラストマイル」です。各拠点で運営方法に若干の違いはありますが、一貫して変わらないものが一つあります、それは顧客を第一に考える私たちのビジョンと献身的な姿勢です。

本ポジションはAmazonの新しいエキサイティングな物流拠点で業務を行います。可能な限り最速でお客様のご自宅に商品をお届けすることでお客様のカスタマーエクスペリエンスを向上します。私たちと一緒に歴史をつくりましょう！

Amazonでは、最新のAI Tool, 生成AIを日々の業務の中に積極的に取り入れています。
AI Toolは私たちの意思決定のスピードを加速させ、私たちを本当に重要な「判断」と「議論」に集中させることを可能にしています。Amazon では学習を継続する文化が根付いているため、ご自身のペースでAIに関する知識を深めることができるリソースが用意されています。


Key job responsibilities
■業務内容■
「エリアマネージャー」には、他業種・職種も含めこれまでの経験、スキルを活かし、改善点を模索しながら、「People First」の考え方で、各種プロジェクトをリードし、またピープルマネージメントを行っていただきます。また、「エリアマネージャー」は拠点の全ての工程を担当し、上司の示す部署全体の方針や安全・品質・生産性の年間目標に沿って、担当工程における改善を積み重ね、日々の計画、進捗、実績管理に責任をもち活動いただきます。

具体的な業務は以下の通りです。

主な責任と職務内容：
① チームメンバーの育成とサポート
現場の最前線にいるマネージャーとしてチームメンバーと積極的に関わり、メンバーからの意見に基づく職場改善によりエンゲージメントを高めます。また、数名から数十名のチームのマネージャーとして、業務上の知識・スキル、アマゾンカルチャー等の指導を行うことはもちろん、部下の悩みに傾聴し、問題の解決に向けて自ら動きます。さらに、部下の勤怠や労働時間等の把握、管理を適切に行います。

② 担当プロセスの安全・品質・作業効率の向上
マネージャーはそれぞれ特定のプロセスを担当し、そのプロセスの安全・品質・作業効率の向上をリードします。日々の安全活動、品質チェックに加え、作業環境の改善、トレーニングの進捗管理など多岐にわたる改善活動が該当します。問題を特定し、対策を立案し、チームメンバーを巻き込みながら実行に移し、結果を出していくことが求められます。

③ 日々のオペレーション対応
物流拠点のすべての工程を管理し、商品の管理からお客様へお届けするまでの一連の流れの中で計画を立案し管理していただきます。日々のオペレーションにおいてお客様にお約束した納期を確実に守るため、物量の上振れや下振れ、急な労働力不足、システムトラブル等の変動要素に際し、適切に判断して対応していくことが求められます。

④ プロジェクトリーダーとして改善を推進
Amazonでは日々改善が推進されています。エリアマネージャーは通常業務と並行して、安全上のリスクや生産性を改善するプロジェクトのリーダーとして拠点内の年次/月次プロジェクト活動を推進します。これらのプロジェクトにおいては関連部署との協業等も含まれます。

The Generation Service Technician has safety, customer satisfaction, and business responsibilities within data center operations. The person in this role is responsible for identifying, troubleshooting, diagnosing and providing quality repairs of electrical generator systems and related engine mechanical failures. The Generator Service Technician is both the technical expert and primary customer support contact to the customer, and is therefore responsible for continually communicating with the customer to provide an exceptional customer experience and drive data center up-time and availability.

The generator team is a tight knit crew that often collaborates to complete large tasks. The volunteerism and communication on this team sets a high bar.

Preferred qualifications

We ensure that you get what you want when we promised it to you. We are at the core of Amazon's business and our software is mission-critical.

The Outbound Execution group, based in Toronto, creates the software that makes it easy for Amazon staff to safely, quickly and accurately perform the most labour-intensive warehouse function: picking the items for your order. We deal with real physical processes, and our systems need to make decisions within real-time constraints. As a Systems Engineer in RDPI, you will be overseeing large scale project planning, installation, and launch of industrial automation technologies across Amazons growing Stores network. This field engineering position demands strong technical skills for deploying robotic equipment, including mechanical and electrical systems, network configurations, and software coordination. The ideal candidate has experience with complex electro-mechanical and network systems, large scale installations, and system troubleshooting. You will work with cross-functional partners across the Amazon Fulfillment Technology & Robotics engineering, safety, product strategy, software, supply chain, third-party installers, contracted deployment engineers, construction teams, and internal operations customer teams, functioning as the lead on-site project manager to provide technical oversight on installation Amazon-designed automation equipment. This Systems Engineer position is an individual contributor role, influencing and leading stakeholders from planning through go-live of each project. Project durations vary from a few days to several months each. This is a travel-based role and you will be expected to travel to meet the requirements of your projects across North America, upwards of 75% or more.

**Relocation to Amazon Corporate offices in Seattle, Boston, Nashville or Austin will be required for the role.



Key job responsibilities
As a Systems Engineer II, a candidate will typically own multiple simultaneous deployments of a single technology across multiple sites or oversee multi-technology deployments within a single site; delivering within documented standards. This role requires a balance of experience both in working with high-complexity industrial technologies, with complex, multi-dependency project management. The ideal candidate is proactive and takes independent initiative in improving system performance and handling end-to-end deployment. In parallel to the execution, candidates will be responsible for driving continuous improvement ideas into both the deployment cycle time (safety, quality and productivity), and will be responsible for sharing engineering design improvements feedback to the hardware engineering and product teams, to simplify the installation. This role will require the ability to build relationships and capture and synthesize the voice of the customer.

- You will manage the tactical deployment of large scale industrial automation technologies, ranging in technical complexity and product maturity from early alpha/beta to mature Generally Available.

- You will own the tactical execution (onsite coordination of installation and acceptance testing) to achieve the target “go-live” date for each project assigned; delivering independently.

- You will collaborate with hardware engineering, technical program managers, product managers, and internal customers including site maintenance and operations teams to convert technical requirements into refined deployment execution documents (schedules, Standard Operating Procedures, dependencies, etc.)

- You will improve operational metrics and team processes through automation and optimization

- You will independently resolve difficult technical problems during deployment, considering operational burden and making appropriate trade-offs between time, quality, and resources

- You will create and improve standard work documents and operational guidebooks, and work towards automating or improving team processes.

- You will influence internal and partner teams towards meeting team level goals.

- You will develop subject matter expertise in one or more deployment domains

- You will mentor junior engineers and participate in technical assessment

- You will drive operational excellence initiatives with measurable results





A day in the life
In this role you will be focused on execution of end-to-end deployment and manage technical ambiguity around integration of workcells in fulfillment centers. On a daily basis you will collaborate with hardware engineering, technical program managers, product managers, construction teams, and internal customers including site maintenance and operations teams, to ensure a safe, on time, high quality product is delivered to the internal customer. You will travel to your project sites, collaborate both virtually and in person, to ensure all business stakeholders are aligned on program status. You will manage the day-to-day project execution, and work on continuous improvement activities to improve deployment execution first pass yield. You will work with senior engineers and your manager to develop technical depth and begin building strategic thinking skills for future growth.

Amazon offers a full range of benefits that support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners and their children. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment. The benefits that generally apply to regular, full-time employees include:

1. Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
2. Maternity and Parental Leave Options
3. Paid Time Off (PTO)
4. 401(k) Plan

If you are not sure that every qualification on the list above describes you exactly, we'd still love to hear from you! At Amazon, we value people with unique backgrounds, experiences, and skillsets. If you’re passionate about this role and want to make an impact on a global scale, please apply!

About the team
Are you inspired by invention? Is problem solving through teamwork in your DNA? Do you like the idea of seeing how your work impacts the bigger picture? Answer yes to any of these and you’ll fit right in here at Robotics Delivery & Packaging Innovation (RDPI) within Amazon Robotics (AR). We are a smart, collaborative team of enthusiastic doers that work passionately to apply cutting edge advances in robotics and software to solve real-world challenges that will transform our customers’ experiences in ways we can’t even image yet. We invent new improvements every day. We are RDPI and we will give you the tools and support you need to invent with us in ways that are rewarding, fulfilling and fun

RDPI Tech Deployment are missioned with enabling the delivery of large scale automation technologies designed and manufactured by Amazon. The team is multi-disciplinary, and consists of Field Deployment Engineers, Controls Engineering, Design for Deployment, Product Single Threaded Leaders, and a Program Management Office team, who collaborate on enabling the delivery of new technologies and packaging solutions that delight our customers, and improve the safety, quality and costs within the Amazon fulfillment processes. The team is geographically located across four North America hub locations. The work we deliver directly impact high priority goals set each year to our most senior leadership at Amazon.

title: Sr. Risk Manager, Finance Operations, Finance Operations Risk, Governance, & Experience
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is seeking a Senior Risk Manager to support the Finance Operations (FinOps) Controllership team at Amazon. We’re looking for someone who can take lead in understanding complex FinOps processes and identify the full range of risks related to processes, regulatory compliance, organization, policy, and technology. This individual will ensure FinOps processes stay ahead of risks associated with process design, internal control effectiveness, computer system integration, and other relevant areas.
As a Senior Risk Manager on the FORGE team, you won't just find problems, you'll architect solutions. You will lead high-impact audits and risk programs across Finance Operations (FinOps), with a primary focus on Global Real Estate & Facilities. Your work will directly strengthen the control environment, protect Amazon from material risk, and drive the kind of operational excellence that lets Finance scale with confidence.

In this role, you will lead and oversee projects, such as inspections, risk assessments, and advisory services, that shape process and control design to mitigate risk and drive a continuous controllership culture. Responsibilities will also include preparation of findings and engagement with stakeholders to complete action items. Your subject matter expertise is critical to develop strong working knowledge of processes, current initiatives, and organizational changes.

This role requires strong leadership skills to influence others and/or self-serve in order to achieve critical inspection objectives. You will be expected to identify risks in our processes and work with the appropriate owners to mitigate risks. You will need to dive deep to understand Amazon’s disparate and complex processes and related applications and work through ambiguity to deliver results.

Key job responsibilities
Successful candidates must be eager to dive deep into processes and have a proven record of delivering meaningful risks and recommendations to the business. The candidate should have strong auditing skills, problem solving skills, systems and process knowledge, and a passion for customer service. Specific core responsibilities are below:
• Perform risk assessments of the organization
• Perform end to end audits, including scoping, fieldwork, and reporting
• Evaluate design and effectiveness of FinOps controls
• Evaluate policy and process exceptions
• Prepare clear, compelling audit reports, executive narratives, and leadership-ready communications. Present findings, recommendations, and risk trade-offs to senior leaders (Director and above) with precision and confidence
• Provide training that improves and raises the bar on controllership with respect to policies and other requirements
• Support ad hoc inspections, deep dives, and reviews across broader FinOps and upstream business processes as new risks emerge or business needs evolve
• Provide strategic perspective on risk-related business and technology decisions. Help stakeholders see around corners, prioritize the right mitigation investments, and avoid building risk into new processes

A day in the life
• Lead scoping, planning, and execution of complex audits and risk assessments across FinOps processes.
• Own end-to-end lifecycle of high-impact, cross-functional risk programs.
• Identify control gaps, evaluate control effectiveness, and drive sustainable remediation plans.
• Define project objectives, success criteria, and risk reduction metrics.
• Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to prioritize risk initiatives, influence decisions, and drive execution.
• Develop data-driven audit reports and executive communications presenting findings and recommendations to senior leadership.
• Influence stakeholders to implement scalable, automated controls and eliminate recurring risks.
• Leverage data, automation, and technology to improve risk detection and audit efficiency.

About the team
Finance Operations Risk, Governance & Experience (FORGE)’s mission is to improve controllership across Finance Operations (FinOps) by identifying risks, protecting assets, designing to-be controls, testing existing controls, and as appropriate, assisting process owners with risk mitigation or remediation. In addition, FORGE collaborates with teams within and beyond FinOps on risk assessments, compliance, corporate social responsibility, regulatory, and governance matters. FORGE also serves as FinOps's program manager for the global external audit, provides controllership support for non-integrated subsidiaries, and is the contact for FinOps owned Internal Audit findings.

Basic qualifications

- 7+ years of compliance, audit or risk management experience
- Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications at an advanced level
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree or equivalent
- Experience at consulting firms or equivalent
- Experience working across teams and influencing teams that are not your own
- Experience in relevant finance roles, or experience in identifying, leading, and executing opportunities to improve, automate, standardize or simplify finance or business tools and processes

title: Onsite Medical Representative
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon’s mission to become Earth’s safest place to work! At Amazon, we’ve set the ambitious goal to become the benchmark of safety excellence across all industries in which we operate. The Amazon Workplace Health & Safety (WHS) team sets the strategic direction to provide resources, best practices, and safe environments to proactively manage the health and wellbeing of our workforce. To support these goals, Amazon is seeking an experienced and dynamic Onsite Medical Representative (OMR) to join our team. In this position, you will work closely with the WHS Site Manager, WHS Specialist, and occasionally the Injury Prevention Specialist (IPS). This includes attending weekly associate safety committee meetings, greeting all new hires for the site or through daily one-on-one interaction. Additionally, the OMR will participate in weekly case management review meetings as necessary. As an OMR, you will independently assess and administer first aid as well as offer guidance to Amazon Associates (AAs) on both occupational and non-occupational injuries or illnesses. You should be passionate about learning and advocating health and wellness principles to consistently support AAs on a daily basis. You will refer care to outside medical providers as needed, and learn about OSHA regulations, risk, and analysis. The OMR will function as a part of the larger team onsite, assisting with all first aid needs and support safety operations as needed.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
- Provide first aid support and make referrals to outside medical providers as necessary.
- Minimize the AA risk of injury through awareness, education, and proactive engagement.
- Maintain all records of care provided to AAs.
- Coordinate and maintain the workers’ compensation and return to work programs for AAs with work-related injuries.
- Provide daily activity logs and end of shift reports.
- Engage with AAs and leadership on operations floor to provide coaching regarding observed at-risk work habits.
- Maintain a clean working environment and ensure appropriate medical supply inventory is maintained.
- Participate in training and certification to facilitate first aid, CPR and AED certifications classes.
- Maintain all first aid, CPR, AED credentials.
- Work flexible shifts which could include days, nights, holidays, and/or weekends.
- Assist with random saliva drug testing protocols.
- Maintain effective care delivery in emergencies and assist emergency response at the site.

Additional Job Elements include:
- Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
- Work in an environment where the noise level varies
- Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
- Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)

For those that do not have an adult First Aid, CPR, AED certification from the American Heart Association or American Red Cross, must obtain within 3 weeks of start date.

- Proficient in Microsoft Office

title: Sr. Software Development Engineer, Quick Core Experience
descriptionHtml:
Our team — Quick Core Experience — owns the platform layer behind Amazon Quick, an agentic, AI-powered digital workspace. We deliver the critical infrastructure every feature depends on: asset metadata services (indexing, search, list, favorites), real-time customization, the core design system, and enterprise governance adherence across web, mobile, and desktop experiences in Quick.

Quick is where generative AI meets the enterprise workplace. Chat, custom agents, research, BI, workflow automation — all unified, fast, discoverable, and governed at scale. The platform we build is what makes that possible.

We're looking for a full-stack engineer energized by hard problems on both sides of the stack. You design and operate large-scale distributed systems, and you love crafting scalable front-end experiences. You'll own real problems: high-throughput indexing pipelines that unify writes across dozens of producer teams, real-time customization services scaling across regions and tenants, and the search and discovery experiences that make the platform feel effortless.

You bring a strong sense of ownership, a high bar for code quality, and genuine passion for design and architecture. You don't just know how to solve problems — you build solutions to address them. You challenge yourself and others to constantly find better solutions. You partner with product managers, UX designers, and fellow engineers to turn ambiguous customer needs into shipped, polished features.

This role offers wide scope, real ownership, and the chance to shape Enterprise governance layers we add in Quick, that every team in the product depends on.

Key job responsibilities
* Lead the design and implementation of distributed systems, providing system-wide architectural guidance
* Build Agents to ease on-boarding and evaluation of Enterprise governance across Quick features and Quick accounts.
* Balance speed of execution with architectural requirements, identifying one-way door decisions that require the right long-term solution
* Drive adoption of engineering best practices and operational excellence across the team
* Solve complex technical problems with multiple risks and roadblocks, bringing clarity through simple, well-designed solutions
* Mentor and coach multiple engineers, helping develop the next generation of technical talent
Effectively communicate technical designs to both technical and non-technical audiences

About the team
Amazon Quick is an enterprise AI platform that serves as an agentic, AI-powered digital workspace — integrating with customer data to provide contextual AI assistance including natural language chat, custom AI agents, research tools, business intelligence, workflow automation, and multi-agent automation. The Core Experience team owns critical platform capabilities including asset metadata services (search, favorites, recents, and lists), the core design system, brand and experience customization, and key experiences that enable feature discoverability across the platform.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience

title: Software Dev Engineer II, Amazon Detail Page
descriptionHtml:
The Detail Page is where Amazon customers decide what to buy. Every day, hundreds of millions of shoppers land on a product page to discover, evaluate and compare products and offers on mobile, desktop and app, and this surface drives the majority of purchase decisions on Amazon. The Detail Page team builds that experience, along with the platform that lets hundreds of partner teams across Amazon ship features to the page safely and quickly. As an SDE II, you will own the design and delivery of significant features and services on one of Amazon's highest-traffic pages, where every millisecond of latency and every point of availability matters to customers. You will work on real distributed-systems problems at a scale few places can offer, see your code reach customers worldwide within days, and help shape the technical direction of a page that nearly every Amazon shopper sees. If you love building for customers at massive scale and want your work to matter on day one, we would love to hear from you.

title: Sr. Solutions Architect, Software and Technology
locations: East Palo Alto, CA, United States
descriptionHtml:
Join the AWS Solutions Architecture team as a Sr Solutions Architect for Software and Technology customers. Our customers are born in the cloud and are leading the industry in AI-Native transformation. You will define and prove technical direction by combining architectural reasoning and strategic advisory with hands-on validation in customer environments. You will build working prototypes, proof-of-concepts, and AI-driven solutions that accelerate customer decisions and remove the gap between architectural recommendation and validated proof.  You operate where the path forward is undefined and must be defined by you. Your customers have business objectives but may not have defined technology strategy or solution design. You create and adapt approaches for situations where established patterns are insufficient, applying contextual judgment about your customers' operational constraints, regulatory environment, and competitive dynamics.  You will be the primary technical partner for your customers. You lead with Agentic AI and AI-assisted development to solve customer problems, and you steer customers away from where hype outpaces practical value for their operational context. You maintain technical currency so customers receive guidance based on current capability, not outdated expertise. You build deep relationships with customers’ senior technical leaders to enable them to be cloud advocates.  You are technically self-sufficient, yet you know when to seek help: you are capable of using AI tools and delivering directly in customer sandbox environments. You drive the architectural decisions that downstream teams (customer engineering, ProServe, partners) build against, and you own the consequences with the customer when those decisions need revisiting.    

Key job responsibilities  

Technical Proof & Validation  
Build working prototypes in customer non-production sandbox environments using AI-augmented development tools (Kiro, Claude Code, Bedrock) to validate architectural recommendations and accelerate customer adoption  
• Implement directly to unblock customer decisions: build PoCs for agentic AI and other use cases proving architectural approaches that conversations alone cannot validate  
• Deploy infrastructure using IaC (CDK, Terraform) in customer sandboxes, demonstrating scalability and security patterns  
• Apply GenAI and agentic systems (multi-agent orchestration, RAG pipelines, foundation model integration) where they solve customer problems.   

Architectural Reasoning & Decision Ownership
 • Frame and resolve technical trade-offs involving multiple competing concerns (security vs. cost vs. operational burden vs. time-to-market vs. industry compliance), bringing a clear recommendation with alternatives articulated  
• Make cross-cutting architectural decisions that ensure coherence across systems, teams, and workstreams; flag decisions that are difficult to reverse before the customer commits  
• Diagnose non-obvious architectural issues including resilience gaps, failover weaknesses, scaling bottlenecks, and security vulnerabilities.
• Own the architectural decisions that downstream teams build against and own the consequences with the customer when those decisions need revisiting  
• Stay engaged through implementation to ensure the architecture holds against the reality of the customer's environment; know when accumulated context warrants a revised approach   

Strategic Advisory & Customer Influence  • Own the end-to-end technical strategy for customers, maintaining the current view of their technical landscape, industry context, and competitive dynamics  
• Partner with the sales team, formulate and execute a sales strategy to exceed revenue objectives through the adoption of AWS  
• Influence senior leaders' technology direction by connecting short-term AI and cloud decisions to long-term business outcomes; earn trust through guidance that consistently delivers the outcomes they expected  
• Challenge customer direction when evidence indicates a better path; customers avoid costly rework because you identify risk early and bring considered alternatives  
• Shape AI and cloud strategy for major operators — translating complex capabilities into business-outcome narratives.  

Revenue & Opportunity Acceleration  
• Accelerate customer adoption by removing ambiguity through validated proof points, measurably reducing the time from architectural recommendation to customer commitment  
• Identify new opportunities discovered during customer engagements  
• Increase service adoption through tangible multi-service integration demos  • Conduct one-to-few and one-to-many training sessions to transfer knowledge to customers considering or already using AWS  
• Identify implementation pathways that benefit from ProServe expertise, creating natural expansion opportunities through demonstrated value   Customer

Relationship & Communication Skills  
• Experience presenting to both large and small audiences (Executives, IT Management, and developers)  
• Experience communicating across internal and external organizations  
• Ability to moderate tone and technical depth based on audience  
• Ability to pick up on non-verbal communication and "un-said" drivers   

Thought Leadership & Product Influence  • Author or otherwise contribute to AWS customer-facing publications such as blogs and whitepapers.  
• Translate customer feedback into clear, actionable requirements that service teams act on; synthesize evidence across multiple engagements rather than relaying feedback from one. Accelerate development and reduce ambiguity by creating code for a proposed feature to illustrate your requirement that can be reviewed and evaluated for inclusion into product codebase.


About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

- 8+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
- 3+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent
- Demonstrated ability to build and validate solutions hands-on (code, infrastructure as code, tested deployments), not only advise
- Experience communicating across technical and non-technical audiences, including executive level stakeholders or clients including building deep relationships with senior technical leaders.

title: EHS Specialist
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon’s mission to become Earth’s safest place to work! At Amazon, we’ve set the ambitious goal to become the benchmark of safety excellence across all industries in which we operate. As a Workplace Health & Safety Specialist (WHSS), you'll be at the forefront of transforming workplace safety culture at one of the world's most innovative companies. Your expertise and dedication will directly protect employees, ensuring they return home safely to their families every day. You'll facilitate new approaches to safety, combining technology with human-centered solutions to create an environment where safety and productivity thrive together. This isn't just about maintaining safety standards – it's about revolutionizing how we think about and implement workplace safety, making a lasting impact on our people and operations. As your building's designated safety champion, you'll have the unique opportunity to build relationships, influence positive change, and help write the next chapter in Amazon's commitment to becoming Earth's Safest Place to Work.

Core Impact Areas:
Safety Program Excellence & Implementation - Drive comprehensive safety programs through data-driven strategies. Lead daily safety audits, incident investigations, and risk assessments while implementing innovative solutions to prevent injuries. Deliver engaging safety training that resonates with associates and promotes a proactive safety culture. Champion continuous improvement initiatives that enhance workplace safety while maintaining operational efficiency.

Associate Advocacy & Cultural Leadership - Serve as a trusted safety advisor and advocate for associate wellbeing, building strong partnerships across all levels of the organization. Foster a culture where safety is everyone's priority through effective communication, coaching, and positive reinforcement. Develop strong relationships with frontline associates and leadership to drive behavioral changes and ensure safety best practices become natural habits. Transform safety data into compelling narratives that influence positive change and drive engagement in safety initiatives.

Additional Job Elements include:
- Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
- Work in an environment where the noise level varies
- Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
- Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)
- Maintain effective care delivery in emergencies and assist emergency response at the site

Must be available to work flexible shifts including days, nights and/or weekends.

For those that do not have an adult First Aid, CPR, AED certification from the American Heart Association or American Red Cross, must obtain within 3 weeks of start date.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent
- A minimum of 1 year in an Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) related field OR; A Bachelor’s degree in EHS-relevant background OR; 6 months experience performing in a safety-related role within Amazon
- Knowledge of OSHA regulations specifically 29 CFR 1910
- Experience using Microsoft Word and Excel in a professional capacity
- Experience maintaining confidentiality in matter involving security and/or personnel issues in the workplace

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree or higher, preferably in a safety related field
- Strong communication, teamwork, analysis, judgment, and customer focus skills
- Experience leading and managing a team, ability to analyze accident data, new processes, and machinery for potential safety concerns, and conduct job hazard and job safety analyses
- Experience in emergency response and currently holds First Aid and CPR certificates
- Experience in workers compensation case management

title: Senior Program Manager, Technology Supply Chain Organization Program Enablement
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Technology Supply Chain is scaling, and the hardest part of that growth is getting an entire organization to change how it works. We are looking for a Senior Program Manager to own the change management discipline across Technology Supply Chain and make new ways of working the way the organization operates by default. You will design adoption approaches grounded in established change management methodologies such as Prosci/ADKAR and Kotter's 8-Step, build the communications that move behavior, and decide what to do when adoption stalls. You are comfortable in ambiguity and able to influence leaders and teams you do not manage. Success in this role is adoption: the standards you introduce become how teams actually operate. You will start with changes already in flight and build a discipline that applies to whichever change the organization adopts next. Over time the role grows. You will deepen expertise in change management and AI-assisted operations, and your scope will widen from driving individual changes to shaping how the whole organization absorbs change.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the change management discipline across Technology Supply Chain, partnering with leadership to shape the change strategy and owning its execution. Apply stakeholder analysis, readiness assessment, and resistance management to determine goals and design adoption approaches in ambiguous situations where the problem is not yet fully defined.
- Build adoption frameworks, playbooks, communications, and enablement materials that take each new way of working from something that exists to something the organization does by default, drawing on established change frameworks such as Prosci/ADKAR and Kotter.
- Partner with reporting, governance, and tooling teams to drive adoption of shared ways of working across all customer groups, influencing leaders and teams you do not directly manage to align on how the organization operates.
- Establish adoption measurement and reporting so progress and risk are visible before a change fails, own the judgment on how to respond when adoption stalls, and build the documentation and processes that make new ways of working durable beyond any single individual.

A day in the life
You spend your day building the organization's capacity to change. You partner with leadership to shape the change strategy, then own how it comes to life: assessing why change stalls and fixing it at the root rather than rescuing one rollout at a time. You coach leaders to be effective sponsors of the changes they own, because that is where change succeeds or fails. You sequence a portfolio of concurrent changes so the organization adopts them without saturating, and build the methodology and standards that let every team run change well. You work across every Technology Supply Chain group and influence leaders you do not manage. Your real product is not any single rollout. It is an organization that can change without breaking.

About the team
Technology Supply Chain delivers the full lifecycle of technology fulfillment for Amazon, sourcing, delivering, and deploying the hardware, infrastructure, and equipment that Amazon's Worldwide Stores operations and AWS data centers run on. As Amazon's technology footprint grows, Technology Supply Chain is the organization that keeps the supply chain behind it ahead of demand. Our team is the central program management and business operations function within Technology Supply Chain. Our principle is "enable rather than simply do": we take recurring programmatic work off every team through shared standards, processes, and tooling so each team can focus on the specialized work only it can do, and we build our own automation to do it.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of program or project management experience
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of driving process improvements experience

title: Onsite Medical Representative
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon’s mission to become Earth’s safest place to work! At Amazon, we’ve set the ambitious goal to become the benchmark of safety excellence across all industries in which we operate. The Amazon Workplace Health & Safety (WHS) team sets the strategic direction to provide resources, best practices, and safe environments to proactively manage the health and wellbeing of our workforce. To support these goals, Amazon is seeking an experienced and dynamic Onsite Medical Representative (OMR) to join our team. In this position, you will work closely with the WHS Site Manager, WHS Specialist, and occasionally the Injury Prevention Specialist (IPS). This includes attending weekly associate safety committee meetings, greeting all new hires for the site or through daily one-on-one interaction. Additionally, the OMR will participate in weekly case management review meetings as necessary. As an OMR, you will independently assess and administer first aid as well as offer guidance to Amazon Associates (AAs) on both occupational and non-occupational injuries or illnesses. You should be passionate about learning and advocating health and wellness principles to consistently support AAs on a daily basis. You will refer care to outside medical providers as needed, and learn about OSHA regulations, risk, and analysis. The OMR will function as a part of the larger team onsite, assisting with all first aid needs and support safety operations as needed.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
- Provide first aid support and make referrals to outside medical providers as necessary.
- Minimize the AA risk of injury through awareness, education, and proactive engagement.
- Maintain all records of care provided to AAs.
- Coordinate and maintain the workers’ compensation and return to work programs for AAs with work-related injuries.
- Provide daily activity logs and end of shift reports.
- Engage with AAs and leadership on operations floor to provide coaching regarding observed at-risk work habits.
- Maintain a clean working environment and ensure appropriate medical supply inventory is maintained.
- Participate in training and certification to facilitate first aid, CPR and AED certifications classes.
- Maintain all first aid, CPR, AED credentials.
- Work flexible shifts which could include days, nights, holidays, and/or weekends.
- Assist with random saliva drug testing protocols.
- Maintain effective care delivery in emergencies and assist emergency response at the site.

Additional Job Elements include:
- Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
- Work in an environment where the noise level varies
- Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
- Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)

For those that do not have an adult First Aid, CPR, AED certification from the American Heart Association or American Red Cross, must obtain within 3 weeks of start date.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent diploma
- Current valid Basic Life Support (BLS) certification by an approved emergency cardiac care (ECC) provider; AND must have one of the following:
- Current valid Emergency Medical Technician (EMT) OR Paramedic Certification from the Department of Health OR the National Registry of Emergency Medical Technicians (NREMT); OR
- Current active Athletic Trainer Certification, by either the Board of Certification (BOC) or equivalent State Certification.

Preferred qualifications

- Certified to teach first aid, CPR, and AED training from American Heart Association or American Red Cross
- Proficient in Microsoft Office
- Experience with an industrial wellness program
- Experience managing musculoskeletal disorders, ergonomics, and coaching on body mechanics
- Demonstrated work experience with OSHA regulations and Workers Compensation
- Proficient in digital recordkeeping
- In the last year, six months job experience in the Military as a Combat Medic (U.S. Army), Field Medic (U.S. Army), Healthcare Specialist (U.S. Army), Hospital Corpsman (U.S. Navy), or Aerospace Medical Service Technician (U.S. Air Force)

title: Sr. Lab Buildout and Operations Manager, Integration & Test, Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a hands-on Lab Buildout and Operations Manager to own the deployment, readiness, and sustained operation of RF, networking, and system-integration lab environments. This role will manage lab infrastructure buildouts across Austin and Seattle ensuring labs are built, instrumented, networked, documented, and operationally ready for engineering use.

The ideal candidate has a strong mix of lab operations, RF test infrastructure, networking, procurement, vendor management, and hands-on systems experience. This person should be comfortable working across engineering, facilities, procurement, vendors, and site leadership to turn unclear lab requirements into executable build plans.

Key Responsibilities
Lab Buildout and Site Readiness
- Own end-to-end lab buildout execution for RF and system-integration environments across Austin and Seattle.
- Coordinate deployment of racks, benches, chambers, RF infrastructure, test equipment, control stations, cabling, power, grounding, cooling, and secure lab network access.
- Drive readiness for RF test areas, integrated system test beds, hardware-in-the-loop environments, and production-representative lab setups.
- Partner with Facilities, Networking, Security, Hardware, RF, Software, and Test teams to ensure lab spaces are usable, safe, scalable, and -operationally reliable.
- Maintain lab bring-up schedules, punch lists, dependency trackers, and operational readiness checklists.

RF, Network, and Test Infrastructure Operations
- Support RF lab environments including chambers, antennas, attenuators, channel emulators, spectrum analyzers, signal generators, RF cabling, timing sources, and related instrumentation.
- Support lab network design and operations, including VLANs, routing, switching, firewall access, remote access, control-plane connectivity, and test-device isolation.
- Ensure lab infrastructure can support integration, regression, throughput, latency, mobility, handover, timing, and multi-device validation.
- Drive uptime and reliability improvements for lab systems, including monitoring, alerting, access control, inventory tracking, and failure-response processes.
- Standardize lab configurations, diagrams, runbooks, rack elevations, port maps, cable labels, and operational procedures across sites.

Procurement, Vendor, and Budget Execution
- Own procurement tracking for lab equipment, RF components, network gear, racks, cables, tools, fixtures, chambers, and facility-dependent infrastructure.
- Translate technical needs into BOMs, purchase requests, vendor quotes, lead-time tracking, and delivery schedules.
- Manage vendor coordination for chamber deployment, electrical work, cooling, RF infrastructure, installation labor, and equipment calibration.
- Track CapEx/Opex needs, delivery risks, dependencies, and site constraints; escalate issues early with clear options and impact.
- Maintain asset inventory and lifecycle tracking for lab hardware, instruments, network devices, and shared test infrastructure.

Cross-Site Execution and Travel
- Travel regularly to Austin and Seattle to support lab buildouts, readiness reviews, vendor work, infrastructure deployment, and operational handoffs. 20-30% travel
- Act as the on-site execution lead during critical lab moves, new building bring-up, chamber installations, RF infrastructure deployment, and major test-bed readiness efforts.
- Build repeatable lab standards so each site can be deployed and operated consistently while still supporting local engineering needs.

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Basic qualifications

- Experience with the project management of technical projects
- 7+ years of experience in lab operations, hardware development management, systems development, RF test, network operations, or infrastructure deployment.
- Experience building, operating, or maintaining engineering labs, RF labs, network labs, telecom labs, or hardware-in-the-loop environments.
- Working knowledge of RF test environments, including chambers, antennas, RF cabling, attenuators, spectrum analyzers, signal generators, or channel emulators.
- Working knowledge of networking fundamentals, including switching, routing, VLANs, IP addressing, firewall rules, remote access, and lab network segmentation.
- Experience managing procurement, BOMs, vendors, delivery schedules, asset tracking, and equipment lifecycle.
- Ability to create and maintain lab documentation, rack diagrams, port maps, build plans, readiness checklists, and operational runbooks.
- Ability to travel regularly between Austin and Seattle.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with satellite communications, wireless systems, telecom, RF validation, mobility, maritime, or customer-terminal validation.
- Experience supporting anechoic chambers, RF shielded rooms, integrated RF test beds, or large-scale system-integration environments.
- Experience with Linux and Windows lab hosts, test controllers, remote access systems, automation frameworks, and telemetry/logging tools.
- Experience with lab monitoring, dashboards, alerting, inventory systems, and uptime reporting.
- Experience with network gear from vendors such as Cisco, Arista, MikroTik, Juniper, or similar.
- Experience coordinating facilities work such as electrical, grounding, cooling, rack power, structured cabling, and space planning.
- Strong ability to operate in ambiguous environments where lab requirements, schedules, and dependencies are still being defined.

descriptionHtml:
We are hiring a Program Manager to drive the expansion and integration of computer-vision-powered automation use cases across North America and embed them into our sustainment model. This role requires strong technical aptitude and data fluency. You will work hands-on with perception and detection metrics, sensor and image data, operational KPIs, and the ML pipeline lifecycle — from model training and evaluation through deployment and monitoring. You will partner daily with computer vision and ML scientists, engineers, RME teams, site operations, and external vendors to scope use cases, execute pilots, define and analyze KPIs, and drive data-informed decisions that scale reliably across a decentralized network.

Key job responsibilities
Identify and evaluate new computer vision automation use cases for North America (e.g., drones, robotics, autonomous vehicles, inspection systems); develop feasibility assessments and business cases for each opportunity.
• Execute pilots end-to-end: define success metrics, coordinate cross-functional partners across science, engineering, RME, operations, and vendors, track milestones, and report outcomes with clear recommendations.
• Conduct deep-dive analysis on model and detection performance (e.g., precision, recall, F1 score, detection accuracy); analyze flight telemetry, reliability logs, and operational data to identify trends and improvement opportunities.
• Assess data and annotation pipeline quality feeding perception models; partner with science teams to evaluate labeling accuracy, dataset coverage, and annotation throughput.
• Evaluate edge inference constraints including latency, on-device compute capacity, and connectivity limitations; factor deployment realities into use-case scoping and architecture decisions.
• Support post-deployment model monitoring activities including tracking model drift indicators, retraining triggers, and A/B testing frameworks to ensure sustained system performance.
• Build KPI dashboards and visualizations; translate telemetry and analytics into actionable insights for technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Coordinate with regulatory and safety stakeholders to ensure automation deployments comply with applicable standards (e.g., FAA regulations for UAV systems, robotics safety standards).
• Translate between technical teams and operational stakeholders; document standards, RACIs, and handoff procedures so use cases remain sustainable post-launch.
• Track risks, dependencies, and timelines across concurrent workstreams in a decentralized network environment.


A day in the life
• You Dive Deep into perception data and system telemetry to surface insights that others miss — then translate those insights into clear, actionable recommendations.
• You demonstrate Bias for Action by driving pilots forward through ambiguity, coordinating across teams without waiting for perfect information.
• You Earn Trust with cross-functional partners by communicating transparently, documenting decisions clearly, and delivering on commitments.

- Experience in MS Access and SQL

title: Sr Package Engineer, JCFS CPEX
descriptionHtml:
Amazonでは、環境に配慮した新たな梱包資材の開発・導入を進めています。これを担うオペレーション技術統括本部（JCFS: Japan Customer Fulfillment Solutions）のCustomer Packaging Experience（CPEX）部門では、事業の成長と、お客様の購入体験の保護、そして環境・サステナビリティへの貢献を同時に実現する梱包イノベーション（新しい梱包資材の設計・開発）を推進しており、体制強化のため新たなメンバーを募集しています。

近年、当日配送のGrocery（食品・日用品）ECサービスが急速に拡大しており、新しい業態特有の商品・配送形態に対応した梱包資材の開発リソースの確保が急務となっています。本ポジションは、こうしたGrocery配送サービスの拡大に伴う資材開発リソースを確保・強化するために新設された枠であり、拡大するビジネスを支える新たなメンバーを募集しています。

シニア パッケージエンジニアは、「配送・資材コストの低減」「お客様の購入体験」「環境配慮」の3つを両立できる新しい梱包資材の設計・開発や、既存資材のデザイン見直しを担当します。資材メーカー（サプライヤー）との折衝・共同開発や、実際に梱包作業を行う物流現場のメンバーとの対話を通じて、導入までを一貫してマネジメントします。Amazonはさまざまな形状・サイズの商品を扱い、多くの物流拠点で梱包資材を使用しているため、求められる要件は日々変化します。既成概念にとらわれず、新しいアイデアを形にするプロジェクトを推進していただきます。Amazonで使用する梱包資材の設計・開発・導入に責任を持ち、複数の大規模プロジェクトを主体的に管理します。

Amazon is committed to reaching net-zero carbon by 2040, and Amazon Japan is looking for a technically strong Senior Package Engineer to help achieve this goal within the JCFS (Japan Customer Fulfillment Solutions) team in Tokyo. In the Customer Packaging Experience (CPEX) organization, you will design, develop, and roll out packaging materials that balance business needs, customer experience, and sustainability, working closely with internal teams and external packaging suppliers.
With the rapid growth of same-day grocery (food and daily-goods) e-commerce services, securing additional packaging-development resources for the unique products and delivery formats these new businesses require has become a priority. This position has been newly created to secure and strengthen packaging-development capacity as these grocery delivery services expand.

As a Senior Package Engineer, you will design new packaging or improve existing designs based on business requirements, customer feedback, and our sustainability goals, in cooperation with packaging suppliers, your manager, and team members. You will lead material-strength testing, prototype verification, hands-on efficiency studies at fulfillment sites, and validation of packaging behavior on automated handling and conveyor lines, and you will negotiate with and guide suppliers for joint development.
Not everything on a project goes as planned, so you are expected to solve unexpected problems and ask for support from the team and leaders whenever needed. Your results will be shared with Japan and global leadership through regular business reviews. Because packaging has a wide influence on Amazon’s e-commerce business, close collaboration with internal teams (fulfillment operations, supply chain, finance, delivery, engineering) and external partners (vendors, marketplace sellers, and packaging suppliers) is essential.

The CPEX mission is to delight customers by advancing packaging innovations that reduce waste, cost, and carbon emissions. Our programs range from simplified shipping (sending orders in the product’s own box, without extra Amazon packaging) and lighter paper-based packaging, to right-sizing packaging to customer order dimensions and adopting more sustainable materials. The Package Design & Development team designs new packaging to balance business, sustainability, and customer experience, and deploys it in the field.


Key job responsibilities
• Amazonで使用する梱包資材の設計・開発・導入に責任を持ち、マネージャーが描く方針に沿って、優先度の高い梱包施策の開発・導入をリードします。
• 資材メーカーとの交渉・技術指導・共同開発、試作品の検証、資材の強度評価、梱包作業の効率（工数）検証、物流現場の搬送・自動化ライン上での不具合検証と解決を行います。
• データ分析担当や他部門と連携し、CO2やプラスチックの削減につながる機会を見つけ、新技術のアイデアを提案します。中長期を見据えた新規資材の先行開発も担います。
• 複数の大規模プロジェクトを主体的に管理し、若手メンバーの指導・育成を行います。成果は定量的に評価し、社内外の関係者と共有・合意を図り、結果に責任を持ちます。

• Own the design, development, and rollout of packaging used across Amazon, leading high-priority packaging initiatives aligned with your manager’s direction.
• Negotiate with and guide suppliers for joint development; verify prototypes; evaluate material strength; run packing-efficiency studies; and validate and resolve issues on automated handling and conveyor lines.
• Directly manage multiple large-scale projects and coach junior members, and report key results clearly and on time to internal and external stakeholders.
• Report to the CPEX Manager within JCFS, while serving as a point of contact for packaging and technology teams in Japan and across global regions.

A day in the life
シニア パッケージエンジニアは、デスクワーク（データ分析、設計仕様の作成、資材メーカーとの折衝、プログラム資料の作成）と現場（物流拠点での試作品検証、資材の強度試験、ライン検証）の両方に時間を使い、コスト・お客様の購入体験・サステナビリティを両立する梱包イノベーションを推進します。
A Senior Package Engineer divides time between desk work (data analysis, design specifications, supplier negotiation, and program documents) and the field (visiting fulfillment sites for prototype verification, material-strength testing, and line validation), driving packaging innovation that balances cost, customer experience, and sustainability.

- 5+ years of industrial engineer, operations engineer, manufacturing engineer, or project engineer in a manufacturing environment experience
- Bachelor's degree
- Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Visio, and MS Project) at an advanced level
- Experience leading cross-functional teams across engineering, operations, and field execution through launch readiness and go-live phases

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of AutoCAD, VBA, and SQL at the intermediate level

- Experience with Six Sigma, lean manufacturing
