title: Partner Sales Manager, Energy & Utilities
descriptionHtml:
The Principal Partner Sales Manager (PSM) is a senior, quota-carrying individual contributor who drives partner-delivered revenue across Energy and Utilities accounts in EMEA. The role carries an individual revenue number. It calls for pipeline generation, disciplined deal execution, and strategic executive relationships with Customers and Partners that turn into closed revenue. To succeed, you'll own the partner sales strategy across a broad set of accounts and manage a portfolio of deals in flight. You'll also build trusted advisor status with partners and customers through consistent engagement, co-sell motions, and a steady focus on customer outcomes. The role also owns ongoing reporting and the continued reshaping of how AWS engages in the partner selling motion.

Beyond your own deals, you'll define the partner coverage model for Energy and Utilities in EMEA. That means deciding where we cover accounts directly through the depth coverage model and where we scale through other parts of the partner organization. It also means setting the right interface points between them, so partner resources go where they drive the most value for Energy and Utilities customers.

The PSM works where industry technology, AWS Marketplace, cloud migrations, consulting and tech partners, and Generative AI meet. You'll find and advance high-value opportunities by working with customer stakeholders and account teams. That means speeding up pipeline velocity, growing partner-led deal flow, and delivering measurable revenue impact every quarter.

The ideal candidate is a proven senior seller who consistently meets goals and raises the bar for the account and partner teams around them. You lead through influence rather than authority, and you treat every challenge as a chance to sharpen execution. You use internal AI tools to boost productivity, bring in the right partners across AWS to drive outcomes, and set the standard for how partner selling is done.

This role sits on the global Energy and Utilities Partner Sales team and covers customers across EMEA.

Key job responsibilities
• Achieve revenue targets by driving partner-originated and partner-assisted opportunities with quota accountability, progressing deal stages, managing pipeline hygiene, and using partner funding programs to accelerate pipeline velocity.

• Execute co-sell motions with GSI/SI and ISV partners, including migration plays such as mainframe modernization, data center exits, and application rationalization.

• Cultivate strategic relationships that unlock new line-of-business personas, and drive net-new pipeline through account planning, business reviews, and scale campaigns with the One Partner Team.

• Shape Marketplace deals that address industry priorities, including regulatory compliance, data modernization, security, and digital transformation, while supporting PPA demand plans and driving customer adoption of the Marketplace.

• Build repeatable selling motions and plays that other PSMs and partner teams can adopt across geographies.

• Role model Amazon Leadership Principles, use AI tools to produce quality documents and forecasts, maintain CRM hygiene and forecast accuracy, and escalate blockers to maximize revenue realization.

• Act as a strategic advisor to Energy and Utilities leadership in EMEA, using data and field signal to decide where to invest partner resources, where to simplify, and where to place bigger bets.

• Establish the interface points with Partner Development Managers, Partner Development Specialists, and Partner Solutions Architects so partner resources are aligned to the accounts and workloads where they drive the most value for customers.

• Define partner coverage model for Energy and Utilities in EMEA, deciding where we cover accounts through the depth coverage model and where we scale through other parts of the partner organization, using data.

A day in the life
You manage your own pipeline cadence. That means inspecting your deals, moving your most strategic opportunities forward with GSI/SI and ISV partners, and joining executive conversations with partners and customers where senior engagement moves a deal forward. You spend your time working alongside account teams across EMEA, unblocking deals, and lining up PDMs, PDSs, and PSAs behind partner-led opportunities. You also keep refining the coverage model that decides where partner resources focus their effort next.

About the team
The AWS Industries (AWSI) Partner Sales organization is a global, collaborative team of professionals united by a single objective: delivering results for customers through partner motions that reshape industries around the world. We are a customer-facing team that engages with customers to understand and solve their hardest problems, and we work shoulder to shoulder with partner executives to build the future solutions our customers will rely on. Those solutions are durable, and they take on the most demanding business challenges on earth. The Energy and Utilities team brings that focus to customers working through the energy transition, grid modernization, and the shift to data-driven operations. We win as one team, sharing what works and raising the bar for how partner selling is done globally.

Basic qualifications

- Experience working and communicating with multiple stakeholders and cross-functional teams including direct and channel marketing, solution architect teams, product management and account management teams
- Experience in sales or business development in the software/technology industry
- Experience working with Systems Integrators and Consulting Companies to achieve sales

Preferred qualifications

- Speak, write, and read fluently in Spanish
- Experience working in a matrixed environment, influencing strategy, and achieving goals by working across the organization

descriptionHtml:
Transform network infrastructure by joining our dynamic team! You'll be at the forefront of developing innovative solutions that drive network stability and scalability, using your technical expertise to create automated systems that power global technological advancement.

Infra Delivery Install Technicians will collaborate with cross-functional teams, troubleshoot complex technical scenarios, and implement strategic solutions that keep our network running seamlessly. AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

NOTE: Relocation assistance will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.

Key job responsibilities

• Following well established hardware installation procedures and break-fix activities
• Safely using material handling tools and equipment
• Traveling within and outside of the regional work area is required.

Physical Requirements:
• All physical requirements are expected with reasonable accommodations:
• Regularly lift and/or move up to 40 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 41+ pounds
• Ability to work in an environment that operates 24/7 with an ability to participate in primary responder rotation and provide after-hours support as needed
• Working in cramped and/or elevated and/or noisy environments
• Bending, lifting, stretching, reaching, standing and walking for up to 8+ hours a day
• Ascending and descending ladders, stairs, and gangways safely and without limitation
This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:
• Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
• Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
• Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of data center, critical environment, computer hardware repair, infrastructure cabling, network deployment, or data center operations experience, or experience in similar technical roles
- 2+ years of network cabling, fiber optics, and test equipment including VFL, power meter, and OTDR experience
- Experience with network hardware: copper and optical fiber cabling, switches, routers

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in an IT-related field (e.g., Computer Science, Network Engineering), or experience in professional or military IT-related roles
- certification in a relevant field (CCENT - Cisco Certified Entry Networking Technician, Network+, or CCNA - Cisco Certified Network Associate)
- Experience in a data center or other critical environment
- Work flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays
- Experience conducting behavioral interviews and hiring

title: Customer Service Associate- Delhi India
descriptionHtml:
Work from Office with Amazon Customer Service!

Role:  Customer Service Associate
Job Type: Contractual 
Location: Work from Office in Delhi/Noida

Our mission at Amazon is to be Earth’s most customer-centric company, and our award-winning Customer Service team is a key part of achieving that goal. Doing our best for our customers is where we get our energy, and that’s why you’ll find we approach things differently here. You won’t be asked to read from a script or learn dialogue by heart. Instead we’ll provide you with the training you need to problem solve for our customers. You’ll bring your unique personality to every customer conversation and deliver the exceptional support experience our customers love.

What will you do as a Customer Service Associate?
As an Amazon Customer Service Associate, you have a very clear purpose: to prevent issues, solve queries, and delight our customers. You’ll be the first point of contact for our customers by answering their requests through phone, chat and/or email – this includes everything from order and product questions to payment matters and website guidance. Our Customer Service Associates use a variety of tools to navigate, research, and review solutions, and communicate effectively with customers

What strengths will you bring?

  •     Hard-working, articulate, and detail-oriented
  •     Friendly and customer-focused in every situation
  •     Ability to learn quickly and embrace change
  •     Comfortable multi-tasking in a high-energy environment.

What benefits will you receive?
One of the great things about joining Amazon’s Customer Service team is that you don’t need past experience in customer service. You’ll receive training and be provided with a complete equipment package when you join. Additionally, we offer a number of benefits, including:
 
  • Medical insurance
  • Pension plan
  • Internet allowance
  • Lifestyle benefits and retail discounts through our Amazon Extras program
  • Expert training and ongoing opportunities to learn more and develop your skills

If this role sounds like it’s for you, then click on the link below to start the application process!
You’ll need to allow 3 hours to complete the full application, including assessments which will evaluate your suitability for the role. You will have the option to save your application during the process and return to it if necessary. We recommend using a laptop/desktop computer in order to get the best experience.

If successful, we will contact you about next steps!

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build.

Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.

Basic qualifications

What qualifications do we need from you?

  • Minimum age: 18 years old
  • Have the right to work in India
  • Strong communication skills in English (both written and oral fluency)
  • Experience working with a computer
  • The availability to work varying shifts from Monday to Sunday within the operating hours
  • Willingness and ability to work in rotating shifts (i.e. early, late, overnight, weekend, and overtime as required)

title: Atendimento ao Cliente com foco em PCD- Estado do São Paulo
descriptionHtml:
Atendimento ao Cliente (vaga afirmativa com foco em Pessoas com Deficiência - PCD) - Estado do São Paulo, Brasil

Trabalhe em casa com o Atendimento ao Cliente da Amazon!
Cargo: Associado de  Atendimento ao Cliente em Português.
Tipo de posição: Permanente em tempo integral.
Localização: Trabalho em casa no Estado De São Paulo.
Salário: R$ 1600

A  Amazon tem a missão de ser a melhor empresa de atendimento ao cliente do mundo, portanto, nossos representantes de atendimento ao cliente são essenciais para atingir esse objetivo. Para o nosso Centro de Atendimento no estado de São Paulo, buscamos pessoas para o cargo de Representante de Atendimento ao Cliente na modalidade Trabalho Virtual que se identifiquem com os mais altos padrões de qualidade da Amazon, e tenham interesse em fazer carreira em uma empresa pioneira , dispostos a inventar e simplificar com base em nossos clientes.

O que você fará como Associado de Atendimento ao Cliente?
Nossos representantes devem ser detalhistas, habilidosos na expressão oral e escrita e dispostos a nos ajudar a superar as expectativas de nossos clientes; oferecendo um serviço profissional, pontual e de qualidade.
Como Associado de Atendimento ao Cliente da Amazon, você tem um propósito muito claro: evitar problemas, resolver dúvidas e encantar nossos clientes. Você será o primeiro ponto de contato para nossos clientes no mercado brasileiro, respondendo às suas solicitações por telefone, chat e/ou e-mail. Isso inclui tudo, desde perguntas sobre pedidos e produtos até problemas de pagamento e orientação do site.
Nossos Associados de Atendimento ao Cliente usam uma variedade de ferramentas para navegar, pesquisar, revisar soluções e se comunicar de forma eficaz com os clientes.

Quais são os horários?
Esta função exige horários de trabalho que variam para coincidir com o momento em que os clientes mais precisam de nós. Você trabalhará em turnos diurnos e sua semana de trabalho é de no mínimo 36 horas. Para atender a demanda de nossos clientes, agendamos de acordo com uma variedade de padrões de turnos dentro do nosso horário de funcionamento das 06h às 24h de Segunda feira à Domingo. Você pode ser obrigado a trabalhar em feriados nacionais e será compensado de acordo com a lei. Você aprenderá mais sobre sua programação exata mais perto de sua data de início.

Quais benefícios você receberá?
Uma das melhores coisas de se juntar à equipe de atendimento ao cliente da Amazon é que você não precisa de nenhuma experiência anterior de atendimento ao cliente. Você receberá treinamento e um pacote completo de equipamentos será fornecido quando você se inscrever. Além disso, oferecemos uma série de benefícios, incluindo:

  • Seguro de vida e morte acidental  (Icatu)
  • Programa de Previdencia Complementar
  • Programa de Assistência ao Funcionário (EAP)
  • Vale Refeição / Vale Alimentação - $1016
  • Ajuda de custo de Internet - $120
  • Treinamento remunerado
Se você for selecionado para a vaga :
Você deve receber de uma a duas caixas que incluem o seguinte:
  • 1 Lenovo Case o CPU
  • 1 Mouse
  • 1 teclado
  • 1 monitor Lenovo
  • 1 Headset (audífonos)
  • 2 zuckye
Certifique-se de que o endereço fornecido é um endereço exato e completo de onde você reside de forma que possa receber o equipamento e garanta que não haja atrasos em seu recebimento. Adicione o número do apartamento(se houver).

Se parece que esta posição é para você, clique no link abaixo para iniciar o processo de inscrição!

* Você precisará de 1 a 2 horas para concluir a inscrição em sua totalidade, incluindo as avaliações que medirão sua adequação ao cargo. Recomendamos o uso de um laptop ou computador desktop para obter a melhor experiência. Você terá a opção de salvar sua inscrição entre cada etapa do processo de inscrição e retornar a ela, se necessário, mas recomendamos que você conclua o processo de uma vez só, sempre que possível.

* Se você passar em todos os testes, entraremos em contato com os próximos passos!
“Nossa cultura inclusiva capacita os Amazonians a oferecer os melhores resultados para nossos clientes. Não celebramos apenas a diversidade de nossa força de trabalho, celebramos as diversas formas como trabalhamos. Se você quiser solicitar uma acomodação para a entrevista ou o processo de integração, avise seu recrutador e ele o conectará à nossa Equipe de Acomodação.”
Se for selecionado, você será fornecido um computador, teclado, mouse, fone de ouvido e dois tokens de segurança ao endereço fornecido no processo de reclutamento. É de responsabilidade dos atendentes garantir uma conectividade à internet sem interrupções, e ter um ambiente ``semelhante a um escritório`` dentro de sua residência, para que possam oferecer o melhor desempenho em termos de produtividade e qualidade.  

A Amazon segue rigorosamente a Legislação Geral de Proteção dos Dados e informação pessoal que você fornece em sua candidatura, e a gerenciará e cumprirá às exigências legais correspondentes. De forma particular, não iremos compartilhar suas informações pessoais com terceiros sem seu consentimento prévio, a não ser por determinação legal. A Amazon conservará sua informação numa base de dados eletrônica armazenada pela Amazon.com nos Estados Unidos ou, outros escritórios da Amazon desde que, autorizado previamente por você. Para maiores informações sobre o armazenamento e processamento da sua informação pessoal na Amazon, por favor, acesse o seguinte endereço: http://www.amazon.jobs/.

Basic qualifications

Requisitos Obrigatórios:

  • Residir no Estado de São Paulo.
  • Você deve estar disponível para obter Internet de alta velocidade (download de 10 MGB / upload de 2 MBG ou superior).
  • Ter mais de 18 anos
  • Diploma do ensino médio completado.
  • Identidade nacional ou cartão de residência com situação migratória legal no País.
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em turnos variados de Segunda à Domingo
  • Você precisará de um espaço de trabalho tranquilo e livre de distrações (espaço de mesa dedicado com cadeira).

Importante: Ter Laudo pra confirmar o enquadramento como PCD.

Quais pontos fortes você trará para a empresa?

Habilidades técnicas:
· Capacidade de usar um computador desktop.
· Conhecimento de Microsoft Windows, Microsoft Outlook.
· Excelentes habilidades de escrita.
· Compreensão do uso da Internet, bem como do site Amazon.com.br e dos sites da concorrência.

Habilidades de comunicação:
· Capacidade de comunicar de forma clara e assertiva com os clientes, tanto internos como externos.
· Excelentes habilidades de documentação de informações.
· Bom entendimento dos problemas apresentados pelos clientes.

Habilidades de composição
· Capacidade de escrever respostas corretas, concisas e precisas.

Habilidades para resolver problemas:
· Capacidade de compreender problemas logicamente.
· Resolução eficaz de problemas.
· Capacidade de aprender e tomar decisões rápidas.
· Disciplina e orientação para a ação.
· Orientação para o detalhe e elevada capacidade de organização.
· Capacidade de priorizar atividades garantindo o cumprimento das normas de gestão do tempo.

Outras características desejadas:
· Adaptabilidade a um ambiente multitarefa acelerado, enérgico.
· Resolver problemas de forma criativa e analítica.
· Grande paixão pelo atendimento ao cliente.
· Experiência anterior em função semelhante é desejável.
